public theorem adicCompletion_stalk_reduced_noetherian_complete_local_ringKrullDim_eq
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced X] (hX : IsNagataScheme X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (x : X) :
    _root_.IsReduced (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
      IsNoetherianRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
      (∃ _ : IsLocalRing
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
        IsAdicComplete
            (maximalIdeal
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
            (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
          ringKrullDim
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)) =
            ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
      ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≤ 1 ∧
      (ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ↔ ¬ IsField (X.presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: part (6) at every point: A^ reduced Noetherian complete local, dim A^ = dim A ≤ 1

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_injective_range_eq_integralClosure_adicCompletion_normalizationStalk_of_isNagataScheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C1R, part (7).** Let `X` be a reduced Nagata scheme of dimension one,
`A = 𝒪_{X,x}` and `A' = (ν_* 𝒪_{X^ν})_x`.  The completion `(A')^∧` of `A'` along `𝔪_A A'` is the
integral closure of `A^∧` in its total ring of fractions: there is an injective ring map
`(A')^∧ → Frac(A^∧)` extending the structure map of `A^∧`, whose image is the integral closure of
`A^∧` in `Frac(A^∧)`.

Closedness of the point is not needed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem
    exists_injective_range_eq_integralClosure_adicCompletion_normalizationStalk_of_isNagataScheme
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsReduced X] (hX : IsNagataScheme X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (normalizationPushforwardStalk X (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isNagataScheme X hX) x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X _ x
    let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let A' :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalk X (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isNagataScheme X hX) x
    let Ac := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    let J := (maximalIdeal A).map (algebraMap A A')
    let C := AdicCompletion J A'
    let k : Ac →+* C := adicCompletionMap (algebraMap A A') (maximalIdeal A) J le_rfl
    ∃ g : C →+* FractionRing Ac,
      Function.Injective g ∧
        g.range = (integralClosure Ac (FractionRing Ac)).toSubring ∧
        ∀ y : Ac, g (k y) = algebraMap Ac (FractionRing Ac) y
declarations.comment: part (7): (A')^ is the integral closure of A^ in its total ring of fractions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finite_maximalSpectrum_normalizationPushforwardStalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C1R.** The stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the
normalization of a Nagata scheme is semilocal: it has finitely many maximal ideals.

The point is not assumed closed, and the dimension hypothesis of the source is not used.
declarations.statement:
public theorem finite_maximalSpectrum_normalizationPushforwardStalk
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hNagata : IsNagataScheme X)
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite) (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X hX x
    Finite (MaximalSpectrum (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x))
declarations.comment: semilocal_dedekind

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isFiniteProductOfDedekindDomains_normalizationPushforwardStalk
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C1R.** On a Nagata scheme of dimension one, the stalk of the
pushforward of the structure sheaf of the normalization is a finite product of Dedekind
domains.

The point is not assumed closed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isFiniteProductOfDedekindDomains_normalizationPushforwardStalk
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (hNagata : IsNagataScheme X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite) (x : X) :
    IsDiscreteValuationRing.IsFiniteProductOfDedekindDomains
      (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x)
declarations.comment: semilocal_dedekind

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfBranches_eq_encard_normalizationFiber
declarations.doc: The number of branches at a point equals the number of points of the normalization above it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfBranches_eq_encard_normalizationFiber
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfBranches X x =
      Set.encard {y : Scheme.normalizationScheme X hX |
        Scheme.normalization X hX y = x}
declarations.comment: branches

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_card_sigma_sepDegree_normalization
declarations.doc:
The number of geometric branches at a point is the sum, over the points of the normalization
above it, of the separable degrees of the corresponding residue-field extensions, interpreted
as the extended cardinality of the sigma type of these multiplicities.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_card_sigma_sepDegree_normalization
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x =
      ENat.card (Σ y : {y : Scheme.normalizationScheme X hX //
          Scheme.normalization X hX y = x},
        letI := (((X.residueFieldCongr y.property).inv ≫
          (Scheme.normalization X hX).residueFieldMap y).hom).toAlgebra
        (Field.sepDegree (X.residueField x)
          ((Scheme.normalizationScheme X hX).residueField y)).ord.ToType)
declarations.comment: geometric_branches

declarations.name: Ring.deltaInvariant
declarations.doc:
The delta invariant of a commutative ring is the length of the quotient of its integral
closure in its total ring of fractions by the image of the ring.  For a reduced
one-dimensional Nagata local ring, this quotient has finite length.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable abbrev Ring.deltaInvariant (A : Type*) [CommRing A] : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: the invariant of a scheme at a point, as the invariant of the local ring there

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.multicross
declarations.doc: The ring of `n`-tuples of formal power series having the same constant coefficient.
declarations.statement: def multicross (k : Type*) [CommRing k] (n : ℕ) : Subring (Fin n → PowerSeries k)

declarations.name: Ring.deltaInvariant_ge_numberOfBranches_sub_one
declarations.doc:
**The delta invariant of a reduced one-dimensional Nagata local algebra over a separably
closed field is at least the number of branches minus one.**
declarations.statement:
theorem deltaInvariant_ge_numberOfBranches_sub_one
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A] (hNagata : IsNagataRing A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (_hres : Nonempty (ResidueField A ≃ₐ[k] k)) :
    numberOfBranchesOfLocalRing A - 1 ≤ Ring.deltaInvariant A
declarations.comment: delta invariant bound

declarations.name: Ring.adicCompletion_algEquiv_multicross_of_deltaInvariant_eq
declarations.doc:
**If equality holds in the branch bound, the completed local algebra is the multicross
algebra with one power-series factor for each branch.**
declarations.statement:
theorem adicCompletion_algEquiv_multicross_of_deltaInvariant_eq
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A] (hNagata : IsNagataRing A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (_hres : Nonempty (ResidueField A ≃ₐ[k] k))
    (heq : Ring.deltaInvariant A = numberOfBranchesOfLocalRing A - 1) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, numberOfBranchesOfLocalRing A = n ∧
      ∃ e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A ≃+* multicross k n,
        e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) =
          (RingHom.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ PowerSeries.C).codRestrict
            (multicross k n) (by
              intro a
              rw [mem_multicross]
              simp)
declarations.comment: equality case

declarations.name: Ring.deltaInvariant_eq_numberOfBranches_sub_one_of_adicCompletion_algEquiv_multicross
declarations.doc:
**A coefficient-compatible multicross description of the completion, with one factor for
each branch, forces equality in the delta-invariant bound.**
declarations.statement:
theorem deltaInvariant_eq_numberOfBranches_sub_one_of_adicCompletion_algEquiv_multicross
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [IsSepClosed k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A] (hNagata : IsNagataRing A)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (_hres : Nonempty (ResidueField A ≃ₐ[k] k))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : numberOfBranchesOfLocalRing A = n)
    (e : AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A ≃+* multicross k n)
    (_he : e.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap k (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) =
      (RingHom.pi fun _ : Fin n ↦ PowerSeries.C).codRestrict
        (multicross k n) (by
          intro a
          rw [mem_multicross]
          simp)) :
    Ring.deltaInvariant A = numberOfBranchesOfLocalRing A - 1
declarations.comment: converse equality case

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.IsMulticrossSingularity
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C1W.** A point is a multicross singularity if it is closed and its completed
local ring is a multicross ring with at least two branches.
declarations.statement:
def IsMulticrossSingularity (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] (x : X) : Prop
declarations.comment: multicross singularity

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.IsOrdinaryDoublePoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C1W.** A point is an ordinary double point — a node, or a nodal singularity — if
it is closed and its completed local ring is the two-branch multicross ring.
declarations.statement:
def IsOrdinaryDoublePoint (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] (x : X) : Prop
declarations.comment: node (ordinary double point)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isMulticrossSingularity_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C1X.** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, `X` a reduced algebraic
one-dimensional `k`-scheme and `x ∈ X` a closed point whose local ring is not regular. The
following are equivalent:

1. `x` defines a multicross singularity;
2. the delta invariant of `X` at `x` is the number of branches of `X` at `x` minus one;
3. there is a sequence of morphisms `U_n ⟶ U_{n-1} ⟶ … ⟶ U_0 = U ⊆ X` with `U` an open
   neighbourhood of `x`, with `U_n` nonsingular, and with every step a glueing of two points as
   in Example 0C1J.

The equivalence of (1) and (2) is
`Stacks.Curves.isMulticrossSingularity_iff_deltaInvariant_eq_of_not_isRegularLocalRing`, which
is Tag 0C1V read at a point of a scheme. For (3) implies (1) the completion at the point glued
in each step is the pair pullback of the two completions above it, hence a multicross ring or a
field, and over every other point the step is an isomorphism on stalks. For (1) implies (3) an
open neighbourhood on which `x` is the only singular point is chosen, Tag 0C1L factors its
normalization morphism into glueings of two points and squishings of tangent vectors, and no
step is a squishing because a multicross completion is seminormal while a squishing produces a
non-seminormal completion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMulticrossSingularity_tfae
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))] [IsReduced X]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hsing : ¬ IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :
    List.TFAE
      [Stacks.Curves.IsMulticrossSingularity k X x,
        Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = numberOfBranches X x - 1,
        HasNonsingularGlueingResolution k X x]
declarations.comment: all three clauses.  The hypothesis that the local ring at `x` is not regular is an erratum repair, not a weakening: the source's displayed equivalence is false at a nonsingular closed point, where the delta invariant is 0 and the number of branches is 1, so clauses (2) and (3) hold while (1) fails because Definition 0C1W requires n ≥ 2 -- Lemma 0C1V, which the source cites for the equivalence of (1) and (2), puts no lower bound on n. That counterexample is proved, not asserted, in `Stacks.Curves.exists_counterexample_to_displayed_statement_of_tag_0C1X_at_nonsingular_point`, and at a concrete scheme -- the origin of the affine line -- in `Stacks.Curves.exists_counterexample_to_displayed_statement_of_tag_0C1X_specPolynomial`. The hypothesis excludes exactly the regular configurations, where the equivalence fails, and nothing else

declarations.name: Stacks.Picard.nonempty_torsionBy_addEquiv_pi_zmod_of_smoothProjectiveCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C1Z (1).** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field and `X` a smooth
projective curve of genus `g` over `k`. If `n ≥ 1` is invertible in `k`, then
`Pic(X)[n] ≅ (ℤ/nℤ)^{⊕2g}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_torsionBy_addEquiv_pi_zmod_of_smoothProjectiveCurve (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve k f]
    [IsProjectiveVariety k f] [Smooth f] (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnk : IsUnit (n : k)) :
    Nonempty (Submodule.torsionBy ℤ (ofScheme X) (n : ℤ) ≃+ (Fin (2 * genus f) → ZMod n))
declarations.comment: clause (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Picard.exists_rank_torsionBy_prime_pow_addEquiv_pi_zmod_of_smoothProjectiveCurve
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C1Z (2).** Let `k` be an algebraically closed field of characteristic
`p > 0` and `X` a smooth projective curve of genus `g` over `k`. Then there is an integer
`0 ≤ r ≤ g` with `Pic(X)[p^m] ≅ (ℤ/p^mℤ)^{⊕r}` for all `m ≥ 1` (the source's `f`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_rank_torsionBy_prime_pow_addEquiv_pi_zmod_of_smoothProjectiveCurve (k : Type u)
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsCurve k f]
    [IsProjectiveVariety k f] [Smooth f] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∃ r : ℕ, r ≤ genus f ∧ ∀ m : ℕ, 1 ≤ m →
      Nonempty (Submodule.torsionBy ℤ (ofScheme X) ((p : ℤ) ^ m) ≃+ (Fin r → ZMod (p ^ m)))
declarations.comment: clause (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_picardTorsion_le_genus_add_geometricGenus_of_isReduced_dim_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C20, the bound.**

Let `k` be an algebraically closed field, let `X` be a proper scheme over `k` which is reduced and
of dimension one, let `g = h¹(X, 𝒪_X)` be its genus and let `g_geom` be the sum of the geometric
genera of its irreducible components, and let `ℓ` be a prime different from the characteristic of
`k`.  Then the `ℓ`-torsion of `Pic(X)` is finite-dimensional over `F_ℓ` and

`dim_{F_ℓ} Pic(X)[ℓ] ≤ g + g_geom`.

Connectedness, which the source assumes, is not needed; the source's statement is the special
case `[ConnectedSpace X]`.

The proof is the source's: the normalization is factored by [Stacks, Tag 0C1L], the two
invariants are compared along the factorization by the three lines of the source's table, and at
the far end `h¹(X^ν) = g_geom`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.genus_normalizationOverField_eq_geometricGenus`) and
`dim_{F_ℓ} Pic(X^ν)[ℓ] = 2 g_geom`, the latter from clause (1) of [Stacks, Tag 0C1Z]
(`Stacks.Picard.nonempty_torsionBy_addEquiv_pi_zmod_of_smoothProjectiveCurve`) by
`AlgebraicGeometry.rank_picardTorsion_normalizationSchemeOverField_eq_two_mul_geometricGenus`.
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_picardTorsion_le_genus_add_geometricGenus_of_isReduced_dim_one (k : Type u)
    [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsReduced X]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (X : Type u) = 1) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (hℓ : (ℓ : k) ≠ 0) :
    FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (ofScheme X) (ℓ : ℤ)) ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (ofScheme X) (ℓ : ℤ)) ≤
        genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) + geometricGenus k (X ↘ Spec (.of k))
declarations.comment: the bound dim Pic(X)[l] ≤ g + g_geom (connectedness not needed)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_picardTorsion_eq_iff_forall_isMulticrossSingularity_of_isReduced_dim_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C20, the equality criterion.**

In the situation of the bound
`AlgebraicGeometry.finrank_picardTorsion_le_genus_add_geometricGenus_of_isReduced_dim_one`, the
`ℓ`-torsion of `Pic(X)` is finite-dimensional over `F_ℓ`, and equality
`dim_{F_ℓ} Pic(X)[ℓ] = g + g_geom` holds if and only if every singularity of `X` is multicross.

Equality holds exactly when the factorization of the normalization contains no squishing, in
both directions — the forward direction from the strict drop a squishing causes, the backward
direction from the equality case of the arithmetic along a glueing chain — and the
factorization contains no squishing exactly when every singularity of `X` is multicross
(`Stacks.Curves.isGlueingChain_normalizationOver_iff_forall_isMulticrossSingularity`, the step
the source leaves out: "just glue the local sequences for each point to find one that works for
all singular points").
declarations.statement:
theorem finrank_picardTorsion_eq_iff_forall_isMulticrossSingularity_of_isReduced_dim_one
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsReduced X] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim (X : Type u) = 1) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hℓ : (ℓ : k) ≠ 0) :
    FiniteDimensional (ZMod ℓ) (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (ofScheme X) (ℓ : ℤ)) ∧
      (Module.finrank (ZMod ℓ) (AddSubgroup.torsionBy (ofScheme X) (ℓ : ℤ)) =
        genus (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) + geometricGenus k (X ↘ Spec (.of k)) ↔
      ∀ x : X, ¬ IsRegularLocalRing (X.presheaf.stalk x) →
        Stacks.Curves.IsMulticrossSingularity k X x)
declarations.comment: the equality criterion: equality iff all singularities are multicross

declarations.name: isReduced_of_flat_of_isReduced_fiber
declarations.doc:
Let `R → S` be a flat ring map of Noetherian rings. If `R` is reduced and every fibre ring
`κ(𝔭) ⊗_R S` is reduced, then `S` is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduced_of_flat_of_isReduced_fiber {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Module.Flat R S]
    [IsReduced R] (hfibre : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], IsReduced (p.Fiber S)) :
    IsReduced S
declarations.comment: The ring map is an `Algebra R S` instance with `Module.Flat R S`, and the fibre ring `S ⊗_R κ(𝔭)` is Mathlib's `Ideal.Fiber 𝔭 S`, as in the statements of Tags 0339 and 033A. Reducedness is Mathlib's `IsReduced`, and the fibre hypothesis is reducedness, not geometric reducedness, so this is not an affine instance of Mathlib's `AlgebraicGeometry.GeometricallyReduced.isReduced_of_flat_of_isLocallyNoetherian`. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: isNormalRing_of_flat_of_isNormalRing_fiber
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0C22.** Let `R → S` be a flat ring map of Noetherian rings. If `R` is a normal
ring and every fibre ring `κ(𝔭) ⊗_R S` is a normal ring, then `S` is a normal ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalRing_of_flat_of_isNormalRing_fiber {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R]
    [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [Module.Flat R S]
    (hR : IsNormalRing R) (hfibre : ∀ (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime], IsNormalRing (p.Fiber S)) :
    IsNormalRing S
declarations.comment: The ring map is an `Algebra R S` instance with `Module.Flat R S`, and the fibre ring `S ⊗_R κ(𝔭)` is Mathlib's `Ideal.Fiber 𝔭 S`, as in the companion statements 0C21 and 0339. Normality is the library's `IsNormalRing` (Definition 00GV), definitionally the `IsDomain` plus `IsIntegrallyClosed` condition on `Localization.AtPrime 𝔮` that tags 030C(1), 031S and 033G write out, and the fibre hypothesis is normality, not geometric normality. Mathlib has neither a normal-ring predicate nor this ascent. See the module docstring.

declarations.name: isNormalRing_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0C23.** The completion of a Noetherian normal local ring whose formal fibres
are normal is a normal ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNormalRing_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    (hA : IsNormalRing A)
    (hformal : ∀ (p : Ideal A) [p.IsPrime],
      IsNormalRing (p.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))) :
    IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)

declarations.name: bijective_maximalIdeals_and_minimalPrimes_of_henselization
declarations.doc:
Let `A'` be the integral closure of a local ring `A` in the total ring of fractions of its
reduction, and let `Aʰ` be a henselization of `A`. Contraction from `A' ⊗[A] Aʰ` is bijective
on maximal ideals toward `A'` and on minimal primes toward `Aʰ`. Each minimal prime of the tensor
product lies in a unique maximal ideal, and each maximal ideal contains a unique minimal prime.
declarations.statement:
theorem bijective_maximalIdeals_and_minimalPrimes_of_henselization
    (A : Type u) (Ah : Type v) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah]
    [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ah]
    (hmin : (minimalPrimes A).Finite) :
    let A' := integralClosure A (FractionRing (A ⧸ nilradical A))
    let T := TensorProduct A A' Ah
    Set.BijOn
        (Ideal.comap (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : A' →+* T))
        {I : Ideal T | I.IsMaximal} {I : Ideal A' | I.IsMaximal} ∧
      Set.BijOn
        (Ideal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Ah →ₐ[A] T).toRingHom)
        (minimalPrimes T) (minimalPrimes Ah) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ minimalPrimes T, ∃! m : Ideal T, m.IsMaximal ∧ q ≤ m) ∧
      (∀ m : Ideal T, m.IsMaximal → ∃! q : Ideal T, q ∈ minimalPrimes T ∧ q ≤ m)

declarations.name: geometric_branches_of_strictHenselization
declarations.doc:
Let `A'` be the integral closure of a local ring `A` in the total ring of fractions of its
reduction, and let `Aˢʰ` be a strict henselization with separably closed residue field `ksep`
inside an algebraic closure `kbar`. The residue extension at every maximal ideal of `A'` is
algebraic, and its embeddings into `kbar` canonically parametrize the fibre in
`Spec (A' ⊗[A] Aˢʰ)`. Contraction to `Aˢʰ` is bijective on minimal primes, and containment gives
mutually unique correspondences between minimal and maximal primes of the tensor product.
declarations.statement:
theorem geometric_branches_of_strictHenselization
    (A : Type u) (Ash : Type u') (ksep : Type v) (kbar : Type w)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
    [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash]
    [Field kbar] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) kbar]
    [IsAlgClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) kbar]
    [Algebra ksep kbar] [IsScalarTower (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep kbar]
    (e : ksep ≃+* IsLocalRing.ResidueField Ash)
    (he : ∀ x : A,
      e (algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep (IsLocalRing.residue A x)) =
        IsLocalRing.residue Ash (algebraMap A Ash x))
    (hmin : (minimalPrimes A).Finite) :
    let A' := integralClosure A (FractionRing (A ⧸ nilradical A))
    let T := TensorProduct A A' Ash
    (∀ m' : MaximalSpectrum A',
      ∃ h : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = m'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A A'),
        let f := Ideal.quotientMap m'.asIdeal (algebraMap A A') (le_of_eq h)
        f.IsIntegral ∧
          ∃ E : ({σ : (A' ⧸ m'.asIdeal) →+* kbar //
                    σ.comp f = algebraMap (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) kbar} ≃
                  {q : PrimeSpectrum T //
                    PrimeSpectrum.comap
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom : A' →+* T) q =
                        m'.toPrimeSpectrum}),
            ∀ σ, ∃ φ : T →+* kbar,
              (∀ (a : A') (b : Ash),
                  φ (a ⊗ₜ[A] b) =
                    σ.1 (Ideal.Quotient.mk m'.asIdeal a) *
                      algebraMap ksep kbar (e.symm (IsLocalRing.residue Ash b))) ∧
                (E σ).1.asIdeal = RingHom.ker φ ∧
                ∀ ψ : T →+* kbar,
                  (∀ (a : A') (b : Ash),
                    ψ (a ⊗ₜ[A] b) =
                      σ.1 (Ideal.Quotient.mk m'.asIdeal a) *
                        algebraMap ksep kbar (e.symm (IsLocalRing.residue Ash b))) →
                  ψ = φ) ∧
      Set.BijOn
        (Ideal.comap
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : Ash →ₐ[A] T).toRingHom)
        (minimalPrimes T) (minimalPrimes Ash) ∧
      (∀ q ∈ minimalPrimes T, ∃! m : Ideal T, m.IsMaximal ∧ q ≤ m) ∧
      (∀ m : Ideal T, m.IsMaximal → ∃! q : Ideal T, q ∈ minimalPrimes T ∧ q ≤ m)

declarations.name: numberOfBranches
declarations.doc:
The number of branches of a local ring is the extended-natural cardinality of the set of
minimal primes of a henselization.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def numberOfBranches (A Ah : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing Ah]
    [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ah] : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: number of branches

declarations.name: numberOfGeometricBranches
declarations.doc:
The number of geometric branches of a local ring is the extended-natural cardinality of the
set of minimal primes of a strict henselization.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def numberOfGeometricBranches (A : Type u) (ksep : Type v) (Ash : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep] [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash]
    [Algebra A Ash] [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash] : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: number of geometric branches

declarations.name: numberOfBranches_le_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_le_completion
declarations.doc:
For a Noetherian local ring `A` with henselization `Aʰ` and strict henselization `Aˢʰ`, there
is a map `Aʰ → Â` along which contraction is surjective on minimal primes, `Â ⊗[Aʰ] Aˢʰ` is a
strict henselization of `Â`, and completion decreases neither the number of branches nor the
number of geometric branches.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberOfBranches_le_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_le_completion
    (A Ah Ash : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah]
    (κsep : Type v) [Field κsep] [Algebra (ResidueField A) κsep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField A) κsep]
    [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash] [Algebra Ah Ash]
    [IsScalarTower A Ah Ash] [IsHenselization A κsep Ash]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap Ah Ash)] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    ∃ hAhatLocal : IsLocalRing Ahat,
      letI : IsLocalRing Ahat := hAhatLocal
      ∃ hAhatMapLocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A Ahat),
        letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A Ahat) := hAhatMapLocal
        ∃ f : Ah →+* Ahat,
          (∀ x : A, f (algebraMap A Ah x) = algebraMap A Ahat x) ∧
          Set.SurjOn (fun q => Ideal.comap f q) (minimalPrimes Ahat) (minimalPrimes Ah) ∧
          letI : Algebra Ah Ahat := f.toAlgebra
          ∃ hAhatHenselization : IsHenselization Ahat (ResidueField Ahat) Ahat,
            letI : IsHenselization Ahat (ResidueField Ahat) Ahat := hAhatHenselization
            numberOfBranches A Ah ≤ numberOfBranches Ahat Ahat ∧
            ∃ algKhat : Algebra (ResidueField Ahat) κsep,
              letI : Algebra (ResidueField Ahat) κsep := algKhat
              (∀ x : ResidueField A,
                algebraMap (ResidueField Ahat) κsep
                    (ResidueField.map (algebraMap A Ahat) x) =
                  algebraMap (ResidueField A) κsep x) ∧
              ∃ hKsep : IsSepClosure (ResidueField Ahat) κsep,
                letI : IsSepClosure (ResidueField Ahat) κsep := hKsep
                ∃ hTensorLocal : IsLocalRing (Ahat ⊗[Ah] Ash),
                  letI : IsLocalRing (Ahat ⊗[Ah] Ash) := hTensorLocal
                  ∃ hTensorHenselization : IsHenselization Ahat κsep (Ahat ⊗[Ah] Ash),
                    letI : IsHenselization Ahat κsep (Ahat ⊗[Ah] Ash) := hTensorHenselization
                    numberOfGeometricBranches A κsep Ash ≤
                      numberOfGeometricBranches Ahat κsep (Ahat ⊗[Ah] Ash)

declarations.name: numberOfBranches_eq_completion_iff_radical_map_minimalPrime_isPrime
declarations.doc:
A Noetherian local ring and its completion have the same number of branches if and only if
the radical of the extension of every minimal prime of a henselization to the completion is
prime.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberOfBranches_eq_completion_iff_radical_map_minimalPrime_isPrime
    (A Ah : Type u)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    ∃ hAhatLocal : IsLocalRing Ahat,
      letI : IsLocalRing Ahat := hAhatLocal
      ∃ hAhatMapLocal : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A Ahat),
        letI : IsLocalHom (algebraMap A Ahat) := hAhatMapLocal
        ∃ f : Ah →+* Ahat,
          (∀ x : A, f (algebraMap A Ah x) = algebraMap A Ahat x) ∧
          ∃ hAhatHenselization : IsHenselization Ahat (ResidueField Ahat) Ahat,
            letI : IsHenselization Ahat (ResidueField Ahat) Ahat := hAhatHenselization
            (numberOfBranches A Ah =
                numberOfBranches Ahat Ahat ↔
              ∀ q ∈ minimalPrimes Ah, (Ideal.map f q).radical.IsPrime)

declarations.name: exists_surjective_bijective_away_prod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0C2A, Lemma 15.110.3.**
Let `A` be a ring, `I ⊆ A` a finitely generated ideal, and `A → C` a ring map such that
for every `f ∈ I` the induced map `A_f → C_f` is localization at an idempotent. Then there
is a surjective ring map `A → C'` such that for every `f ∈ I` the canonical ring map
`A_f → (C × C')_f` is an isomorphism (here expressed as a bijective ring homomorphism).

Note: `C'` is constructed as a quotient of `A`, so it lives in the universe `u` of `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_surjective_bijective_away_prod {A : Type u} {C : Type v} [CommRing A] [CommRing C]
  [Algebra A C]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.FG)
    (h : ∀ f ∈ I, IsLocalizationAtIdempotent
      (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away f)
        (Localization.Away (algebraMap A C f)) (algebraMap A C) f)) :
    ∃ (C' : Type u) (_ : CommRing C') (_ : Algebra A C'),
      Function.Surjective (algebraMap A C') ∧
      ∀ f ∈ I, Function.Bijective
        (IsLocalization.Away.map (Localization.Away f)
          (Localization.Away (algebraMap A (C × C') f)) (algebraMap A (C × C')) f)

declarations.name: exists_minimalPrime_henselization_radical_map_eq_of_quotient_dimension_one
declarations.doc:
A minimal prime defining a one-dimensional component of the completion of a Noetherian local
ring is the radical of the extension of a minimal prime of its henselization.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_minimalPrime_henselization_radical_map_eq_of_quotient_dimension_one
    (A : Type u) (Ah : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    ∃ f : Ah →+* Ahat,
      (∀ x : A, f (algebraMap A Ah x) = algebraMap A Ahat x) ∧
        ∀ q : Ideal Ahat, q ∈ minimalPrimes Ahat →
          ringKrullDim (Ahat ⧸ q) = 1 →
            ∃ qh : Ideal Ah, qh ∈ minimalPrimes Ah ∧ q = (Ideal.map f qh).radical

declarations.name: not_isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_adicCompletion_iff_henselization
declarations.doc:
The punctured spectrum of the completion of a Noetherian local ring is disconnected if and
only if the punctured spectrum of its henselization is disconnected.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isConnected_puncturedSpectrum_adicCompletion_iff_henselization
    (A : Type u) (Ah : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah] :
    let Ahat := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    (¬ _root_.IsConnected {p : PrimeSpectrum Ahat | p.asIdeal ≠ maximalIdeal Ahat}) ↔
      ¬ _root_.IsConnected {p : PrimeSpectrum Ah | p.asIdeal ≠ maximalIdeal Ah}

declarations.name: numberOfBranches_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_adicCompletion_of_dimension_one
declarations.doc:
Completion preserves the ordinary and the geometric number of branches of a one-dimensional
Noetherian local ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberOfBranches_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_adicCompletion_of_dimension_one
    (A Ah AhatH Ash AhatSh : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah]
    [CommRing AhatH] [IsLocalRing AhatH]
    [Algebra (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatH]
    [IsHenselization (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
      (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) AhatH]
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField A) ksep]
    [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash] [IsHenselization A ksep Ash]
    (khatsep : Type w) [Field khatsep]
    [Algebra (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) khatsep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) khatsep]
    [CommRing AhatSh] [IsLocalRing AhatSh]
    [Algebra (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatSh]
    [IsHenselization (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) khatsep AhatSh]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    numberOfBranches A Ah =
        numberOfBranches (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatH ∧
      numberOfGeometricBranches A ksep Ash =
        numberOfGeometricBranches
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) khatsep AhatSh

declarations.name: isNagataRing_and_numberOfBranches_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
A Noetherian local ring whose formal fibres are geometrically normal is Nagata, and its
ordinary and geometric branch counts agree with those of its completion.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNagataRing_and_numberOfBranches_and_numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_adicCompletion
    (A Ah AhatH Ash AhatSh : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsHenselization A (ResidueField A) Ah]
    [CommRing AhatH] [IsLocalRing AhatH]
    [Algebra (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatH]
    [IsHenselization (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
      (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) AhatH]
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField A) ksep]
    [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash] [IsHenselization A ksep Ash]
    (khatsep : Type w) [Field khatsep]
    [Algebra (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) khatsep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)) khatsep]
    [CommRing AhatSh] [IsLocalRing AhatSh]
    [Algebra (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatSh]
    [IsHenselization (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) khatsep AhatSh]
    (hformal : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum A,
      Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal q.asIdeal.ResidueField
        (q.asIdeal.Fiber (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A))) :
    IsNagataRing A ∧
      numberOfBranches A Ah =
        numberOfBranches (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) AhatH ∧
      numberOfGeometricBranches A ksep Ash =
        numberOfGeometricBranches
          (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) khatsep AhatSh

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Catenary.isUniversallyCatenary_henselization_and_of_isUnibranch
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C2F.** A Noetherian local ring with geometrically normal formal fibres has a

declarations.statement:
public lemma isUniversallyCatenary_henselization_and_of_isUnibranch

declarations.name: Stacks.Surfaces.isZero_rightDerived_one_divisorTwist
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2J], assertion (1).** Let `E ⊆ X` be an exceptional curve of the first kind
on a scheme `X`, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and let `n` be the degree of `ℒ|_E` as an
invertible module on `𝐏¹`, recorded as an isomorphism `e^*i^*ℒ ≅ 𝒪(n)`. If `H¹(X, ℒ) = 0` and
`0 ≤ n` then

`H¹(X, ℒ(iE)) = 0` for every `0 ≤ i ≤ n + 1`.

The induction is on `i`, along the ideal sequence of `E` twisted by `ℒ((i+1)E)`:

`0 ⟶ ℒ(iE) ⟶ ℒ((i+1)E) ⟶ ℒ((i+1)E)|_E ⟶ 0`,

whose first term is identified by `Stacks.Surfaces.twistedIdealIso` and whose third restricts to
`𝒪(n - i - 1)` on `𝐏¹`. For `i ≤ n` that degree is at least `-1`, so the third term has no `H¹`
by `Stacks.Surfaces.isZero_rightDerived_one_tensorPushforwardUnit`, and the degree-one row of
the long exact sequence forces `H¹` of the middle term to vanish. The hypothesis `0 ≤ n` is the
source's and is carried unchanged; the induction consumes only `i ≤ n + 1`, since the step that
produces `ℒ((j+1)E)` gets the `j ≤ n` it needs from `j + 1 ≤ n + 1`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_one_divisorTwist (E : X.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ E.subscheme}
    (hE : E.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.sheaf))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    {n : ℤ} (_hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (hdeg : (modulePullback e.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((modulePullback E.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) ≅
      ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n)
    (hL : IsZero (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived 1).obj L))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : (i : ℤ) ≤ n + 1) :
    IsZero (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived 1).obj (divisorTwist E L i))
declarations.comment: assertion (1): H^1 vanishes on the twists ℒ(iE) for 0 ≤ i ≤ n+1

declarations.name: Stacks.Surfaces.mono_rightDerived_one_map_tensorCanonicalSection
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2J], assertion (2).** Let `E ⊆ X` be an exceptional curve of the first kind
on a scheme `X`, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and let `n` be the degree of `ℒ|_E` as an
invertible module on `𝐏¹`, recorded as an isomorphism `e^*i^*ℒ ≅ 𝒪(n)`. If `n ≤ 0` then
multiplication by the canonical section `1_E` makes `H¹(X, ℒ)` a submodule of `H¹(X, ℒ(E))`.

The map is `Stacks.Divisors.tensorCanonicalSection`, the canonical map `ℒ ⟶ ℒ ⊗ 𝒪_X(E)` of
multiplication by `1_E`, and not merely some isomorphic copy of it.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_rightDerived_one_map_tensorCanonicalSection (E : X.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u)
    [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ E.subscheme}
    (hE : E.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} ((Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (X).sheaf)))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    {n : ℤ} (hn : n ≤ 0)
    (hdeg : (modulePullback e.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((modulePullback E.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) ≅
      ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n) :
    Mono (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived 1).map (tensorCanonicalSection E L))
declarations.comment: assertion (2): injectivity on H^1 when the degree is non-positive

declarations.name: Stacks.Surfaces.isZero_rightDerived_one_tensorInvertibleSheafPow
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2J], assertion (1).** Let `E ⊆ X` be an exceptional curve of the first kind
on a scheme `X`, let `ℒ` be an invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and let `n` be the degree of `ℒ|_E` as an
invertible module on `𝐏¹`, recorded as an isomorphism `e^*i^*ℒ ≅ 𝒪(n)`. If `H¹(X, ℒ) = 0` and
`n ≥ 0` then `H¹(X, ℒ(iE)) = 0` for every `0 ≤ i ≤ n + 1`.

Here `ℒ(iE)` is `ℒ ⊗ 𝒪_X(iE)` with `iE = E ^ i` the `i`-fold sum of `E` with itself in the monoid
of effective Cartier divisors.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_rightDerived_one_tensorInvertibleSheafPow (E : X.IdealSheafData) (k : Type u)
    [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ E.subscheme}
    (hE : E.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (L : _root_.SheafOfModules.{u} (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.sheaf))
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible X.presheaf
      (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace).property L]
    {n : ℤ} (_hn : 0 ≤ n)
    (hdeg : (modulePullback e.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
        ((modulePullback E.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) ≅
      ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n)
    (h0 : IsZero (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived 1).obj L))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : (i : ℤ) ≤ n + 1) :
    IsZero (((moduleGlobalSections X).rightDerived 1).obj
      (MonoidalCategory.tensorObj (C := _root_.SheafOfModules.{u}
        (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf X.sheaf))
        L (invertibleSheaf' (E ^ i))))
declarations.comment: assertion (1): vanishing through the twists of nonnegative degree

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isSteinFactorization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2L.** Let `X` be a Noetherian scheme and `E ⊆ X` an exceptional curve
of the first kind, cut out by `D` and presented as `𝐏¹_k` by `e`. Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism
such that `Y` is Noetherian, `f` is proper, `f` maps `E` to a point `y` of `Y`, and `f` is
quasi-finite at every point not in `E`. Then there exists a contraction `b : X ⟶ Z` of `E`, and it
is the Stein factorization of `f`: `f = b ≫ π` with `𝒪_Z ⟶ b_* 𝒪_X` an isomorphism and `π`
integral, which characterises the Stein factorization ([Stacks, Tag 03H0]).
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isSteinFactorization
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] {D : X.IdealSheafData} {k : Type u}
    [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme} (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (y : Y)
    (hmaps : ∀ z : D.subscheme, f.base (D.subschemeι.base z) = y)
    (hqf : ∀ x ∉ (D.support : Set X), quasiFiniteAt f x) :
    ∃ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (b : X ⟶ Z) (π : Z ⟶ Y), b ≫ π = f ∧ IsIso b.c ∧ IsIntegralHom π ∧
      IsContractionOfExceptionalCurve D b

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_contraction_isProper_isAmple
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2M].** Let `S = Spec R` be an affine Noetherian scheme, `f : X ⟶ S` a proper
morphism, `ℒ` an ample invertible `𝒪_X`-module, and `E ⊆ X` an exceptional curve of the first
kind, cut out by `D` and presented as `𝐏¹_k` by `e`. Then

1. there exists a contraction `b : X ⟶ X'` of `E`;
2. `X'` is proper over `S`: the structure morphism factors as `b ≫ f'` with `f'` proper;
3. the invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module `ℒ'` of [Stacks, Remark 0C5M] is ample. Here `ℒ` has a degree
   `n` on `E` (its restriction to `𝐏¹_k` is `𝒪(n)`), and `ℒ'` is an invertible `𝒪_{X'}`-module
   with `b^*ℒ' = ℒ(nE)` in `Pic(X)`, i.e. `b^*[ℒ'] = [ℒ] + n • [𝒪_X(E)]`
   (`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exceptionalTwist`). Such an `ℒ'` exists, and every
   such `ℒ'` is ample; it is unique up to isomorphism by
   `AlgebraicGeometry.IsContractionOfExceptionalCurve.nonempty_iso_of_schemePullbackClass_eq`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_contraction_isProper_isAmple {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsProper f]
    (L : X.Modules) [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X L)
    {D : X.IdealSheafData} {k : Type u} [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme}
    (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e) :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (b : X ⟶ X'),
      IsContractionOfExceptionalCurve D b ∧
      (∃ f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of R), b ≫ f' = f ∧ IsProper f') ∧
      (∃ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((modulePullback e.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          ((modulePullback D.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) ≅
        ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((modulePullback e.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj
          ((modulePullback D.subschemeι.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj L) ≅
        ProjectiveSpectrum.Proj.twistingSheaf (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) n) →
        (∃ (L' : X'.Modules) (_ : Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X' L'),
          Stacks.Picard.schemePullbackClass b (cls L') =
            (haveI := hE.isEffectiveCartierDivisor; D.exceptionalTwist n (cls L))) ∧
        ∀ (L' : X'.Modules) [Stacks.Ample.IsInvertibleModule X' L'],
          Stacks.Picard.schemePullbackClass b (cls L') =
            (haveI := hE.isEffectiveCartierDivisor; D.exceptionalTwist n (cls L)) →
          Scheme.Modules.IsAmple X' L'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isProjective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2N] (1).** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme and `f : X ⟶ S` a morphism of
finite type. Let `E ⊆ X` be an exceptional curve of the first kind, cut out by `D` and presented
as `𝐏¹_k` by `e`, which lies in the fibre of `f` over a point `s`. If `X` is projective over `S`,
then there exists a contraction `b : X ⟶ X'` of `E`, and `X'` is projective over `S`: the
structure morphism factors as `b ≫ g` with `g` projective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] {D : X.IdealSheafData} {k : Type u}
    [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme} (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (s : S) (hs : ∀ x ∈ (D.support : Set X), f.base x = s) (hf : IsProjective f) :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (b : X ⟶ X') (g : X' ⟶ S),
      IsContractionOfExceptionalCurve D b ∧ b ≫ g = f ∧ IsProjective g

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isQuasiProjective
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C2N] (2).** Let `S` be a Noetherian scheme and `f : X ⟶ S` a morphism of
finite type. Let `E ⊆ X` be an exceptional curve of the first kind, cut out by `D` and presented
as `𝐏¹_k` by `e`, which lies in the fibre of `f` over a point `s`. If `X` is quasi-projective over
`S`, then there exists a contraction `b : X ⟶ X'` of `E`, and `X'` is quasi-projective over `S`:
the structure morphism factors as `b ≫ g` with `g` quasi-projective.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isContractionOfExceptionalCurve_isQuasiProjective {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    {D : X.IdealSheafData} {k : Type u} [Field k] {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme}
    (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e) (s : S)
    (hs : ∀ x ∈ (D.support : Set X), f.base x = s) (hf : IsQuasiProjective f) :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (b : X ⟶ X') (g : X' ⟶ S),
      IsContractionOfExceptionalCurve D b ∧ b ≫ g = f ∧ IsQuasiProjective g

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.IsModelHom
declarations.doc:

which induces the identity on `V`, i.e. carries the identification `V ≅ X_K` to `V ≅ X'_K`.

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.IsModel.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Base change of a model** (Section 0C2R). Let `R ⊆ R'` be an extension of discrete
valuation rings with induced extension `K'/K` of fraction fields. If `X` is a model of the
`K`-scheme `V` over `R`, then `X ×_{Spec R} Spec R'` is a model of `V' = V ×_{Spec K} Spec K'`
over `R'`.
declarations.comment: base change X ↦ X ×_{Spec R} Spec R' along an extension of discrete valuation rings sends models of V over R to models of V' = V ×_{Spec K} Spec K' over R'

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.IsModelHom.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Base change of a morphism of models** (Section 0C2R): the base change of a morphism of
models of `V` over `R` is a morphism of models of `V'` over `R'`.
declarations.comment: base change sends morphisms of models of V over R to morphisms of models of V' over R'

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.Model.baseChange
declarations.doc:
**The base change functor** (Section 0C2R): for an extension of discrete valuation rings
`R ⊆ R'` with induced extension `K'/K` of fraction fields, `X ↦ X ×_{Spec R} Spec R'` is a
functor from models of `V` over `R` to models of `V' = V ×_{Spec K} Spec K'` over `R'`.
declarations.statement:
def Model.baseChange (V : Scheme.{u}) (v : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :
    Model R v ⥤ Model R' (pullback.snd v (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K K'))))
declarations.comment: the functor from models for V over R to models for V' over R' sending X to X ×_{Spec R} Spec R'

registrations.name: Stacks.Models.IsModel
