declarations.name: Stacks.Models.schemeTheoreticImage_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2S.** The scheme-theoretic image of a closed immersion of
algebraic `K`-schemes in an `R`-model of its target is an `R`-model of its source.
declarations.statement:
theorem schemeTheoreticImage_isModel {V₁ V₂ X₂ : Scheme.{u}}
    (v₁ : V₁ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (v₂ : V₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType v₁] [QuasiCompact v₁]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType v₂] [QuasiCompact v₂]
    (f : V₁ ⟶ V₂) [IsClosedImmersion f] (hf : f ≫ v₂ = v₁)
    (p₂ : X₂ ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    (e₂ : V₂ ≅ pullback p₂ (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX₂ : IsModel v₂ p₂ e₂) :
    let i := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))
    let g := f ≫ e₂.hom ≫ pullback.fst p₂ i
    ∃ e₁ : V₁ ≅ pullback (g.imageι ≫ p₂) i, IsModel v₁ (g.imageι ≫ p₂) e₁

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.isFinite_normalization_of_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2T (finiteness of the normalization).** The normalization of a model,
over a discrete valuation ring, of a geometrically normal scheme over its fraction field is a
finite morphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_normalization_of_isModel {V X : Scheme.{u}}
    (v : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (hV : IsGeometricallyNormal v)
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    (e : V ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : IsModel v p e)
    (hfinX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite) :
    IsFinite (Scheme.normalization X hfinX)
declarations.comment: finiteness of the normalization

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.exists_iso_baseChange_normalization_adicCompletion_of_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2T (normalization commutes with completion).** For a model, over a
discrete valuation ring `R`, of a geometrically normal scheme over the fraction field of `R`, the
base change of the normalization to the completion `R^∧` is the normalization of the base change
of the model, compatibly with the two normalization morphisms.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_baseChange_normalization_adicCompletion_of_isModel {V X : Scheme.{u}}
    (v : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (hV : IsGeometricallyNormal v)
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    (e : V ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : IsModel v p e)
    (hfinX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite) :
    let ν := Scheme.normalization X hfinX
    let Rhat := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R) R
    let i : Spec (CommRingCat.of Rhat) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R) :=
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R Rhat))
    let Y : Scheme.{u} := pullback p i
    let νhat : pullback (ν ≫ p) i ⟶ Y :=
      pullback.map (ν ≫ p) i p i ν (𝟙 _) (𝟙 _) (by simp) (by simp)
    ∀ hfinY : ∀ U : Y.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set Y) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite,
      ∃ α : pullback (ν ≫ p) i ≅ Scheme.normalizationScheme Y hfinY,
        α.hom ≫ Scheme.normalization Y hfinY = νhat
declarations.comment: normalization commutes with completion

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.isNormalRing_adicCompletion_stalk_normalization_of_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2T (completions of the local rings are normal).** At every point of
the normalization of a model, over a discrete valuation ring, of a geometrically normal scheme
over the fraction field, the completion of the local ring is a normal ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormalRing_adicCompletion_stalk_normalization_of_isModel {V X : Scheme.{u}}
    (v : V ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (hV : IsGeometricallyNormal v)
    (p : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of R))
    (e : V ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : IsModel v p e)
    (hfinX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : Scheme.normalizationScheme X hfinX) :
    IsNormalRing (AdicCompletion
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((Scheme.normalizationScheme X hfinX).presheaf.stalk x))
      ((Scheme.normalizationScheme X hfinX).presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: completions of the local rings are normal

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.exists_isResolution_of_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2U (existence of a resolution).** Let `X` be a model over a discrete
valuation ring `R` of a smooth curve `C` over the fraction field `K`. Then `X` is integral and
Noetherian, and there exists a resolution of singularities of `X`.

If the special fibre of `X` is empty, `X` is its generic fibre, which is the smooth curve `C`, and
the identity is a resolution. Otherwise `X` is two-dimensional and Lipman's theorem applies, see
`exists_isResolution_of_isModel_of_topologicalKrullDim_eq_two`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isResolution_of_isModel {C X : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth c]
    [IsCurve K c] (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (e : C ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : IsModel c p e) :
    ∃ (_ : IsIntegral X) (_ : IsNoetherian X) (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X), IsResolution f
declarations.comment: existence of a resolution

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isModel_comp_of_isResolution
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2U.** A resolution of singularities of a model of a smooth curve is
again a model of that curve.
declarations.statement:
theorem isModel_comp_of_isResolution {C X Y : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth c]
    [IsCurve K c] (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [IsIntegral X] [IsNoetherian X]
    (eX : C ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : Stacks.Models.IsModel c p eX) (f : Y ⟶ X) (hf : IsResolution f) :
    ∃ eY : C ≅ pullback (f ≫ p) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))),
      Stacks.Models.IsModel c (f ≫ p) eY
declarations.comment: resolution_is_model

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isResolution_and_isModel_comp_of_isModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2U.** Let `X` be a model of a smooth curve `C` over `K`. Then `X` is
a Noetherian integral scheme, there exists a resolution of singularities of `X`, and any
resolution of singularities of `X` is a model of `C`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isResolution_and_isModel_comp_of_isModel {C X : Scheme.{u}}
    (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [Smooth c] [IsCurve K c] (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (eX : C ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))))
    (hX : Stacks.Models.IsModel c p eX) :
    ∃ (_ : IsIntegral X) (_ : IsNoetherian X),
      (∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X), IsResolution f) ∧
      ∀ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : Y ⟶ X), IsResolution f →
        ∃ eY : C ≅ pullback (f ≫ p) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K))),
          Stacks.Models.IsModel c (f ≫ p) eY

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.IsMinimalModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2V.** A *minimal model* of a smooth projective curve `C` over `K`
with `H⁰(C, 𝒪_C) = K` is a regular, proper model `X ⟶ Spec(R)` of `C` such that `X` contains no
exceptional curve of the first kind.
declarations.statement:
public structure IsMinimalModel {C X : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsCurve K c]
    [Smooth c] (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    (e : C ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))) : Prop
declarations.comment: a minimal model of a smooth projective curve

declarations.name: Stacks.Models.exists_isMinimalModel
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C2W.** Let `C` be a smooth projective curve over `K` with
`H⁰(C, 𝒪_C) = K`. A minimal model of `C` exists.

The proof is the source's: the scheme-theoretic image of `C` in a projective space over `R` is a
projective model, a resolution of its singularities is a regular proper model
(`Stacks.Models.exists_isModel_isProper_isRegular`, through [Stacks, Tag 0C2S] and
[Stacks, Tag 0C2U]), and [Stacks, Tag 0CD9] contracts it to a minimal model.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isMinimalModel {C : Scheme.{u}} (c : C ⟶ Spec (.of K)) [IsCurve K c] [Smooth c]
    (hproj : Stacks.HProjective.IsHProjective c)
    (hH0 : IsIso ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ c.appTop)) :
    ∃ (X : Scheme.{u}) (p : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
      (e : C ≅ pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R K)))),
      IsMinimalModel c p e

declarations.name: exists_isLocalization_lmul'_of_isSeparable_isAlgebraic
declarations.doc:
Stacks Tag 0C2X (Lemma 10.43.8), primary `IsLocalization` formulation.
For a separable algebraic field extension `k'/k`, equipping `k'` with the
`(k' ⊗_k k')`-algebra structure given by the multiplication map
`m = Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' k`, there is a submonoid `S ⊆ k' ⊗_k k'` such
that `k'` is the localization of `k' ⊗_k k'` at `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isLocalization_lmul'_of_isSeparable_isAlgebraic
    (k k' : Type*) [Field k] [Field k'] [Algebra k k']
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic k k'] [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] :
    letI : Algebra (k' ⊗[k] k') k' :=
      RingHom.toAlgebra (Algebra.TensorProduct.lmul' (R := k) (S := k')).toRingHom
    ∃ S : Submonoid (k' ⊗[k] k'), IsLocalization S k'

declarations.name: Algebra.isGeometricallyReduced_iff_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C2Y.** For a separable algebraic field extension `k'/k`, a `k'`-algebra is
geometrically reduced over `k` if and only if it is geometrically reduced over `k'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.isGeometricallyReduced_iff_of_isSeparable (k k' A : Type*) [Field k] [Field k']
    [CommRing A] [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k' A] [Algebra k A] [IsScalarTower k k' A]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] :
    Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k A ↔ Algebra.IsGeometricallyReduced k' A

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.exists_algEquiv_tensorProduct_strictHenselization_atPrime
declarations.doc:
**The strict henselization as a base change of the henselization** (Stacks 0C2Z). Let
`R → S` be a ring map and let `q` be a prime of `S` lying over the prime `p` of `R` such that
`κ(p) → κ(q)` is an isomorphism, and let `κ^sep` be a separable algebraic closure of
`κ(p) = κ(q)`. Let `(R_p)^h → (S_q)^h` be henselizations over `R_p → S_q` and let `(R_p)^{sh}`,
`(S_q)^{sh}` be strict henselizations with respect to `κ^sep`. Then the local map
`(R_p)^{sh} → (S_q)^{sh}` over `(R_p)^h` inducing the identity of `κ^sep` identifies
`(S_q)^{sh}` with `(S_q)^h ⊗_{(R_p)^h} (R_p)^{sh}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.exists_algEquiv_tensorProduct_strictHenselization_atPrime
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S)
    [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)]
    [Localization.AtPrime.IsLiesOverAlgebra p q]
    (hres : Function.Bijective
      (ResidueField.map (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q))))
    (ksep : Type w) [Field ksep] [Algebra (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) ksep]
    [Algebra (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) ksep]
    (hksep : ∀ a, algebraMap (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) ksep
      (ResidueField.map (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q)) a) =
        algebraMap (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) ksep a)
    (Rh : Type x) [CommRing Rh] [IsLocalRing Rh] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) Rh]
    [IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) Rh]
    (Sh : Type y) [CommRing Sh] [IsLocalRing Sh] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) Sh]
    [IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime q) (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) Sh]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) Sh] [Algebra Rh Sh]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) Rh Sh]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) Sh]
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap Rh Sh)]
    (Rsh : Type z) [CommRing Rsh] [IsLocalRing Rsh] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) Rsh]
    [Algebra Rh Rsh] [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) Rh Rsh]
    [IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime p) ksep Rsh]
    (Ssh : Type t) [CommRing Ssh] [IsLocalRing Ssh] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime q) Ssh]
    [Algebra Sh Ssh] [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime p) Ssh] [Algebra Rh Ssh]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime q) Sh Ssh]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) (Localization.AtPrime q) Ssh]
    [IsScalarTower (Localization.AtPrime p) Rh Ssh] [IsScalarTower Rh Sh Ssh]
    [IsHenselization (Localization.AtPrime q) ksep Ssh]
    (eRsh : ksep ≃+* ResidueField Rsh)
    (heRsh : ∀ a, eRsh (algebraMap (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime p)) ksep
      (residue (Localization.AtPrime p) a)) =
        residue Rsh (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime p) Rsh a))
    (eSsh : ksep ≃+* ResidueField Ssh)
    (heSsh : ∀ b, eSsh (algebraMap (ResidueField (Localization.AtPrime q)) ksep
      (residue (Localization.AtPrime q) b)) =
        residue Ssh (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime q) Ssh b)) :
    ∃ g : Rsh →ₐ[Rh] Ssh, IsLocalHom g ∧
      (∀ a, eSsh.symm (residue Ssh (g a)) = eRsh.symm (residue Rsh a)) ∧
      ∃ e : Ssh ≃ₐ[Sh] Sh ⊗[Rh] Rsh, ∀ a, e (g a) = Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight a
declarations.comment:
The equality of the source is an isomorphism of `(S_q)^h`-algebras
`Ssh ≃ₐ[Sh] Sh ⊗[Rh] Rsh` compatible with the local map `Rsh → Ssh` over `Rh` inducing the identity
of `κ^sep` (via `eRsh`, `eSsh`), which is part of the statement. Henselizations and strict
henselizations are `IsHenselization` with residue field `κ` and `κ^sep`. All seven carriers — `R`,
`S`, `κ^sep`, `(R_p)^h`, `(S_q)^h`, `(R_p)^{sh}`, `(S_q)^{sh}` — lie in mutually independent
universes.

declarations.name: Algebra.IsGeometricallyNormal.of_isSeparableExtension
declarations.doc:
A separable field extension is geometrically normal: if `K/k` is a field extension all of whose
finitely generated subextensions are separably generated (Definition 030O (2)), then `k' ⊗[k] K` is
a normal ring for every field extension `k'/k`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsGeometricallyNormal.of_isSeparableExtension {k K : Type*} [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] [IsSeparableExtension k K] : IsGeometricallyNormal k K
declarations.comment:
Separability is the source's Definition 030O (2),
  `Algebra.IsSeparableExtension`, which does not require `K/k` algebraic, and not Mathlib's
  `Algebra.IsSeparable`; the converse implication is Proposition 0322 and is not part of this tag.

declarations.name: Algebra.isGeometricallyNormal_iff_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C31.** For a separable algebraic field extension `k'/k`, a `k'`-algebra `A` is
geometrically normal over `k` if and only if it is geometrically normal over `k'`. Both directions
are tested on finite purely inseparable extensions `L` (Lemma 037Z). Over `k'`, the ring
`L ⊗[k'] A` is a localization of `L ⊗[k] A` (Lemma 0C2X). Over `k`, the ring `k' ⊗[k] L` is a field
and `L ⊗[k] A = (k' ⊗[k] L) ⊗[k'] A`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyNormal_iff_of_isSeparable (k k' A : Type*) [Field k] [Field k']
    [CommRing A] [Algebra k k'] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k' A] [IsScalarTower k k' A]
    [Algebra.IsSeparable k k'] : IsGeometricallyNormal k A ↔ IsGeometricallyNormal k' A
declarations.comment:
Separable algebraic is Mathlib's `Algebra.IsSeparable k k'`, which includes
  algebraicity; the `k`-algebra structure of `A` is the restriction of its `k'`-algebra structure.

declarations.name: Stacks.DirectLimit.FinitePresentationDescent.isIso_of_finitePresentation_colim
declarations.doc:
Let `A = colim_{i ∈ I} A_i` be a directed colimit of commutative rings, fix an index
`i₀ ∈ I`, and let `φ₀ : B₀ → C₀` be a map of `A i₀`-algebras. If the base-changed map
`φ : A ⊗_{A i₀} B₀ → A ⊗_{A i₀} C₀` is bijective and `φ₀` is of finite presentation, then there
exists an index `i ≥ i₀` such that the base-changed map
`φ_i : A_i ⊗_{A i₀} B₀ → A_i ⊗_{A i₀} C₀` is bijective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_finitePresentation_colim
    (hfp : (φ₀ : B₀ →+* C₀).FinitePresentation)
    (hφ : Function.Bijective (phiColim A f i₀ B₀ C₀ φ₀)) :
    ∃ i : ι, ∃ h : i₀ ≤ i, Function.Bijective (phiAt A f i₀ B₀ C₀ φ₀ i h)

declarations.name: Algebra.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection.exists_stage_tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C33, relative global complete intersections.** Let `A = colim_i A_i` be a directed
colimit of rings, let `0 ≤ i` be an index and `φ₀ : B₀ → C₀` a map of `A₀`-algebras with `C₀` of
finite presentation over `B₀`. If `A ⊗_{A₀} B₀ → A ⊗_{A₀} C₀` is a relative global complete
intersection, then so is `A_i ⊗_{A₀} B₀ → A_i ⊗_{A₀} C₀` for some `i ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection.exists_stage_tensorProduct
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirected ι (· ≤ ·)]
    {A : ι → Type u} [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] (a : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → A i →+* A j)
    [DirectedSystem A fun i j h => a i j h] {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (ρ : ∀ i, A i →+* R)
    (hρ : ∀ i j (h : i ≤ j) x, ρ j (a i j h x) = ρ i x) (hρs : ∀ r, ∃ i x, ρ i x = r)
    (hρz : ∀ i x, ρ i x = 0 → ∃ j, ∃ h : i ≤ j, a i j h x = 0)
    {i₀ : ι} {B₀ C₀ : Type v} [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀] [Algebra (A i₀) B₀] [Algebra (A i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[A i₀] C₀) (hfp : φ₀.FinitePresentation)
    (h : letI := (ρ i₀).toAlgebra
      letI := (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (A i₀) R) φ₀).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection (R ⊗[A i₀] B₀) (R ⊗[A i₀] C₀)) :
    ∃ i, ∃ h : i₀ ≤ i, letI := (a i₀ i h).toAlgebra
      letI := (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (A i₀) (A i)) φ₀).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsRelativeGlobalCompleteIntersection (A i ⊗[A i₀] B₀) (A i ⊗[A i₀] C₀)
declarations.comment:
The relative global complete intersection case. The colimit `A` is the ring `R`
with the cocone `ρ`, given elementwise: every element of `R` comes from a stage, and an element of
a stage dying in `R` dies at a later stage. The maps `A_i ⊗ B₀ → A_i ⊗ C₀` are
`Algebra.TensorProduct.map id φ₀`.

declarations.name: Algebra.Syntomic.exists_stage_tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C33, syntomic ring maps.** Let `A = colim_i A_i` be a directed colimit of rings,
let `0 ≤ i` be an index and `φ₀ : B₀ → C₀` a map of `A₀`-algebras with `C₀` of finite
presentation over `B₀`. If `A ⊗_{A₀} B₀ → A ⊗_{A₀} C₀` is syntomic, then so is
`A_i ⊗_{A₀} B₀ → A_i ⊗_{A₀} C₀` for some `i ≥ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem Algebra.Syntomic.exists_stage_tensorProduct
    {ι : Type*} [Preorder ι] [IsDirected ι (· ≤ ·)]
    {A : ι → Type u} [∀ i, CommRing (A i)] (a : ∀ i j, i ≤ j → A i →+* A j)
    [DirectedSystem A fun i j h => a i j h] {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (ρ : ∀ i, A i →+* R)
    (hρ : ∀ i j (h : i ≤ j) x, ρ j (a i j h x) = ρ i x) (hρs : ∀ r, ∃ i x, ρ i x = r)
    (hρz : ∀ i x, ρ i x = 0 → ∃ j, ∃ h : i ≤ j, a i j h x = 0)
    {i₀ : ι} {B₀ C₀ : Type v} [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀] [Algebra (A i₀) B₀] [Algebra (A i₀) C₀]
    (φ₀ : B₀ →ₐ[A i₀] C₀) (hfp : φ₀.FinitePresentation)
    (h : letI := (ρ i₀).toAlgebra
      letI := (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (A i₀) R) φ₀).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.Syntomic (R ⊗[A i₀] B₀) (R ⊗[A i₀] C₀)) :
    ∃ i, ∃ h : i₀ ≤ i, letI := (a i₀ i h).toAlgebra
      letI := (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (A i₀) (A i)) φ₀).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.Syntomic (A i ⊗[A i₀] B₀) (A i ⊗[A i₀] C₀)
declarations.comment:
The syntomic case, with the conventions of the relative global complete
intersection case.

declarations.name: exists_residueField_algHom_section
declarations.doc:
A complete local algebra over a field whose residue field is separable over the
base field has a coefficient field: the residue homomorphism has a section by an
algebra homomorphism.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_residueField_algHom_section
    {k : Type*} {A : Type*} [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) :
    ∃ σ : IsLocalRing.ResidueField A →ₐ[k] A,
      (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ k (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)).comp σ =
        AlgHom.id k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)

declarations.name: exists_algEquiv_mvPowerSeries_residueField
declarations.doc:
A complete regular local algebra over a field whose residue field is separable over
the base field is isomorphic, as an algebra over that field, to a multivariable formal
power series ring over its residue field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_algEquiv_mvPowerSeries_residueField
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)) :
    Nonempty
      (A ≃ₐ[k] MvPowerSeries
        (Fin (Module.finrank (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.CotangentSpace A)))
        (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A))

declarations.name: isPRing_henselization_and_strictHenselization
declarations.doc:
The henselization and strict henselization of a local `P`-ring are `P`-rings when `P` is
local on the target, ascends along regular maps, descends along faithfully flat maps, and is
preserved by separable algebraic extensions of the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPRing_henselization_and_strictHenselization
    (P : RingMapProperty.{max u (max v (max w x)), max u (max v (max w x))})
    (hB : ∀ (k R : Type (max u (max v (max w x))))
      [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum R, P (algebraMap k (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ↔
        P (algebraMap k R))
    (hC : ∀ (R S T : Type (max u (max v (max w x))))
      [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
      [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing T]
      [Module.Flat R S] [Module.Flat S T],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber S))) →
      (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum S,
        Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular q.asIdeal.ResidueField (q.asIdeal.Fiber T)) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber T)))
    (hD : ∀ (R S T : Type (max u (max v (max w x))))
      [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing T]
      [Algebra R S] [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T]
      [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsNoetherianRing S] [IsNoetherianRing T]
      [Module.Flat R S] [Module.FaithfullyFlat S T],
      (∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber T))) →
      ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R,
        P.Holds (algebraMap p.asIdeal.ResidueField (p.asIdeal.Fiber S)))
    (hE : ∀ (k K R : Type (max u (max v (max w x))))
      [Field k] [Field K] [CommRing R]
      [Algebra k K] [Algebra K R] [Algebra k R] [IsScalarTower k K R]
      [IsNoetherianRing R],
      Algebra.IsAlgebraic k K → Algebra.IsSeparable k K →
        P (algebraMap k R) → P (algebraMap K R))
    (R : Type u) (Rh : Type w) (Rsh : Type x)
    [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    [CommRing Rh] [IsLocalRing Rh] [Algebra R Rh]
    [CommRing Rsh] [IsLocalRing Rsh] [Algebra R Rsh]
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (ResidueField R) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField R) ksep]
    [IsHenselization R (ResidueField R) Rh]
    [IsHenselization R ksep Rsh]
    (hR : IsPRingAt.{u, max v (max w x), max v (max w x)} P R) :
    IsPRingAt.{w, max u (max v x), max u (max v x)} P Rh ∧
      IsPRingAt.{x, max u (max v w), max u (max v w)} P Rsh

declarations.name: numberOfBranches_characterizations
declarations.doc:
The numbers of branches and geometric branches of a local ring are infinite if the ring has
infinitely many minimal primes, and they equal one exactly for unibranch and geometrically
unibranch rings, respectively. If the ring has finitely many minimal primes, its branches are
the maximal ideals of the normalization of its reduction, with geometric branches weighted by
the separable degrees of the corresponding residue-field extensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem numberOfBranches_characterizations
    (A Ah Ash : Type u) (ksep : Type v)
    [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing Ah] [IsLocalRing Ah] [Algebra A Ah]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) Ah]
    [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [CommRing Ash] [IsLocalRing Ash] [Algebra A Ash]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash] :
    ((minimalPrimes A).Infinite →
        numberOfBranches A Ah = ⊤ ∧
          numberOfGeometricBranches A ksep Ash = ⊤) ∧
      (numberOfBranches A Ah = 1 ↔ IsUnibranch A) ∧
      (numberOfGeometricBranches A ksep Ash = 1 ↔
        IsGeometricallyUnibranch A) ∧
      ((minimalPrimes A).Finite →
        let A' := integralClosure A (FractionRing (A ⧸ nilradical A))
        numberOfBranches A Ah =
            Set.encard {m' : Ideal A' | m'.IsMaximal} ∧
          ∃ hcontract : ∀ m' : MaximalSpectrum A',
              IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A = m'.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A A'),
            numberOfGeometricBranches A ksep Ash =
              ENat.card (Σ m' : MaximalSpectrum A',
                letI : Field (A' ⧸ m'.asIdeal) := Ideal.Quotient.field m'.asIdeal
                let f := Ideal.quotientMap m'.asIdeal (algebraMap A A')
                  (le_of_eq (hcontract m'))
                letI : Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (A' ⧸ m'.asIdeal) := f.toAlgebra
                (Field.sepDegree (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A)
                  (A' ⧸ m'.asIdeal)).ord.ToType))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfBranches
declarations.doc:
The number of branches of a scheme at a point is the number of branches of its local ring at
that point.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable abbrev numberOfBranches (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (x : X) : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: number of branches

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches
declarations.doc:
The number of geometric branches of a scheme at a point is the number of geometric branches
of its local ring at that point.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable abbrev numberOfGeometricBranches
    (X : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u}) (x : X) : ℕ∞
declarations.comment: number of geometric branches

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfBranches_eq_one_iff
declarations.doc: A scheme has exactly one branch at a point if and only if it is unibranch at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfBranches_eq_one_iff (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    numberOfBranches X x = 1 ↔ IsUnibranchAt X x
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_one_iff
declarations.doc:
A scheme has exactly one geometric branch at a point if and only if it is geometrically
unibranch at that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfGeometricBranches_eq_one_iff (X : Scheme.{u}) (x : X) :
    numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 1 ↔ IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt X x
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_restrict_of_isClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3A, affineness of the immersion.** An immersion `j : Y ⟶ X` is
affine as soon as there is an open `U ⊆ X` with affine inclusion over which `j` restricts to an
affine morphism and whose complement meets the image of `j` in a closed set.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_restrict_of_isClosed {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsImmersion j] (U : X.Opens) [IsAffineHom U.ι] [IsAffineHom (j ∣_ U)]
    (hZ : IsClosed (Set.range (j : Y → X) ∩ (U : Set X)ᶜ)) : IsAffineHom j
declarations.comment: immersion is affine

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAffine_of_isAffineHom_restrict_of_isClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3A, affineness of the source.** In the situation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.isAffineHom_of_isAffineHom_restrict_of_isClosed` with an affine target, the
source of the immersion is affine.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAffine_of_isAffineHom_restrict_of_isClosed {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (j : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsImmersion j] [IsAffine X] (U : X.Opens) [IsAffineHom U.ι] [IsAffineHom (j ∣_ U)]
    (hZ : IsClosed (Set.range (j : Y → X) ∩ (U : Set X)ᶜ)) : IsAffine Y
declarations.comment: source is affine

declarations.name: Stacks.NormalizationStalkAmbient.normalizationStalkAlgEquivIntegralClosureMinimalPrimes
declarations.doc:
The stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the normalization is canonically
isomorphic, as an `𝒪_{X,x}`-algebra, to the integral closure of `𝒪_{X,x}` in the product of the
residue fields of its minimal primes.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def
    normalizationStalkAlgEquivIntegralClosureMinimalPrimes (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X hX x
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (minimalPrimeResidueFieldProduct (X.presheaf.stalk x)) :=
      (minimalPrimeResidueFieldProductHom (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toAlgebra
    normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x ≃ₐ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      integralClosure (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (minimalPrimeResidueFieldProduct (X.presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: the product of the minimal-prime residue fields

declarations.name: Stacks.NormalizationStalkAmbient.normalizationStalkAlgEquivIntegralClosureFractionRing
declarations.doc:
The stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the normalization is canonically
isomorphic, as an `𝒪_{X,x}`-algebra, to the integral closure of `𝒪_{X,x}` in the total ring of
fractions of its reduction.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def
    normalizationStalkAlgEquivIntegralClosureFractionRing (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X hX x
    letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ nilradical (X.presheaf.stalk x))) :=
      (reductionFractionRingHom (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toAlgebra
    normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x ≃ₐ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
      integralClosure (X.presheaf.stalk x)
        (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ nilradical (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
declarations.comment: the total ring of fractions of the reduction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.normalizationPushforwardStalkEquivIntegralClosureReductionFractionRing
declarations.doc:
The stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the normalization is canonically
isomorphic, as an `𝒪_{X,x}`-algebra, to the integral closure of `𝒪_{X,x}` in the total ring of
fractions of its reduction.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def
    normalizationPushforwardStalkEquivIntegralClosureReductionFractionRing
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
    letI : Algebra A (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X hX x
    letI : Algebra A (FractionRing (A ⧸ _root_.nilradical A)) :=
      (Stacks.NormalizationStalkAmbient.reductionFractionRingHom A).toAlgebra
    normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x ≃ₐ[A]
      integralClosure A (FractionRing (A ⧸ _root_.nilradical A))
declarations.comment: the total ring of fractions of the reduction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.normalizationPushforwardStalkEquivIntegralClosureMinimalPrimeResidueFields
declarations.doc:
The stalk of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the normalization is canonically
isomorphic, as an `𝒪_{X,x}`-algebra, to the integral closure of `𝒪_{X,x}` in the product of the
residue fields of its minimal primes.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def
    normalizationPushforwardStalkEquivIntegralClosureMinimalPrimeResidueFields
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (hX : ∀ U : X.Opens, IsCompact (U : Set X) → (irreducibleComponents U).Finite)
    (x : X) :
    let A := X.presheaf.stalk x
    letI (p : minimalPrimes A) : p.1.IsPrime := p.2.1.1
    letI : Algebra A (normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x) :=
      normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X hX x
    letI : Algebra A (minimalPrimes.residueFieldProduct A) :=
      (minimalPrimes.residueFieldProductHom A).toAlgebra
    normalizationPushforwardStalk X hX x ≃ₐ[A]
      integralClosure A (minimalPrimes.residueFieldProduct A)
declarations.comment: the product of the minimal-prime residue fields

declarations.name: Stacks.StalkMinimalPrimes.Basic.finite_minimalPrimes_stalk
declarations.doc:
If every quasi-compact open of `X` has finitely many irreducible components, the local
ring of `X` at `x` has only finitely many minimal primes.
declarations.comment: finiteness of the minimal primes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal_comap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3D.** Fitting ideal sheaves of finite type
quasi-coherent modules commute with arbitrary base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem fittingIdeal_comap {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Y.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (k : ℤ) :
    (fittingIdeal F k).comap f =
      fittingIdeal ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj F) k

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal_isFiniteType
declarations.doc:
The Fitting ideals of a finitely presented sheaf of modules are
quasi-coherent ideals of finite type.
declarations.statement:
lemma fittingIdeal_isFiniteType {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFinitePresentation] (r : ℕ) :
    Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsFiniteType (fittingIdealOfNat F r)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeneratedByNear_iff_fittingIdeal_stalk_eq_top
declarations.doc:
A finite type quasicoherent module is generated by `r` sections near a
point if and only if the stalk of its `r`th Fitting ideal is the unit ideal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeneratedByNear_iff_fittingIdeal_stalk_eq_top
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : ℕ) (s : X) :
    IsGeneratedByNear F r s ↔ IdealSheafData.stalk (fittingIdeal F r) s = ⊤

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_tfae_fittingIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3G.** A finite type quasicoherent module is finite
locally free of rank `r` if and only if its Fitting ideals vanish below `r`
and are the unit ideal from `r` onward.
declarations.statement:
public lemma finiteLocallyFreeOfRank_tfae_fittingIdeal
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (r : ℕ) :
    List.TFAE [
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank F r,
      (r = 0 ∨ AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal F (r - 1) = ⊥) ∧
        AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal F r = ⊤,
      (∀ k < r, AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal F k = ⊥) ∧
        (∀ k, r ≤ k → AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal F k = ⊤)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials_comap
declarations.doc:
For a cartesian square of schemes with right edge `f : X ⟶ S` locally of finite type, left
edge `f' : X' ⟶ S'` and top edge `g' : X' ⟶ X`, the inverse image along `g'` of the `r`-th
Fitting ideal sheaf of `Ω_{X/S}` is the `r`-th Fitting ideal sheaf of `Ω_{X'/S'}`: the closed
subschemes cut out by the Fitting ideals of the relative differentials commute with arbitrary
base change.
declarations.statement:
public theorem fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials_comap {X' X S' S : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (f' : X' ⟶ S') (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S) (h : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (r : ℤ) :
    (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) r).comap g' =
      fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f') r

declarations.name: Stacks.Discriminant.range_kaehlerDifferent_subschemeι
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0BVY** and **Stacks Project, Tag 0C3J.** For a morphism of schemes
`f : Y ⟶ X` locally of finite type, the closed subscheme `R ⊆ Y` cut out by the Kähler different
of `f` — equivalently, by the zeroth Fitting ideal of `Ω_{Y/X}`, which is what the Kähler
different is — has as its underlying subset of `Y` exactly the set of points at which `f` is not
unramified.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials_iff_not_smoothAt
declarations.doc:
**The nonsmooth locus is cut out by the `d`-th Fitting ideal of the relative
differentials.** For `f : X ⟶ S` flat and locally of finite presentation whose nonempty fibres
are all equidimensional of dimension `d`, a point of `X` lies in the closed subscheme defined by
the `d`-th Fitting ideal of `Ω_{X/S}` exactly when `f` is not smooth at that point.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials_iff_not_smoothAt
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ s : S, Nonempty (f.fiber s) →
      (TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional (f.fiber s) ∧
        topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞)))
    (x : X) :
    x ∈ Set.range
      (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) (d : ℤ)).subschemeι ↔
      ¬ InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt f x
declarations.comment: pointwise characterisation of the nonsmooth locus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.range_subschemeι_fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials
declarations.doc:
**The closed subscheme cut out by the `d`-th Fitting ideal of `Ω_{X/S}` is the nonsmooth
locus.** For `f : X ⟶ S` flat and locally of finite presentation whose nonempty fibres are all
equidimensional of dimension `d`, that closed subscheme has as its underlying subset of `X`
exactly the set of points at which `f` is not smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem range_subschemeι_fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (d : ℕ)
    (hd : ∀ s : S, Nonempty (f.fiber s) →
      (TopologicalSpace.Equidimensional (f.fiber s) ∧
        topologicalKrullDim (f.fiber s) = (d : WithBot ℕ∞))) :
    Set.range (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) (d : ℤ)).subschemeι =
      {x : X | ¬ InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt f x}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_syntomic_baseChange_of_syntomic_limitBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3L.**  If a locally finitely presented morphism over a stage of a
cofiltered inverse system with affine transition morphisms becomes syntomic over the limit, it
becomes syntomic at some later stage.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_syntomic_baseChange_of_syntomic_limitBaseChange {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (i₀ : I) (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj i₀)) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [IsCofiltered I] [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [CompactSpace (D.obj i₀)] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i₀)]
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left] (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hf₀ : Syntomic ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i₀)).map f₀).left) :
    ∃ (i : I) (g : i ⟶ i₀), Syntomic ((Over.pullback (D.map g)).map f₀).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isNormal_pullback_of_isSeparableExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3M.** A normal scheme over a field stays normal after base change
along a separable extension of the ground field.

Affine-locally the base change is `Spec (Γ(N, U) ⊗[k] K)`, and the ring-level statement
`IsNormalRing.tensorProduct_of_isSeparableExtension` applies.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNormal_pullback_of_isSeparableExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K] [Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k K]
    {N : Scheme.{u}} (p : N ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsNormal N] :
    IsNormal (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** The canonical morphism from the normalization after extending
the ground field to the base change of the original normalization.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def normalizationBaseChangeComparison
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (Over.pullback σ).obj X
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom := by
      dsimp [Y, σ]
      infer_instance
    let hX := finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k X.hom
    let hY := finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType K Y.hom
    Y.left.normalizationScheme hY ⟶
      ((Over.pullback σ).obj
        (Over.mk (X.left.normalization hX ≫ X.hom))).left
declarations.comment: canonical morphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_fst
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** The projection of the comparison to the original normalization
is the canonical map induced by functoriality of relative normalization.  The map on
generic-point residue spectra is over the projection `X_K ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_fst
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (Over.pullback σ).obj X
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom := by
      dsimp [Y, σ]
      infer_instance
    let hX := finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k X.hom
    let hY := finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType K Y.hom
    let fX := Scheme.fromGenericPointResidueFields X.left
    let fY := Scheme.fromGenericPointResidueFields Y.left
    letI : QuasiCompact fX := Scheme.quasiCompactFromGenericPointResidueFields X.left hX
    letI : QuasiSeparated fX := Scheme.quasiSeparatedFromGenericPointResidueFields X.left
    letI : QuasiCompact fY := Scheme.quasiCompactFromGenericPointResidueFields Y.left hY
    letI : QuasiSeparated fY := Scheme.quasiSeparatedFromGenericPointResidueFields Y.left
    ∃ (gY : Scheme.genericPointResidueSpectrum Y.left ⟶
        Scheme.genericPointResidueSpectrum X.left)
      (sq : gY ≫ fX = fY ≫ pullback.fst X.hom σ),
      normalizationBaseChangeComparison X ≫
          pullback.fst (X.left.normalization hX ≫ X.hom) σ =
        Scheme.Hom.normalizationMap fX fY gY (pullback.fst X.hom σ) sq
declarations.comment: projection to the original normalization

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** The projection of the comparison to `Spec K` is the structural
morphism of the normalized base change.  Together with the preceding projection formula, this
characterizes the map into the fibre product.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_snd
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (Over.pullback σ).obj X
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom := by
      dsimp [Y, σ]
      infer_instance
    let hX := finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType k X.hom
    normalizationBaseChangeComparison X ≫
        pullback.snd (X.left.normalization hX ≫ X.hom) σ =
      Y.left.normalization (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType K Y.hom) ≫
        Y.hom
declarations.comment: projection to the extended base field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_baseChangeNormalization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** The canonical comparison commutes with the normalization
morphisms to the base-changed scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalizationBaseChangeComparison_comp_baseChangeNormalization
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
    let Y := (Over.pullback σ).obj X
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom := by
      dsimp [Y, σ]
      infer_instance
    normalizationBaseChangeComparison X ≫ baseChangeNormalization X =
      Y.left.normalization (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_locallyOfFiniteType K Y.hom)
declarations.comment: compatibility with normalization morphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison_isUniversalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** The normalization comparison for an arbitrary extension of
fields is a universal homeomorphism.

The comparison lands in the reduction of its target (its source is reduced), and the resulting
morphism `d` is integral and birational onto a scheme whose normalization morphism is a universal
homeomorphism — because that scheme is the reduction of a base change of the *normal* scheme
`X.normalizationScheme`.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalizationBaseChangeComparison_isUniversalHomeomorphism
    (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    UniversalHomeomorphism (normalizationBaseChangeComparison (k := k) (K := K) X)
declarations.comment: universal homeomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalizationBaseChangeComparison_isIso_of_isSeparableExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3N.** For a separable extension of fields, the normalization
comparison is an isomorphism.

The target of the comparison is normal, by Tag 0C3M, so the universal property of the
normalization of `X_K` produces a two-sided inverse.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalizationBaseChangeComparison_isIso_of_isSeparableExtension
    [Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k K] (X : Over (Spec (.of k))) [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom] :
    IsIso (normalizationBaseChangeComparison (k := k) (K := K) X)
declarations.comment: separable extension

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeometricallyReducedAt_of_normalization_residueField_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
A reduced one-dimensional point is geometrically reduced if all residue fields above it in
the normalization are separable over the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyReducedAt_of_normalization_residueField_isSeparable
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X)
    (hred : _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1)
    (hsep :
      let Xnorm := normalizationSchemeOverField k f
      let ν := normalizationOverField k f
      ∀ x' : Xnorm, ν x' = x →
        letI : Algebra k (Xnorm.residueField x') :=
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (ν ≫ f).appTop ≫ Xnorm.Γevaluation x').hom.toAlgebra
        Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (Xnorm.residueField x')) :
    IsGeometricallyReducedAt f x
declarations.comment: geometrically reduced at the original point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeometricallyRegularAt_normalization_of_residueField_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
Every point of the normalization above a one-dimensional point is geometrically regular
when its residue field is separable over the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyRegularAt_normalization_of_residueField_isSeparable
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X)
    (hdim : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1)
    (hsep :
      let Xnorm := normalizationSchemeOverField k f
      let ν := normalizationOverField k f
      ∀ x' : Xnorm, ν x' = x →
        letI : Algebra k (Xnorm.residueField x') :=
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (ν ≫ f).appTop ≫ Xnorm.Γevaluation x').hom.toAlgebra
        Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (Xnorm.residueField x')) :
    let Xnorm := normalizationSchemeOverField k f
    let ν := normalizationOverField k f
    ∀ x' : Xnorm, ν x' = x → IsGeometricallyRegularAt (ν ≫ f) x'
declarations.comment: geometrically regular on the normalization

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.radical_span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_notMem_minimalPrimes
declarations.doc:
An element of the maximal ideal of a one-dimensional Noetherian local ring cuts out the
closed point exactly when it is in no minimal prime.
declarations.statement:
public lemma radical_span_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_notMem_minimalPrimes
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) {f : A} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) :
    (Ideal.span {f}).radical = maximalIdeal A ↔
      ∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes A, f ∉ p
declarations.comment: parts (1) and (2)

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_pi_localizationAtPrime
declarations.doc:
Avoiding all minimal primes is equivalent to localization away from the element being
the product of the local rings at the minimal primes.
declarations.statement:
public lemma notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_pi_localizationAtPrime
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) {f : A} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) :
    (∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes A, f ∉ p) ↔
      Nonempty (Localization.Away f ≃ₐ[A]
        (∀ p : minimalPrimes A,
          @Localization.AtPrime A _ p.1 p.2.1.1))
declarations.comment: parts (2) and (3)

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.exists_radical_span_eq_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
A one-dimensional Noetherian local ring has an element of its maximal ideal whose
principal ideal has radical equal to the maximal ideal.
declarations.statement:
public lemma exists_radical_span_eq_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    ∃ f ∈ maximalIdeal A, (Ideal.span {f}).radical = maximalIdeal A
declarations.comment: existence

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_depth_eq_one
declarations.doc:
At depth one, the elements avoiding all minimal primes are precisely the
nonzerodivisors.
declarations.statement:
public lemma notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_depth_eq_one
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (hdepth : Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A = 1) (f : A) :
    (∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes A, f ∉ p) ↔ f ∈ nonZeroDivisors A
declarations.comment: part (4)

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_fractionRing_of_depth_eq_one
declarations.doc:
At depth one, avoiding all minimal primes is equivalent to localization away from the
element being the total ring of fractions.
declarations.statement:
public lemma notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_fractionRing_of_depth_eq_one
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) (hdepth : Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A = 1)
    {f : A} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) :
    (∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes A, f ∉ p) ↔
      Nonempty (Localization.Away f ≃ₐ[A] FractionRing A)
declarations.comment: part (5)

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.depth_eq_one_of_isReduced
declarations.doc: A reduced one-dimensional Noetherian local ring has depth one.
declarations.statement:
public lemma depth_eq_one_of_isReduced
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A = 1
declarations.comment: reduced rings have depth one

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_pi_residueField_of_isReduced
declarations.doc:
In a reduced one-dimensional Noetherian local ring, avoiding all minimal primes is
equivalent to localization away from the element being the product of the residue fields at
the minimal primes.
declarations.statement:
public lemma notMem_minimalPrimes_iff_localizationAway_equiv_pi_residueField_of_isReduced
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) {f : A} (hf : f ∈ maximalIdeal A) :
    (∀ p ∈ minimalPrimes A, f ∉ p) ↔
      Nonempty (Localization.Away f ≃ₐ[A]
        (∀ p : minimalPrimes A, @Ideal.ResidueField A _ p.1 p.2.1.1))
declarations.comment: part (6)

declarations.name: isNormalRing_integralClosure_fractionRing
declarations.doc:
The integral closure of a reduced Noetherian ring in its total ring of fractions is a
normal ring.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isNormalRing_integralClosure_fractionRing
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsReduced A] :
    IsNormalRing ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))
declarations.comment: normality

declarations.name: module_finite_integralClosure_fractionRing
declarations.doc:
The integral closure of a reduced Nagata ring in its total ring of fractions is finite over
the original ring.
declarations.statement:
public lemma module_finite_integralClosure_fractionRing
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) :
    Module.Finite A ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))
declarations.comment: finiteness

declarations.name: isNagataRing_integralClosure_fractionRing
declarations.doc: The integral closure of a reduced Nagata ring in its total ring of fractions is Nagata.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isNagataRing_integralClosure_fractionRing
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) :
    IsNagataRing ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))
declarations.comment: Nagata

declarations.name: isFiniteLength_integralClosure_quotient
declarations.doc:
For a reduced one-dimensional Nagata local ring, the quotient of its integral closure in
the total ring of fractions by the original ring has finite length.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isFiniteLength_integralClosure_quotient
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    IsFiniteLength A
      (↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A)) ⧸
        LinearMap.range (Algebra.linearMap A ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))))
declarations.comment: finite length

declarations.name: Ring.deltaInvariant
declarations.doc:
The delta invariant of a commutative ring is the length of the quotient of its integral
closure in its total ring of fractions by the image of the ring.  For a reduced
one-dimensional Nagata local ring, this quotient has finite length.
declarations.statement: public noncomputable abbrev Ring.deltaInvariant (A : Type*) [CommRing A] : ℕ∞

declarations.name: Ring.deltaInvariant_eq_zero_iff_isDiscreteValuationRing
declarations.doc:
A reduced one-dimensional Nagata local ring has delta invariant zero if and only if it is a
discrete valuation ring.
declarations.statement:
public lemma deltaInvariant_eq_zero_iff_isDiscreteValuationRing
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    deltaInvariant A = 0 ↔ ∃ _ : IsDomain A, IsDiscreteValuationRing A

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.isReduced_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal_of_isNagataRing
declarations.doc: The maximal-ideal-adic completion of a reduced Nagata local ring is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isReduced_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal_of_isNagataRing
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) : IsReduced (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
declarations.comment: completion_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.isNagataRing_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc: The maximal-ideal-adic completion of a Noetherian local ring is a Nagata ring.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNagataRing_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    IsNagataRing (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A)
declarations.comment: completion_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.ringKrullDim_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc: Completion of a Noetherian local ring at its maximal ideal preserves Krull dimension.
declarations.statement:
public theorem ringKrullDim_adicCompletion_maximalIdeal
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] :
    ringKrullDim (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A) = ringKrullDim A
declarations.comment: completion_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isReduced
declarations.doc: The henselization of a reduced local ring is reduced.
declarations.statement: public lemma isReduced [IsReduced A] : IsReduced Ah
declarations.comment: henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.isNagataRing
declarations.doc: The henselization of a Nagata local ring is Nagata.
declarations.statement: public lemma isNagataRing (hNagata : IsNagataRing A) : IsNagataRing Ah
declarations.comment: henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.IsHenselization.ringKrullDim_eq
declarations.doc: Henselization preserves the Krull dimension of a local ring.
declarations.statement: public lemma ringKrullDim_eq : ringKrullDim Ah = ringKrullDim A
declarations.comment: henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.strictHenselization_isReduced
declarations.doc: A strict henselization of a reduced local ring is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public lemma strictHenselization_isReduced
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash] [IsReduced A] : IsReduced Ash
declarations.comment: strict_henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.strictHenselization_isNagataRing
declarations.doc: A strict henselization of a Nagata local ring is Nagata.
declarations.statement:
public lemma strictHenselization_isNagataRing
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) : IsNagataRing Ash
declarations.comment: strict_henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.strictHenselization_ringKrullDim
declarations.doc:
A local ring and a strict henselization of it have the same Krull
dimension.
declarations.statement:
public lemma strictHenselization_ringKrullDim
    (ksep : Type v) [Field ksep] [Algebra (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsSepClosure (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) ksep]
    [IsLocalRing.IsHenselization A ksep Ash] : ringKrullDim Ash = ringKrullDim A
declarations.comment: strict_henselization_properties

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.exists_fractionRing_map_and_tensorProduct_range_eq_integralClosure_completion
declarations.doc:
The base change to the completion of the integral closure of a reduced one-dimensional
Nagata local ring in its total ring of fractions is the integral closure of the completion in its
total ring of fractions.
declarations.statement:
public lemma exists_fractionRing_map_and_tensorProduct_range_eq_integralClosure_completion
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsReduced A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 1) :
    let B := AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal A) A
    ∃ q : FractionRing A →ₐ[A] FractionRing B,
      ∃ g : (integralClosure A (FractionRing A) ⊗[A] B) →ₐ[A] FractionRing B,
        Function.Injective g ∧
          g.range = (integralClosure B (FractionRing B)).restrictScalars A ∧
          g.comp
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeft :
                integralClosure A (FractionRing A) →ₐ[A]
                  (integralClosure A (FractionRing A) ⊗[A] B)) =
            q.comp (integralClosure A (FractionRing A)).val ∧
          g.comp
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
                B →ₐ[A] (integralClosure A (FractionRing A) ⊗[A] B)) =
            IsScalarTower.toAlgHom A B (FractionRing B)
declarations.comment: completion_integral_closure

declarations.name: IsLocalRing.tensorProduct_integralClosure_isIntegralClosure_strictHenselization

            integralClosure A (FractionRing A) →ₐ[A]
              (integralClosure A (FractionRing A) ⊗[A] Ash)) =
              q.comp (integralClosure A (FractionRing A)).val ∧
          g.comp (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight :
            Ash →ₐ[A] (integralClosure A (FractionRing A) ⊗[A] Ash)) =

declarations.comment: strict_henselization_integral_closure

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_mul_length_quotient_le_of_flat_local_hom
declarations.doc:
**The delta invariant under a flat local homomorphism, with the length of the closed fibre
as a factor.** For a flat local homomorphism `f : A → B` of local rings, the delta invariant of
`A` times the length of `B / 𝔪_A B` is at most the delta invariant of `B`.

The base change `B ⊗[A] (A'/A)` injects into `B'/B`, so its length bounds `δ(B)`; the length of
a base change along a flat local homomorphism is the length of the module times the length of
the closed fibre (`length_baseChange_eq_length_mul_length_quotient`, Tag 02M1), which is the
left-hand side.  Dropping the factor — it is at least one — gives Tag 0C3X itself,
`AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_le_of_flat_local_hom`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma deltaInvariant_mul_length_quotient_le_of_flat_local_hom
    (A B : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) (hlocal : IsLocalHom f) (hflat : f.Flat) :
    Ring.deltaInvariant A *
        Module.length B (B ⧸ Ideal.map f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)) ≤
      Ring.deltaInvariant B
declarations.comment: sharpened by the length of the closed fibre: the source states the inequality without that factor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_stalk_le_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C3X.** The delta invariant of a scheme locally of finite type over a
field at a point cannot decrease under an extension of the ground field.
declarations.statement:
public lemma deltaInvariant_stalk_le_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) y = x) :
    Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) ≤
      Ring.deltaInvariant
        ((pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_mul_length_specialFibre_stalk_le_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**The delta invariant of a stalk under extension of the ground field, with the length of the
special fibre as a factor.** The delta invariant at `x` times the length of the quotient of the
local ring at a point `y` above `x` by the extension of the maximal ideal at `x` is at most the
delta invariant at `y`.

Dropping the factor — it is at least one — gives Stacks Tag 0C3X itself,
`AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_stalk_le_baseChange`.  Keeping it turns a delta invariant
that does not grow into a bound on the special fibre: when both delta invariants equal one the
quotient has length one, so the maximal ideal at `x` already generates the maximal ideal
at `y`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma deltaInvariant_mul_length_specialFibre_stalk_le_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    Ring.deltaInvariant
        (X.presheaf.stalk
          ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)) *
        Module.length
          ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :
            Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)
          ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :
              Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y ⧸
            Ideal.map
              ((pullback.fst f
                (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y).hom
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
                (X.presheaf.stalk
                  ((pullback.fst f
                    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)))) ≤
      Ring.deltaInvariant
        ((pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)
declarations.comment: sharpened by the length of the special fibre of the map on local rings: the source states the inequality without that factor

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.deltaInvariant_stalk_baseChange
declarations.doc:
The delta invariant of a reduced one-dimensional point whose normalization has separable
residue fields is unchanged at any one-dimensional point above it after extending the field.
declarations.statement:
public lemma deltaInvariant_stalk_baseChange
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) y = x)
    (hred : _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x))
    (hdimX : ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1)
    (hsep :
      let Xnorm := normalizationSchemeOverField k f
      let ν := normalizationOverField k f
      ∀ x' : Xnorm, ν x' = x →
        letI : Algebra k (Xnorm.residueField x') :=
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (ν ≫ f).appTop ≫ Xnorm.Γevaluation x').hom.toAlgebra
        Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (Xnorm.residueField x'))
    (hdimY : ringKrullDim
      ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)
        = 1) :
    Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) =
      Ring.deltaInvariant
        ((pullback f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches_baseChange_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
The number of geometric branches at a point of a scheme locally of finite type over a field
is unchanged after extending the ground field and choosing a point above it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem numberOfGeometricBranches_baseChange_fieldExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x =
      AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches
        (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}) y

declarations.name: Ring.exists_isWedge_of_deltaInvariant_eq_numberOfGeometricBranches_sub_one
declarations.doc:
A strictly henselian, reduced, one-dimensional Nagata local ring attaining the lower bound
for its delta invariant is a wedge of a nonempty finite family of strictly henselian discrete

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.normalization_of_isLocallyNoetherian_dimension_one
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C45.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian scheme of dimension `1` and
let `ν : X^ν → X` be its normalization. Then

1. `ν` is integral, surjective, and induces a bijection on irreducible components,
2. there is a factorization `X^ν → X_red → X` and the morphism `X^ν → X_red` is the
   normalization of `X_red`,
3. `X^ν → X_red` is birational,
4. for every closed point `x ∈ X` the stalk `(ν_* 𝒪_{X^ν})_x` is the integral closure of
   `𝒪_{X,x}` in the total ring of fractions of `(𝒪_{X,x})_red = 𝒪_{X_red,x}`,
5. the fibres of `ν` are finite and the residue field extensions are finite,
6. `X^ν` is a disjoint union of integral normal locally Noetherian schemes and each affine open
   is the spectrum of a finite product of Dedekind domains.
declarations.statement:
theorem normalization_of_isLocallyNoetherian_dimension_one (X : Scheme.{u})
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) :
    -- (1)
    (IsIntegralHom X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian ∧
        Surjective X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian ∧
        Set.BijOn (fun C ↦ closure (X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian.base '' C))
          (irreducibleComponents X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian)
          (irreducibleComponents X)) ∧
      -- (2) and (3)
      (∃ g : X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian ⟶ X.nilradical.subscheme,
        g ≫ X.nilradical.subschemeι = X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian ∧
          IsBirational g ∧
          ∃ e : X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian ≅
            X.nilradical.subscheme.normalizationScheme
              (X.finite_irreducibleComponents_reduction
                (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isCompact X)),
            e.hom ≫ X.nilradical.subscheme.normalization
              (X.finite_irreducibleComponents_reduction
                (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isCompact X)) = g) ∧
      -- (4)
      (∀ x : X, IsClosed ({x} : Set X) →
        letI := normalizationPushforwardStalkAlgebra X
          (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isCompact X) x
        letI : Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ nilradical (X.presheaf.stalk x))) :=
          (reductionFractionRingHom (X.presheaf.stalk x)).toAlgebra
        Nonempty (normalizationPushforwardStalk X
              (finite_irreducibleComponents_of_isCompact X) x ≃ₐ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
            integralClosure (X.presheaf.stalk x)
              (FractionRing (X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ nilradical (X.presheaf.stalk x)))) ∧
          ∀ z : X.nilradical.subscheme, X.nilradical.subschemeι z = x →
            Nonempty ((X.presheaf.stalk x ⧸ nilradical (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ≃+*
              X.nilradical.subscheme.presheaf.stalk z)) ∧
      -- (5)
      ((∀ x : X, (X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian.base ⁻¹' {x}).Finite) ∧
        ∀ y : X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian,
          (X.normalizationOfIsLocallyNoetherian.residueFieldMap y).hom.Finite) ∧
      -- (6)
      ((∃ (ι : Type u) (Y : ι → Scheme.{u}) (_ : ∀ i, IsIntegral (Y i))
          (_ : ∀ i, IsNormal (Y i)) (_ : ∀ i, IsLocallyNoetherian (Y i)),
          Nonempty (X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian ≅ ∐ Y)) ∧
        ∀ W : X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian.Opens, IsAffineOpen W →
          Stacks.IsFiniteProductOfDedekindDomains
            Γ(X.normalizationSchemeOfIsLocallyNoetherian, W))

declarations.name: IsRegularLocalRing.eq_bot_or_eq_maximalIdeal_or_eq_span_singleton_of_quotient_isReduced
declarations.doc:
An ideal with reduced quotient in a two-dimensional regular local ring is
zero, maximal, or generated by a nonzero element of the maximal ideal.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_bot_or_eq_maximalIdeal_or_eq_span_singleton_of_quotient_isReduced
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2)
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) [IsReduced (A ⧸ I)] :
      I = ⊥ ∨ I = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∨
      ∃ f : A, f ≠ 0 ∧ f ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ∧ I = Ideal.span {f}

declarations.name: IsRegularLocalRing.exists_ne_zero_mem_maximalIdeal_and_eq_span_singleton_of_quotient_depth_eq_one

An ideal in a two-dimensional regular local ring whose quotient has
depth one is generated by a nonzero element of the maximal ideal.

    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsRegularLocalRing A] (hdim : ringKrullDim A = 2)
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I ≤ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A)
    (hdepth : Module.depth A (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (A ⧸ I) = 1) :

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a Noetherian local algebra over a field, the following are equivalent: it is reduced with
a nondegenerate quadratic relation on its two-dimensional cotangent space; it has depth one with
the same relation; and its completion is a two-variable power-series hypersurface defined by a
nondegenerate quadratic form. In all three conditions the residue-field extension is
separable.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNodalAlgebra_tfae (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A]
    [IsLocalRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [Algebra k A] :
    List.TFAE [
      IsNodalAlgebra k A,
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (ResidueField A) ∧
        Module.depth A (maximalIdeal A) A = 1 ∧ HasNodalQuadraticRelation A,
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (ResidueField A) ∧ HasNodalCompletion k A]

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.encard_maximalSpectrum_integralClosure_fractionRing_eq_one_or_two
declarations.doc:
**The normalization of a nodal Nagata local algebra in its total ring of fractions has one
or two maximal ideals.**
declarations.statement:
public theorem encard_maximalSpectrum_integralClosure_fractionRing_eq_one_or_two
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) (hNodal : IsNodalAlgebra k A) :
    Set.encard (Set.univ : Set (MaximalSpectrum ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A)))) = 1 ∨
      Set.encard
        (Set.univ : Set (MaximalSpectrum ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A)))) = 2
declarations.comment: number of maximal ideals

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_iff_deltaInvariant_eq_one_and_two_geometricBranches
declarations.doc:
A Nagata local algebra over a field is nodal if and only if it is reduced
and one-dimensional, its residue field is separable, its delta invariant is one, and it has two
geometric branches.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isNodalAlgebra_iff_deltaInvariant_eq_one_and_two_geometricBranches
    (k : Type u) (A : Type v) [Field k] [CommRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (hA : IsNagataRing A) :
    IsNodalAlgebra k A ↔
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (ResidueField A) ∧
        IsReduced A ∧
        ringKrullDim A = 1 ∧
        Ring.deltaInvariant A = 1 ∧
        numberOfGeometricBranchesOfLocalRing A = 2
declarations.comment: equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_integralClosure_fractionRing
declarations.doc:
**The residue field at every maximal ideal of the normalization of a nodal Nagata local

declarations.statement:

    (m : MaximalSpectrum ↥(integralClosure A (FractionRing A))) :
    Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k m.asIdeal.ResidueField
declarations.comment: residue field extensions

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.jacobianMinorIdealModulo_eq
declarations.doc:
The ideal of Jacobian minors in a quotient of a finite-variable formal power-series
ring is independent of both the finite family generating the defining ideal and the
regular system of parameters used to form the Jacobian matrix.
declarations.statement:
theorem jacobianMinorIdealModulo_eq {n m l : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))
    (f : Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k) (g : Fin l → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I) (hg : Ideal.span (Set.range g) = I)
    (y : Fin n → IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))
    (hy : IsRegularSystemOfParameters y) (r : ℕ) :
    jacobianMinorIdealModulo I f r = jacobianMinorIdealModuloInParameters I y hy g r

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_jacobianMinorIdeal_tfae
declarations.doc:
**The Jacobian criterion for a node.** A quotient of a finite-variable formal power-series
ring by equations in its maximal ideal is nodal if and only if it is reduced (equivalently, has
depth one) and its next-to-maximal Jacobian minors generate the maximal ideal.

The Jacobian-minor ideal is the one of Tag 0C4B
(`Stacks.Curves.jacobianMinorIdealModulo`). The source states the Jacobian condition as the
minors generating `I + 𝔪_A` in the power-series ring; the equivalent intrinsic equality between
their image and the maximal ideal of the quotient is used here, and the depth condition is
likewise written over the quotient ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNodalAlgebra_jacobianMinorIdeal_tfae (k : Type u) [Field k] {n m : ℕ}
    (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k))
    (f : Fin m → MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)
    (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (hI : I ≤ maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)) :
    letI : Nontrivial (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I) :=
      Ideal.Quotient.nontrivial_iff.mpr
        (ne_top_of_le_ne_top
          (maximalIdeal.isMaximal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k)).ne_top hI)
    letI : IsLocalRing (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I) :=
      IsLocalRing.of_surjective' (Ideal.Quotient.mk I) Ideal.Quotient.mk_surjective
    List.TFAE [
      IsNodalAlgebra k (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I),
      IsReduced (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I) ∧
        jacobianMinorIdealModulo I f (n - 1) =
          maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I),
      Module.depth (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I)
          (maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I))
          (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I) = 1 ∧
        jacobianMinorIdealModulo I f (n - 1) =
          maximalIdeal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) k ⧸ I)]

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isClosed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4D.** Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a one-dimensional scheme
locally of finite type over `k` and let `x` be a closed point of `X`. The following are
equivalent.

1. `x` is a node.
2. `𝒪_{X,x}` is a nodal `k`-algebra.
3. Every point of `X_{k̄}` above `x` is an ordinary double point.
4. `κ(x)/k` is separable, `𝒪_{X,x}` is reduced, and the stalk at `x` of the first Fitting ideal
   sheaf of `Ω_{X/k}` is the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X,x}`.
5. The same with reducedness replaced by depth one.
6. `κ(x)/k` is separable and `𝒪_{X,x}` is reduced of delta invariant one with two geometric
   branches.

Each of the six conditions implies that `κ(x)/k` is separable: conditions (2), (4), (5) and (6)
say so outright, and conditions (1) and (3) by
`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode`. Under that separability the six are
equivalent by
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_and_isNode_of_depth_of_isSeparableExtension`, which supplies the two
Fitting-ideal equivalences that
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_fittingIdeal_equivalence` leaves open; so the cycle of
implications `1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 1` may be run with the separability of its source clause
in hand.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_tfae_of_isClosed
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    let f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k) := X ↘ Spec (.of k)
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    let fittingCondition : Prop :=
      IdealSheafData.stalk (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) (1 : ℤ)) x =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₁ : Prop := IsNode k X x
    let c₂ : Prop := IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₃ : Prop :=
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : Spec (.of K) ⟶ Spec (.of k) := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar)
    let c₄ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ fittingCondition
    let c₅ : Prop :=
