      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x) (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
          fittingCondition
    let c₆ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2
    List.TFAE [c₁, c₂, c₃, c₄, c₅, c₆]

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_isReduced_and_stalk_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Conditions (2) and (4) of Tag 0C4D are equivalent.** The local ring at a closed point `x`
is a nodal algebra over a base field `k` exactly when its residue field is separable over `k`, it
is reduced, and the stalk at `x` of the first Fitting ideal sheaf of `Ω_{X/S}` is its maximal
ideal.

The two conditions share their separability and reducedness clauses; what is proved here is that
the nodal quadratic relation on `𝒪_{X,x}` is the Fitting-ideal condition, which is
`Stacks.Curves.stalk_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_hasNodalQuadraticRelation`. The base field
`k` is not required to be the base of the morphism: no clause of either condition relates the two
beyond the `k`-algebra structure on `𝒪_{X,x}`, which is an argument.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_isReduced_and_stalk_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (x : X)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (hxU : x ∈ U.1) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    {V : S.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (hUV : (U : X.Opens) ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    [IsNoetherianRing Γ(S, V)] (K : Type u) [Field K] (e : Γ(S, V) ≃+* K)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x)] :
    letI := Stacks.Smooth.algebraAppLE f hUV
    ∀ {n m : ℕ} (P : Algebra.Presentation Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U.1) (Fin n) (Fin m))
      (_hv : ∀ i, P.val i ∈ (U.2.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hxU⟩).asIdeal),
      (IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
        Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
          IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
            IdealSheafData.stalk (fittingIdeal (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials f) (1 : ℤ)) x =
              maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: clauses (2) and (4), at a closed point of an affine chart admitting a presentation centred there

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_rational
declarations.doc:
**All six conditions of Stacks Tag 0C4D are equivalent at a rational closed point.**

Let `k` be a field, let `X` be a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over `k` and let
`x` be a closed point of `X` whose residue field is `k` itself — the hypothesis `hrat` says that
the structure map `k → κ(x)` is surjective.  Then the six conditions of the tag are equivalent,
with no further hypothesis.

The two equivalences that `Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_fittingIdeal_equivalence` leaves open are
discharged by
`Stacks.Curves.stalk_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal_iff_hasNodalQuadraticRelation_of_rational`,
which turns the Fitting-ideal condition into the nodal quadratic relation: condition (1) becomes
condition (4) through condition (2), and condition (5) becomes condition (4) because the exchange
of depth one for reducedness in the presence of the nodal relation is Stacks Tag 0C49.

What keeps this short of the tag is only the rationality of `κ(x)`: a presentation of an affine
chart whose generators vanish at `x` exists exactly then, since generators lying in the prime of
`x` generate `κ(x)` over `k` by zero.

A general closed point has `κ(x) / k` finite and, by
`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode` and the separability clause of
conditions (2), (4), (5) and (6), separable in every case that matters.  Reducing it to the
rational case asks only for the Fitting-ideal condition to descend along the base change to the
algebraic closure: Tag 0C3I
(`AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal_relativeDifferentials_comap`) together with
`AlgebraicGeometry.IdealSheafData.stalk_comap` makes the stalk of the Fitting ideal upstairs the
extension of the stalk downstairs, Tag 0C50
(`AlgebraicGeometry.map_maximalIdeal_stalkMap_eq_of_isReduced_tensorProduct`) makes the maximal
ideal upstairs the extension of the maximal ideal downstairs, and faithful flatness of the stalk
map retracts the extension of ideals.  That descent is carried out in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Curves.NodeFittingIdealClosedPoint`, where
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isClosed` states the six conditions at an arbitrary closed point;
it also needs reducedness and depth one to cross between the two points, and they cross in
opposite directions.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_tfae_of_rational
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X))
    (hrat : Function.Surjective ((X.residue x).hom.comp
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom)) :
    let f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) := X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    let omega := f.relativeDifferentials
    let fittingCondition : Prop :=
      AlgebraicGeometry.IdealSheafData.stalk (AlgebraicGeometry.fittingIdeal omega 1) x =
        maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₁ : Prop := IsNode k X x
    let c₂ : Prop := IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₃ : Prop :=
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) :=
         AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) := CategoryTheory.Limits.pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar)
    let c₄ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧ fittingCondition
    let c₅ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x) (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
          fittingCondition
    let c₆ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2
    List.TFAE [c₁, c₂, c₃, c₄, c₅, c₆]
declarations.comment: all six clauses, at a closed point whose residue field is the base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_one_and_depth_eq_one_of_isNode
declarations.doc:
**The local ring at a node of a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over an
arbitrary field is one-dimensional of depth one.**

The depth assertion is the depth clause of condition (5) of Stacks Tag 0C4D, derived from
condition (1) over an arbitrary field; no separability of the residue field extension is used or
asserted.
declarations.statement:
theorem ringKrullDim_stalk_eq_one_and_depth_eq_one_of_isNode
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hnode : IsNode k X x) :
    ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
      Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x) (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
        (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1
declarations.comment: the dimension and the depth of the local ring at a node, over an arbitrary base field: the depth clause of condition (5), from condition (1)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_isSeparableExtension_of_isNode
declarations.doc:
**At a node of a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over an arbitrary field, the
local ring is a nodal `k`-algebra exactly when the residue field extension is separable.**

This is the whole of the gap between conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks Tag 0C4D over an arbitrary
field: the implication from (1) to (2) holds as soon as `κ(x)/k` is separable, and separability
is itself one of the clauses of (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_isSeparableExtension_of_isNode
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hnode : IsNode k X x) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    (IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x))
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2) over an arbitrary base field, at a point already known to be a node: the nodal-algebra condition on the local ring is exactly separability of the residue field extension

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_isNodalAlgebra_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Condition (2) of Stacks Tag 0C4D implies condition (1), over an arbitrary field.**

If the local ring at a point of a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over `k` is a
nodal `k`-algebra, then the point is a node.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_of_isNodalAlgebra_stalk
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom.toAlgebra
    IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) → IsNode k X x
declarations.comment: clause (2) implies clause (1), over an arbitrary base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk_of_isSeparableExtension
declarations.doc:
**Conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks Tag 0C4D agree at a point whose residue field is
separable over the base field.**

Separability of `κ(x)/k` is a clause of condition (2); it is assumed here, and discharged in
`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode`, which makes
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk` the unconditional equivalence.  Everything else
is proved: condition (1) with separability gives condition (2) by
`Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_stalk_of_isNode_of_isSeparableExtension`, and condition (2) gives
condition (1) by `Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_isNodalAlgebra_stalk`, over an arbitrary field.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk_of_isSeparableExtension
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) →
      (IsNode k X x ↔ IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2), at a point whose residue field is separable over the base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isSeparableExtension_residueField
declarations.doc:
**The four conditions of Stacks Tag 0C4D that do not mention the Fitting ideal are
equivalent, over an arbitrary field, at a point whose residue field is separable over the base
field.**

Conditions (1), (2), (3) and (6) of the tag.  The hypothesis `c₂ → c₁` of
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isSeparableExtension` is discharged by
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_isNodalAlgebra_stalk`; what remains assumed is separability of
`κ(x)/k`, which is a clause of conditions (2), (4), (5) and (6).  That hypothesis is discharged
in `Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae`, the same equivalence with no hypothesis beyond closedness of the
point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_tfae_of_isSeparableExtension_residueField
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    let f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) := X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    let c₁ : Prop := IsNode k X x
    let c₂ : Prop := IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₃ : Prop :=
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) :=
         AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar)
    let c₆ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2
    Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) → List.TFAE [c₁, c₂, c₃, c₆]
declarations.comment: clauses (1), (2), (3) and (6), at a point whose residue field is separable over the base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode
declarations.doc:
**The residue field at a node is separable over the base field.**

This is the clause of conditions (2), (4), (5) and (6) of Stacks Tag 0C4D that conditions (1)
and (3) do not display, and the source obtains it from the closed subscheme cut out by the first
Fitting ideal of `Ω_{X/k}`.  The route here is different and stays inside the delta invariant.

Base change to `k^{1/p}`.  At a node the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X,x}` generates the maximal ideal
upstairs (`Stacks.Curves.isField_specialFibre_of_isNode`), so the special fibre of the map on
local rings is a field.  That special fibre is the localization of `κ(x) ⊗_k k^{1/p}` at the
prime cut out by the chosen point (Stacks Tag 0C4Y), so a nonzero reduced *flat* algebra over
`κ(x) ⊗_k k^{1/p}` exists, which forces `κ(x) ⊗_k k^{1/p}` itself to be reduced — every element
of it is a unit or nilpotent, so its maximal ideal acts as zero and flatness upgrades to
faithful flatness.  Reducedness of `κ(x) ⊗_k k^{1/p}` is separability of `κ(x)/k` by Stacks
Tag 030W.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    IsNode k X x → Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x)
declarations.comment: the separability of the residue field extension, from condition (1), over an arbitrary base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk
declarations.doc:
**Conditions (1) and (2) of Stacks Tag 0C4D agree over an arbitrary field.**

A point of a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over `k` is a node exactly when its
local ring is a nodal `k`-algebra.  Separability of `κ(x)/k`, the one clause of condition (2)
that condition (1) does not display, is supplied by
`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    (IsNode k X x ↔ IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x))
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (2), over an arbitrary base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae
declarations.doc:
**The four conditions of Stacks Tag 0C4D that do not mention the first Fitting ideal are
equivalent over an arbitrary field.**

Conditions (1), (2), (3) and (6) of the tag, at a closed point of a one-dimensional scheme
locally of finite type over an arbitrary field, with no hypothesis beyond closedness of the
point.  Each of the four implies that `κ(x)/k` is separable — conditions (2) and (6) say so
outright, and conditions (1) and (3) by
`Stacks.Curves.isSeparableExtension_residueField_of_isNode` — and under that separability the
four are already known to be equivalent.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_tfae
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    let f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) := X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    let c₁ : Prop := IsNode k X x
    let c₂ : Prop := IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x)
    let c₃ : Prop :=
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) :=
         AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar)
    let c₆ : Prop :=
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        _root_.IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2
    List.TFAE [c₁, c₂, c₃, c₆]
declarations.comment: clauses (1), (2), (3) and (6), over an arbitrary base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_deltaInvariant_eq_one_and_two_geometricBranches
declarations.doc:
**The local ring at a point of a one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over a field is
a nodal algebra if and only if the residue field is separable, the local ring is reduced, its
delta invariant is one and it has two geometric branches.**

This is the equivalence of conditions (2) and (6) of Stacks Tag 0C4D.  Its content is the
algebraic equivalence of Stacks Tag 0C4A, whose two further hypotheses are discharged here: the
local ring is Nagata because the scheme is locally of finite type over a field, and it is
one-dimensional because its dimension is at most that of the scheme while a reduced local ring of
delta invariant one is not a field.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNodalAlgebra_stalk_iff_deltaInvariant_eq_one_and_two_geometricBranches
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ (X ↘ Spec (.of k)).appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    (IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) ↔
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2)
declarations.comment: clauses (2) and (6)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_forall_isOrdinaryDoublePoint
declarations.doc:
**A closed point of a scheme locally of finite type over an arbitrary field is a node
exactly when every point of the base change to the algebraic closure above it is an ordinary
double point.**

This is the equivalence of conditions (1) and (3) of Stacks Tag 0C4D, over an arbitrary field.
The definition of a node asks only that *some* point above `x` be an ordinary double point; the
two agree because the automorphisms of the algebraic closure act transitively on the points
above `x`, which is `Stacks.Curves.forall_isOrdinaryDoublePoint_of_isNode`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_iff_forall_isOrdinaryDoublePoint
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))] (x : X)
    (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    let f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) := X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)
    (IsNode k X x ↔
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) :=
         AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar))
declarations.comment: clauses (1) and (3)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isAlgClosed
declarations.doc:
**The four conditions of Stacks Tag 0C4D that do not mention the Fitting ideal are
equivalent over an algebraically closed field.**

Conditions (1), (2), (3) and (6) of the tag.  The equivalence of (1) and (2) over an
algebraically closed field is
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk_of_isAlgClosed`, which is the only hypothesis of
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_tfae_of_isAlgClosed
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hX : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    let f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) := X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫
        X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom
    letI : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x) := kToStalk.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) :=
      ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
    List.TFAE [
      IsNode k X x,
      IsNodalAlgebra k (X.presheaf.stalk x),
      (let K := AlgebraicClosure k
       let g : AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k) :=
         AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))
       let Y := (pullback f g : Scheme.{u})
       let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f g
       let q : Y ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f g
       letI : Y.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) := ⟨q⟩
       ∀ xbar : Y, p.base xbar = x → IsOrdinaryDoublePoint K Y xbar),
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x) ∧
        IsReduced (X.presheaf.stalk x) ∧
          Ring.deltaInvariant (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            AlgebraicGeometry.numberOfGeometricBranches X x = 2]
declarations.comment: clauses (1), (2), (3) and (6), for an algebraically closed base field

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_iff_lci_and_unramified_relativeSingularIdeal
declarations.doc: **Stacks Project, Tag 0C4E.**
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_iff_lci_and_unramified_relativeSingularIdeal
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))]
    (hequi : Equidimensional X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) :
    HasAtWorstNodalSingularities k X ↔
      (IsLocalCompleteIntersectionOverField (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)) ∧
        Unramified ((relativeSingularIdeal
            (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))).subschemeι ≫
          (X ↘ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))))

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.smoothAt_or_isSeparable_and_depth_eq_one_and_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Condition (2) of Tag 0C4E gives condition (5) of Tag 0C4D at every closed point.**  Let
`k` be a field and `X` a locally algebraic `k`-scheme, equidimensional of dimension one.  Assume
`X` is a local complete intersection over `k` and that the closed subscheme cut out by the first
Fitting ideal of `Ω_{X/k}` is unramified over `k`.  Then at a closed point `x` of `X` either the
structure morphism is smooth, or the residue field extension at `x` is separable, `𝒪_{X,x}` is
one-dimensional of depth one, and the first Fitting ideal of `Ω_{X/k}` generates the maximal
ideal of `𝒪_{X,x}`.

The hypotheses are condition (2) of Tag 0C4E and the second disjunct is condition (5) of Tag
0C4D together with the dimension of the local ring.  Separability is stated over the residue
field of the image point of `Spec k`, the spelling of Tag 02G8.

The remaining step of the implication (2) ⟹ (1) of Tag 0C4E — that condition (5) of Tag 0C4D
makes such a point a node — is not delivered *here*, but it **is** available in the library:
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_isClosed`
(`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Curves/NodeFittingIdealClosedPoint.lean`) carries a bare
`@[stacks 0C4D]`, i.e. the whole six-clause equivalence at a closed point of a one-dimensional
scheme locally of finite type over an **arbitrary** field, and the separability this theorem
supplies in its second disjunct is exactly what lets its cycle `1 → 2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6 → 1` be
run, so `(... ).out 5 1` supplies the step.  (5) ⟹ (1) over an arbitrary base field is therefore
in hand, and the two are composed in
`Stacks.NodalEtaleLocalStructure.isNode_asFiber_of_mem_relativeSingular`
(`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Curves/NodalEtaleLocalStructureAssembly.lean`), which is what Tag 0CBY's existence
statement rests on.

The step does not depend on the unproved `h₁₄`/`h₄₅` of
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_tfae_of_residual_equivalences`; that route is only one of several, and
Tag 0CBY is an assembly of proved results.  Alternatives, if the
closed-point hypothesis of `isNode_tfae_of_isClosed` is inconvenient:
`Stacks.Curves.isNode_of_isNodalAlgebra_stalk`
(`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Curves/NodeNodalAlgebraAscent.lean`, `@[stacks 0C4D "clause (2) implies clause (1), over an
arbitrary base field"]`) and `Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_isNodalAlgebra_stalk`
(`StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Curves/NodeResidueFieldSeparable.lean`).
declarations.statement:
theorem smoothAt_or_isSeparable_and_depth_eq_one_and_fittingIdeal_eq_maximalIdeal
    (k : Type u) [Field k] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hequi : Equidimensional X) (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (hlci : IsLocalCompleteIntersectionOverField f)
    (hZ : Unramified ((relativeSingularIdeal f).subschemeι ≫ f))
    (x : X) (hx : IsClosed ({x} : Set X)) :
    letI : Algebra ((AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).residueField (f.base x))
        (X.residueField x) := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
    (InfinitesimalLifting.SmoothAt f x ∨
      (Algebra.IsSeparable ((AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)).residueField (f.base x))
          (X.residueField x) ∧
        ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
          Module.depth (X.presheaf.stalk x) (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
              (X.presheaf.stalk x) = 1 ∧
            IdealSheafData.stalk (relativeSingularIdeal f) x =
              maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
declarations.comment: the implication (2) ⟹ (1), via condition (5) of Tag 0C4D at every closed point

declarations.name: Stacks.DirectLimit.UnramifiedDescent.colimit_unramified
declarations.doc:
If the base change `Φ = id_A ⊗ φ₀` of `φ₀` to the directed colimit `A = colim_i Aᵢ` is
unramified and `C₀` is of finite type over `B₀` via `φ₀`, then the base change
`Φᵢ = id_{Aᵢ} ⊗ φ₀` is unramified at some finite stage `i ≥ O`, where `G i` is an
`A₀`-algebra via `f O i h`.
declarations.statement:
theorem colimit_unramified
    (hΦ :
      letI : Algebra ((A G f) ⊗[G O] B₀) ((A G f) ⊗[G O] C₀) :=
        (phiColim G f O B₀ C₀ φ₀).toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.Unramified ((A G f) ⊗[G O] B₀) ((A G f) ⊗[G O] C₀))
    (hFT :
      letI : Algebra B₀ C₀ := φ₀.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.FiniteType B₀ C₀) :
    ∃ i, ∃ (h : O ≤ i),
      letI : Algebra (G O) (G i) := (f O i h).toAlgebra
      letI φᵢ : (G i) ⊗[G O] B₀ →ₐ[G i] (G i) ⊗[G O] C₀ :=
        Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id (G i) (G i)) φ₀
      letI : Algebra ((G i) ⊗[G O] B₀) ((G i) ⊗[G O] C₀) := φᵢ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.Unramified ((G i) ⊗[G O] B₀) ((G i) ⊗[G O] C₀)

declarations.name: adicCompletionMap_flat_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C4G.** A local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings is flat if and only if the
induced homomorphism between their completions at the maximal ideals is flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem adicCompletionMap_flat_iff {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsLocalRing A] [IsLocalRing B]
    [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsNoetherianRing B] (f : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom f] :
    (adicCompletionMap f (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B)
      (IsLocalRing.map_maximalIdeal_le f)).Flat ↔ f.Flat

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_inclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4I** and **Tag 0C4J.** An inclusion `I ≤ J` of quasi-coherent
sheaves of ideals induces a closed immersion of the associated closed subschemes.

Applied to `I ≤ I ⊔ J` and `J ≤ I ⊔ J` this gives the closed immersions of the scheme theoretic
intersection into either of the two subschemes, and applied to `I ⊓ J ≤ I` and `I ⊓ J ≤ J` it
gives the closed immersions of either subscheme into their scheme theoretic union.
declarations.statement:
instance isClosedImmersion_inclusion {X : Scheme.{u}} {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) :
    IsClosedImmersion (inclusion h)
declarations.comment: closed immersions into the two factors

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_subscheme_sup
declarations.doc:
The subscheme cut out by the sum of two ideal sheaves is the fibre product of the
corresponding closed subschemes over the ambient scheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPullback_subscheme_sup (X : Scheme.{u}) (I J : X.IdealSheafData) :
    IsPullback (I.inclusion le_sup_left : (I ⊔ J).subscheme ⟶ I.subscheme)
      (J.inclusion le_sup_right : (I ⊔ J).subscheme ⟶ J.subscheme)
      I.subschemeι J.subschemeι
declarations.comment: cartesian intersection square

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isClosedImmersion_inclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4I** and **Tag 0C4J.** An inclusion `I ≤ J` of quasi-coherent
sheaves of ideals induces a closed immersion of the associated closed subschemes.

Applied to `I ≤ I ⊔ J` and `J ≤ I ⊔ J` this gives the closed immersions of the scheme theoretic
intersection into either of the two subschemes, and applied to `I ⊓ J ≤ I` and `I ⊓ J ≤ J` it
gives the closed immersions of either subscheme into their scheme theoretic union.
declarations.statement:
instance isClosedImmersion_inclusion {X : Scheme.{u}} {I J : X.IdealSheafData} (h : I ≤ J) :
    IsClosedImmersion (inclusion h)
declarations.comment: union_closed_immersions

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.unionIntersection_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4J.** The canonical sequence of structure sheaves of the
scheme-theoretic union, the two closed subschemes and their scheme-theoretic intersection,
whose last nonzero arrow is the difference of the two restriction maps, is short exact.
declarations.statement:
theorem unionIntersection_shortExact {S : Scheme.{u}} (I J : S.IdealSheafData) :
    ∃ zero : unionToBiprod I J ≫ biprodToIntersection I J = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk (unionToBiprod I J) (biprodToIntersection I J) zero).ShortExact
declarations.comment: union_exact_sequence

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPushout_subscheme_inf
declarations.doc:
The canonical square from the scheme-theoretic intersection of two closed subschemes
to the two subschemes and then to their scheme-theoretic union is a pushout square.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPushout_subscheme_inf {S : Scheme.{u}} (I J : S.IdealSheafData) :
    IsPushout
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion (I := I) (J := I ⊔ J) le_sup_left)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion (I := J) (J := I ⊔ J) le_sup_right)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion (I := I ⊓ J) (J := I) inf_le_left)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.inclusion (I := I ⊓ J) (J := J) inf_le_right)
declarations.comment: union_pushout

declarations.name: Stacks.AmplePullbackDatum.exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C4K].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes, `L` an
invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `M` an invertible `𝒪_Y`-module. If `S` is quasi-compact, `L` is ample
relative to `f` and `M` is ample relative to `g`, then there is a threshold `n` beyond which
`L ⊗ f^* M ^⊗ a` is ample relative to `g ∘ f`.

`Stacks.RelativeAmpleCompositionThreshold.exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp` carries the
datum of [Stacks, Tag 01PW] over each affine open of the base as an explicit premise;
`Stacks.AmplePullbackDatum.relativeEventualAffineDatum` discharges it, so nothing is assumed here
beyond the three hypotheses of the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp [CompactSpace S]
    (hL : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple f L)
    (hM : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple g M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ, n ≤ a → Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f ≫ g)
      (tensorPullbackPowModule f L M a)

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeAmpleCompositionThreshold.exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0C4K**, on the single premise
`Stacks.RelativeAmpleCompositionThreshold.RelativeEventualAffineDatum` — [Stacks, Tag 01PW] over
each affine open of the base.

Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes, `L` an invertible `𝒪_X`-module and `M` an
invertible `𝒪_Y`-module. If `S` is quasi-compact, `L` is ample relative to `f` and `M` is ample
relative to `g`, then there is a threshold `n` with `L ⊗ f^* M ^⊗ a` ample relative to `g ∘ f` for
every `a ≥ n`.

Relative ampleness of `L` and of `M` supplies quasi-compactness of `f` and of `g`, hence of the
composite, so the preimage of an affine open of `S` is quasi-compact and
`Stacks.RelativeAmpleCompositionThreshold.exists_threshold_isAmple_preimage` applies over each of
them. Quasi-compactness of `S` extracts a finite subfamily of the affine opens so chosen, and the
maximum of their thresholds serves for all of them at once; beyond it the finite family is an
affine open covering of `S` on whose preimages the restriction is ample, which
`Stacks.RelativeAmpleLocalOnBase.isRelativelyAmple_of_forall_exists_isAmple` — [Stacks, Tag 01VJ],
clause (3) implies clause (1) — upgrades to relative ampleness over every affine open of `S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp [CompactSpace S]
    (hdat : RelativeEventualAffineDatum f g L M)
    (hL : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple f L)
    (hM : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple g M) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : ℕ, n ≤ a → Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f ≫ g)
      (tensorPullbackPowModule f L M a)
declarations.comment: on Tag 01PW as EventualAffineDatum over each affine open of the base

declarations.name: Stacks.RelativeAmpleCompositionPermanence.isRelativelyAmple_of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0C4L.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes and let `L` be
an invertible `𝒪_X`-module. If `L` is ample relative to `g ∘ f` and `f` is quasi-compact, then
`L` is ample relative to `f`.

Through a point `y : Y` choose an affine open `U ⊆ S` containing `g(y)` and then, since the affine
opens of `Y` are a basis, an affine open `V` with `y ∈ V ≤ g⁻¹U`. On that `V` the restriction of
`L` is ample by `Stacks.RelativeAmpleComposition.isAmple_preimage_of_le_preimage`. These `V` cover
`Y`, and `Stacks.RelativeAmpleLocalOnBase.relativeAmpleLocalOnBase` — [Stacks, Tag 01VJ], clause
(3) implies clause (1) — upgrades them to every affine open of `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyAmple_of_comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) (L : X.Modules)
    [IsInvertibleModule X L] (hL : Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple (f ≫ g) L)
    (hf : QuasiCompact f) :
    Stacks.RelativeAmple.IsRelativelyAmple f L

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsQuasiProjective.comp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C4M].** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes with `S`
quasi-compact. If `f` and `g` are quasi-projective, then so is `f ≫ g`.

Finite type composes. The relatively ample sheaf is produced by [Stacks, Tag 0C4K],
`Stacks.AmplePullbackDatum.exists_threshold_isRelativelyAmple_comp`: from sheaves `L` on `X` ample
relative to `f` and `M` on `Y` ample relative to `g` it gives a threshold beyond which
`L ⊗ f^* M ^⊗ a` is ample relative to `f ≫ g`, and the threshold itself is used as the
exponent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) [CompactSpace S]
    (hf : IsQuasiProjective f) (hg : IsQuasiProjective g) : IsQuasiProjective (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsQuasiProjective.of_comp
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes. If `f ≫ g` is quasi-projective and
`f` is quasi-compact, then `f` is quasi-projective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem of_comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    (hfg : IsQuasiProjective (f ≫ g)) (hf : QuasiCompact f) : IsQuasiProjective f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective.comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4P. A composition of projective morphisms over a quasi-compact
quasi-separated base is projective.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` projective and `S`
quasi-compact and quasi-separated, the composition `f ≫ g` is projective.

The proof is the source's. A projective morphism is quasi-projective and proper (Tags 07RL and
01WC), so `f` and `g` are; a composition of proper morphisms is proper, and a composition of
quasi-projective morphisms with quasi-compact target is quasi-projective (Tag 0C4M); clause (1)
of Tag 0BCL, `AlgebraicGeometry.isProjective_iff_isQuasiProjective_and_isProper`, at the base `S`
returns projectivity of `f ≫ g`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsProjective.comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y ⟶ S} (hf : IsProjective f) (hg : IsProjective g) :
    IsProjective (f ≫ g)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective.of_comp
declarations.doc:
**If `f ≫ g` is projective and `g` is separated then `f` is projective.** Here projective is
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjective`, clause (1) of Definition 01W8: a closed immersion over the base
into the projective bundle `𝐏(ℰ)` of a quasi-coherent module of finite type. The H-projective
form, clause (2), is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism.of_comp`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsProjective.of_comp {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) [IsSeparated g]
    (h : IsProjective (f ≫ g)) : IsProjective f
declarations.comment: projective case: closed immersion over the base into the projective bundle 𝐏(ℰ) of a quasi-coherent module of finite type, i.e. clause (1) of Definition 01W8; no hypothesis beyond the separatedness of `g` that the source states

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsProjectiveMorphism.of_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Q, H-projective case.** If `f ≫ g` is H-projective and `g` is
separated then `f` is H-projective.

The closed immersion `i : X ⟶ ℙⁿ_S` over `S` lifts to `k : X ⟶ ℙⁿ_S ×_S Y` because `i` and `f`
agree over `S`. The first projection of that fibre product is a base change of `g`, hence
separated, and `k` composed with it is `i`; so `k` is a closed immersion by
`AlgebraicGeometry.IsClosedImmersion.of_comp`. Finally `ℙⁿ_S ×_S Y ≅ ℙⁿ_Y` over `Y`.
declarations.statement:
theorem of_comp {Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) [IsSeparated g]
    (h : IsProjectiveMorphism (f ≫ g)) : IsProjectiveMorphism f
declarations.comment: H-projective case

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mul_eq_inf_of_comap_isEffectiveCartierDivisor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4R.**  Let `D, D' ⊆ X` be effective Cartier divisors such that the
scheme-theoretic intersection `D ∩ D'` is an effective Cartier divisor on `D'`.  Then `D + D'`
is the scheme-theoretic union of `D` and `D'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem mul_eq_inf_of_comap_isEffectiveCartierDivisor (D D' : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hD : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D) (hD' : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D')
    (hinter : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor (D.comap D'.subschemeι)) :
    D * D' = D ⊓ D'

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.shortExact_sumKernelMap
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0C4T] with its kernel inclusion named.** For `D ⊆ D'` effective Cartier
divisors on a scheme `X` and `C` an effective Cartier divisor with `D' = D + C`, the sequence
`0 ⟶ 𝒪_X(-D)|_C ⟶ 𝒪_{D'} ⟶ 𝒪_D ⟶ 0` is short exact, with first map
`Stacks.Divisors.sumKernelMap` and second map the canonical restriction.

`Stacks.Divisors.addEffectiveCartierDivisor_shortExact` is the same assertion with the first map
bound by an existential; this version is the one a consumer needs in order to state an equation
about that map, and `Stacks.Divisors.eq_sumKernelMap` shows the two are about the same morphism.
The sum is written `C * D` rather than `D * C` because the named morphism's type mentions it, so
no `mul_comm` can be absorbed into a proof.
declarations.statement:
public theorem shortExact_sumKernelMap (D C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hD : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D) (hsub : C * D ≤ D) :
    (ShortComplex.mk (sumKernelMap D C hD)
      (Scheme.IdealSheafData.closedSubschemeRestriction hsub)
      (sumKernelMap_comp_closedSubschemeRestriction D C hD hsub)).ShortExact
declarations.comment: with the kernel inclusion named, rather than existentially bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.addEffectiveCartierDivisor_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4T.**  Let `D ⊆ D'` be effective Cartier divisors on a scheme `X`
and let `C` be an effective Cartier divisor with `D' = D + C`, which exists by
[Stacks, Tag 02ON].  Then there is a short exact sequence
`0 ⟶ 𝒪_X(-D)|_C ⟶ 𝒪_{D'} ⟶ 𝒪_D ⟶ 0` of `𝒪_X`-modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem addEffectiveCartierDivisor_shortExact (D D' C : X.IdealSheafData)
    (hD : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D) (hD' : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor D')
    (hC : IsEffectiveCartierDivisor C) (hsub : D' ≤ D) (hsum : D' = D * C) :
    ∃ f : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward C.subschemeι).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback C.subschemeι).obj (negativeTwist D)) ⟶
        Scheme.IdealSheafData.closedSubschemeStructureSheaf D',
      ∃ zero : f ≫ Scheme.IdealSheafData.closedSubschemeRestriction hsub = 0,
        (ShortComplex.mk f (Scheme.IdealSheafData.closedSubschemeRestriction hsub)
          zero).ShortExact

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.invertibleSheafPullbackIso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4U.** The canonical identification `f^* 𝒪_Y(D) ≅ 𝒪_X(f^{-1}D)` of
the invertible sheaf of an effective Cartier divisor whose pullback is defined with the
invertible sheaf of its inverse image.
declarations.statement:
def invertibleSheafPullbackIso :
    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj (invertibleSheaf' D) ≅ invertibleSheaf' (D.comap f)
declarations.comment: associated sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.invertibleSheafPullbackIso_canonicalSection
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4U.** Under the identification
`Stacks.Divisors.invertibleSheafPullbackIso` the pullback of the canonical section `1_D` is the
canonical section `1_{f^{-1}D}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem invertibleSheafPullbackIso_canonicalSection :
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.app (invertibleSheafPullbackIso f D).hom ⊤
        (pullbackCanonicalSection f D) =
      (canonicalSection' (D.comap f)).val (op ⊤)
declarations.comment: canonical section

declarations.name: Stacks.Divisors.exists_proper_modification_resolving_partialMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4V.** An `S`-rational map from a Noetherian scheme to a scheme
proper over `S` extends to an `S`-morphism after a proper modification which is unchanged over
the rational map's domain.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_proper_modification_resolving_partialMap
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] [IsNoetherian X]
    [IsProper (Y ↘ S)] (f : X.PartialMap Y) [f.IsOver S] :
    ∃ (X' : Scheme.{u}) (p : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y),
      IsProper p ∧
        f' ≫ (Y ↘ S) = p ≫ (X ↘ S) ∧
        IsIso (pullback.snd p f.domain.ι) ∧
        pullback.fst p f.domain.ι ≫ f' = pullback.snd p f.domain.ι ≫ f.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_unramified_baseChange_of_unramified_limitBaseChange
declarations.doc:
If a morphism over a stage of a cofiltered inverse system is locally of finite type and its
base change to the limit is unramified, then its base change to some later stage is
unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_unramified_baseChange_of_unramified_limitBaseChange
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (i₀ : I)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj i₀)) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀)
    [IsCofiltered I]
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [CompactSpace (D.obj i₀)] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i₀)]
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀.left]
    (hc : IsLimit c)
    [Unramified ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i₀)).map f₀).left] :
    ∃ (i : I) (g : i ⟶ i₀),
      Unramified ((Over.pullback (D.map g)).map f₀).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.stalkOfBaseChange_isLocalization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Y (localization description).** The local ring at a point of a base
change by a field extension is the localization of `𝒪_{X,x} ⊗_k K` at the prime obtained from
the map to the residue field of that point.
declarations.statement:
public theorem stalkOfBaseChange_isLocalization
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x) :
    let Y := (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})
    let A := stalkBaseChangeRing (K := K) f x
    let B := residueBaseChangeRing (K := K) f x
    ∃ θ : A ⟶ B, ∃ ψ : B ⟶ Y.residueField y, ∃ φ : A ⟶ Y.presheaf.stalk y,
      pushout.inl (fieldToStalk f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ θ =
        X.residue x ≫ pushout.inl (fieldToResidue f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ∧
      pushout.inr (fieldToStalk f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ θ =
        pushout.inr (fieldToResidue f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ∧
      pushout.inl (fieldToResidue f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ ψ =
        (X.residueFieldCongr hy.symm).hom ≫
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map
            (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).residueFieldMap y ∧
      pushout.inr (fieldToResidue f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ ψ =
        fieldToResidue
          (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) y ∧
      pushout.inl (fieldToStalk f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ φ =
        (X.presheaf.stalkCongr (.of_eq hy.symm)).hom ≫
          (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y ∧
      pushout.inr (fieldToStalk f x)
          (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K : k →+* K)) ≫ φ =
        fieldToStalk
          (pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))) y ∧
      θ ≫ ψ = φ ≫ Y.residue y ∧
      letI : Algebra A (Y.presheaf.stalk y) := φ.hom.toAlgebra
      let p₀ := RingHom.ker ψ.hom
      let p := stalkBaseChangePrime f x θ p₀
      letI : p₀.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
      letI : p.IsPrime := Ideal.comap_isPrime _ _
      IsLocalization.AtPrime (Y.presheaf.stalk y) p
declarations.comment: localization_description

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
For an extension of fields `K / k`, the map on local rings from a point of a `k`-scheme
to a point above it after base change to `K` is faithfully flat.
declarations.statement:
public theorem faithfullyFlat_stalkMap_fieldExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x) :
    ((eqToHom (congrArg X.presheaf.stalk hy.symm)) ≫
      (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y).hom.FaithfullyFlat
declarations.comment: faithfully_flat_local

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Pullback.isIso_residueFieldMap_to_residueField_specOfPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Y (residue field).** If `y` is a point of the base change of a
scheme over `k` to a field extension `K/k`, its residue field is canonically isomorphic to the
residue field at the corresponding prime of `κ(x) ⊗[k] K`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isIso_residueFieldMap_to_residueField_specOfPoint
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : Y ⟶ S}
    (y : (pullback f g : Scheme)) :
    let T := Scheme.Pullback.Triplet.ofPoint y
    let p := Scheme.Pullback.SpecOfPoint y
    IsIso (((pullback f g : Scheme).residueFieldCongr
        (Scheme.Pullback.SpecTensorTo_SpecOfPoint y).symm).hom ≫
      T.SpecTensorTo.residueFieldMap p ≫
      (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso T.tensor p).hom)
declarations.comment: residue_field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.specialFibreRingEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Y (special fibre).**  For a point `y` of the base change of
a scheme over `k` to an extension field `K`, the quotient of `𝒪_{Y,y}` by the extension
of the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X,x}` is the localization of `κ(x) ⊗_k K` at the prime
induced by `y`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def specialFibreRingEquiv
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    let p := RingHom.ker (Scheme.Pullback.ofPointTensor y).hom
    letI : p.IsPrime := RingHom.ker_isPrime _
    ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}).presheaf.stalk y ⧸
        Ideal.map
          ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y).hom
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
            (X.presheaf.stalk
              ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)))) ≃+*
      Localization.AtPrime p
declarations.comment: special_fibre

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fiberLocalRing_dimension_add_localRing_dimension_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Z.** After extension of the ground field, the dimension of the local
fibre ring plus the dimension of the original local ring is the dimension of the new local
ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberLocalRing_dimension_add_localRing_dimension_eq
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    let Y := (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})
    let g : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let x := g.base y
    ringKrullDim
          ((Y.presheaf.stalk y) ⧸
            Ideal.map (g.stalkMap y).hom
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))) +
        ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk x) =
      ringKrullDim (Y.presheaf.stalk y)
declarations.comment: local-ring dimension equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.fiberLocalRing_dimension_add_trdeg_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C4Z.** After extension of the ground field, the dimension of the local
fibre ring plus the transcendence degree of the new residue field is the transcendence degree of
the original residue field.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberLocalRing_dimension_add_trdeg_eq
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})) :
    let Y := (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})
    let g : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let h : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let x := g.base y
    letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) := (fieldToResidue f x).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra K (Y.residueField y) := (fieldToResidue h y).hom.toAlgebra
    ringKrullDim
          ((Y.presheaf.stalk y) ⧸
            Ideal.map (g.stalkMap y).hom
              (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))) +
        (Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg K (Y.residueField y)) : WithBot ℕ∞) =
      (Cardinal.toENat (Algebra.trdeg k (X.residueField x)) : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: transcendence degree equality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.map_maximalIdeal_stalkMap_eq_of_isReduced_tensorProduct
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C50.** Let `X` be locally of finite type over a field `k` and let
`Y = X ×_{Spec k} Spec K` for an extension of fields `K / k`. If a point `y` of `Y` and its image
`x` in `X` have local rings of the same dimension, and the scalar extension `κ(x) ⊗[k] K` of the
residue field at `x` is reduced — for instance if `κ(x) / k` or `K / k` is separable — then the
maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x}` generates the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{Y, y}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem map_maximalIdeal_stalkMap_eq_of_isReduced_tensorProduct
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hdim :
      ringKrullDim
          (X.presheaf.stalk
            ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)) =
        ringKrullDim
          ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk y))
    (hreduced :
      let x := (pullback.fst f
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y
      letI : (f x).asIdeal.IsPrime := (f x).isPrime
      letI := ((CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k (f x).asIdeal.ResidueField)) ≫
        (Scheme.Spec.residueFieldIso (.of k) (f x)).inv ≫
        f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      _root_.IsReduced (TensorProduct k (X.residueField x) K)) :
    Ideal.map
        ((pullback.fst f
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).stalkMap y).hom
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
          (X.presheaf.stalk
            ((pullback.fst f
              (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y))) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal
        ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_no_quotient_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_completedLocalRing
declarations.doc:
A completed local ring can admit no presentation over its residue field compatible with
the ground field, even when the scheme is locally Noetherian.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_no_quotient_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_completedLocalRing :
    ∃ (k : Type u) (_ : Field k) (X : Scheme.{u})
      (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (_ : IsLocallyNoetherian X) (x : X),
      letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.Γevaluation x).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra k (Scheme.completedLocalRing X x) :=
        Scheme.completedLocalRingAlgebra f x
      ¬ ∃ (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x))),
          Nonempty ((MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x) ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[k]
            Scheme.completedLocalRing X x)
declarations.comment: presentation_not_always_over_base_field

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_quotient_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
If the residue field at a point of a locally Noetherian scheme over `k` is separable over
`k`, then the completed local ring is a quotient of a formal power series ring over the residue
field, as a `k`-algebra, and the equivalence induces the identity on residue fields.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_quotient_mvPowerSeries_algEquiv_adicCompletion
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X) :
    let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
    let κ := X.residueField x
    letI : Algebra k R :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra k κ :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.Γevaluation x).hom.toAlgebra
    Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k κ →
      ∃ (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ))
        (hI : I ≤ RingHom.ker
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ →+* κ)),
        ∃ e : (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[k]
            AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R,
          (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ (maximalIdeal R)).toRingHom.comp
              e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
            Ideal.Quotient.lift I
              (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ →+* κ) hI
declarations.comment: separable_completed_local_ring_presentation

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_powerSeries_quotient_ringEquiv_adicCompletion
registrations.comment: completed_local_ring_presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_powerSeries_quotient_ringEquiv_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
The completed local ring at a point of a locally Noetherian scheme is a quotient of a
formal power series ring over its residue field, with the presentation inducing the canonical
identification on residue fields.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_powerSeries_quotient_ringEquiv_adicCompletion
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x)))
      (e : (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x) ⧸ I) ≃+*
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
      ∀ a : X.residueField x,
        residue (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPowerSeries.C a))) =
          IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
                (X.presheaf.stalk x))) a
declarations.comment: power-series presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_powerSeries_quotient_ringEquiv_adicCompletion_of_isSeparable
declarations.doc:
If the residue field at the point is separable over the ground field, the power-series
presentation of the completed local ring can be chosen to respect the ground-field maps.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_powerSeries_quotient_ringEquiv_adicCompletion_of_isSeparable
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    [IsLocallyNoetherian X] (x : X)
    (hsep :
      let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom
      letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) :=
        ((X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk).toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsSeparable k (X.residueField x)) :
    let kToStalk : k →+* X.presheaf.stalk x :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x trivial).hom
    let kToResidue : k →+* X.residueField x := (X.residue x).hom.comp kToStalk
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (I : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x)))
      (e : (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) (X.residueField x) ⧸ I) ≃+*
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
      (∀ a : X.residueField x,
        residue (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (X.presheaf.stalk x))
            (e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPowerSeries.C a))) =
          IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map
            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
              (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
                (X.presheaf.stalk x))) a) ∧
      (∀ a : k,
        e (Ideal.Quotient.mk I (MvPowerSeries.C (kToResidue a))) =
          algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk x)
            (AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x))
              (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (kToStalk a))
declarations.comment: separable ground-field compatibility

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_baseChanged_powerSeries_quotient_algEquiv_adicCompletion
declarations.doc:
A power-series presentation of a completed local ring over `k` gives, after extending
scalars to `K`, the presentation by the same equations over the residue field upstairs.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_baseChanged_powerSeries_quotient_algEquiv_adicCompletion
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hdim :
      ringKrullDim
          (X.presheaf.stalk
            ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)) =
        ringKrullDim
          ((pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).presheaf.stalk y))
    (hsep :
      let x :=
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y
      letI : Algebra k (X.residueField x) :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.Γevaluation x).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.IsSeparableExtension k (X.residueField x))
    (n : ℕ)
    (I : Ideal
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin n)
        (X.residueField
          ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y))))
    (hI : I ≤ RingHom.ker
      (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff :
        MvPowerSeries (Fin n)
            (X.residueField
              ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)) →+*
          X.residueField
            ((pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y)))
    (e :
      let x :=
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y
      let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
      let κ := X.residueField x
      letI : Algebra k R :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra k κ :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.Γevaluation x).hom.toAlgebra
      (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ ⧸ I) ≃ₐ[k]
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal R) R)
    (he :
      let x :=
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y
      let R := X.presheaf.stalk x
      let κ := X.residueField x
      letI : Algebra k R :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.presheaf.germ ⊤ x (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
      letI : Algebra k κ :=
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appTop ≫ X.Γevaluation x).hom.toAlgebra
      (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ (maximalIdeal R)).toRingHom.comp
          e.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
        Ideal.Quotient.lift I
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κ →+* κ) hI) :
    let Y := pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let p : Y ⟶ X := pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of K) := pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    let x := p.base y
    let RY := Y.presheaf.stalk y
    let κy := Y.residueField y
    let κMap : X.residueField x →+* κy := (p.residueFieldMap y).hom
    let J : Ideal (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κy) := I.map (MvPowerSeries.map κMap)
    let : Algebra K RY :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ g.appTop ≫ Y.presheaf.germ ⊤ y (by simp)).hom.toAlgebra
    let : Algebra K κy :=
      ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of K)).inv ≫ g.appTop ≫ Y.Γevaluation y).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ (hJ : J ≤ RingHom.ker
        (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κy →+* κy))
      (eY : (MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κy ⧸ J) ≃ₐ[K]
        AdicCompletion (maximalIdeal RY) RY),
      (AdicCompletion.evalOneₐ (maximalIdeal RY)).toRingHom.comp
          eY.toRingEquiv.toRingHom =
        Ideal.Quotient.lift J
          (MvPowerSeries.constantCoeff : MvPowerSeries (Fin n) κy →+* κy) hJ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isGeometricallyUnibranchAt_iff_of_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C55.** Geometric unibranchness at a point is invariant under
extension of the ground field for a scheme locally of finite type over that field.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isGeometricallyUnibranchAt_iff_of_fieldExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x) :
    IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt X x ↔
      IsGeometricallyUnibranchAt
        (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}) y

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_of_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C56.**  Let `K / k` be an extension of fields and let `X` be a
one-dimensional scheme locally of finite type over `k`.  A point of the base change `X_K` is a
closed point and a node exactly when its image in `X` is.

Closedness of the point is part of `Stacks.Curves.IsNode`, so the two conditions of the source
are carried by the node predicates themselves rather than stated separately.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_iff_of_fieldExtension
    (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1) (x : X)
    (y : (pullback f (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :
      Scheme.{u}))
    (hy : (pullback.fst f
      (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x) :
    letI : X.Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of k)) := ⟨f⟩
    letI : (pullback f (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) :
        Scheme.{u}).Over (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (.of K)) :=
      ⟨pullback.snd f (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))⟩
    (IsNode k X x ↔
      IsNode K (pullback f
        (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u}) y)

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.isNode_iff_of_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C57.** For an étale morphism `g : Y ⟶ X` of schemes over a field with
`X` of dimension one and locally of finite type, a point of `Y` is a node exactly when its image
in `X` is a node.
declarations.statement:
theorem isNode_iff_of_etale
    (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (_hdim : topologicalKrullDim X = 1)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) [Etale g] (y : Y) :
    letI : X.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨f⟩
    letI : Y.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨g ≫ f⟩
    IsNode k X (g.base y) ↔ IsNode k Y y

declarations.name: Stacks.Curves.hasAtWorstNodalFibresOfDimensionOne_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C59.**  A morphism of schemes is flat, locally of finite presentation
with every nonempty fibre equidimensional of dimension one and with at-worst-nodal singularities
exactly when it is syntomic of relative dimension one and the closed subscheme cut out by the
first Fitting ideal of its relative differentials is unramified over the base.

Everything except the nodal condition on the fibres is
`AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_iff_fibres`, which reads that condition
as condition (2) of Tag 0C4E; Tag 0C4E
(`Stacks.Curves.hasAtWorstNodalSingularities_iff_lci_and_unramified_relativeSingularIdeal`)
applied to a fibre trades the two.  Its hypotheses on the fibre are the equidimensionality and
the dimension, which both sides of the equivalence provide for a nonempty fibre, and local
finite type of the fibre's structure morphism, which follows from local finite presentation of
`f`; over an empty fibre condition (2) holds vacuously.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasAtWorstNodalFibresOfDimensionOne_iff {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) :
    HasAtWorstNodalFibresOfDimensionOne f ↔ IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne f
declarations.comment: condition (1) is `Stacks.Curves.HasAtWorstNodalFibresOfDimensionOne` and condition (2) is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne`

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne
declarations.doc:
A morphism is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one if it is syntomic of relative
dimension one and its relative singular subscheme is unramified over the base.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne.of_isPullback
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one. Then so is any base change
`f' : X' ⟶ S'` of `f`, presented by an arbitrary cartesian square.
declarations.statement:
public theorem IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne.of_isPullback {X' X S' S : Scheme.{u}}
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'} {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} (h : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (hf : IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne f) :
    IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne f'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_isStableUnderBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C5B.** A base change of a morphism which is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension
one is again at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_comp_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5C.** Precomposing an at-worst-nodal morphism of relative
dimension one with an étale morphism again gives an at-worst-nodal morphism of relative
dimension one.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_iff_of_etaleCovering
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5D.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes and let
`{U i ⟶ X}` be an étale covering. The following are equivalent:

1. `f` is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one;
2. each `U i ⟶ S` is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one.

In other words, being at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one is étale local on the source.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_iff_of_etaleCovering {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) {ι : Type*} {U : ι → Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, U i ⟶ X)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows U g ∈ Scheme.etalePrecoverage X) :
    IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne f ↔
      ∀ i, IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne (g i ≫ f)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_isLocalAtSource_etale
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C5D.** Being at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one is étale local on the
source: a morphism has the property exactly when all of its restrictions to the members of an
étale covering of its source do.
declarations.statement:
public instance isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_isLocalAtSource_etale :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource
      (@IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      Scheme.etalePrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0C5E.** Being at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one is fpqc local on the
target: a morphism has the property exactly when all of its base changes along the members of
an fpqc covering of its target do.
declarations.statement:
public instance isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_isLocalAtTarget_fpqc :
    MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget
      (@IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne.{u} : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u})
      Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_baseChange_of_limitBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5F.** Let a scheme be the limit of a cofiltered inverse system of
schemes with affine transition morphisms, and let `f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀` be a morphism locally of finite
presentation over a stage, with that stage and both of `X₀`, `Y₀` quasi-compact and
quasi-separated. If the base change of `f₀` to the limit is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension
one, then its base change to some later stage is at-worst-nodal of relative dimension one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne_baseChange_of_limitBaseChange
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (i₀ : I)
    (X₀ Y₀ : Over (D.obj i₀)) (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ Y₀) [IsCofiltered I]
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [CompactSpace (D.obj i₀)] [QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i₀)]
    [CompactSpace X₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X₀.left]
    [CompactSpace Y₀.left] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y₀.left]
    (hf₀ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation f₀.left) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hf : IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne
      ((Over.pullback (c.π.app i₀)).map f₀).left) :
    ∃ (i : I) (g : i ⟶ i₀), IsAtWorstNodalOfRelativeDimensionOne
      ((Over.pullback (D.map g)).map f₀).left

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.eq_zero_of_zsmul_picardClass_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5G, the infinite-order half.** Let `D` be an exceptional curve of
the first kind on a scheme `X` over a field `k`. Then the class of `𝒪_X(D)` has infinite order
in `Pic(X)`: no nonzero multiple of it vanishes.

Pulling the class back along the closed immersion `D ⟶ X` gives the class of the normal sheaf of
`D`, and pulling that back along `e` gives the class of `𝒪(-1)` on `𝐏¹_k`, which has infinite
order because `m ↦ [𝒪(m)]` is injective there (Tag 0BXJ).
declarations.statement:
theorem IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.eq_zero_of_zsmul_picardClass_eq_zero
    (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e) (n : ℤ)
    (hn : n • Stacks.Divisors.picardClass D = 0) : n = 0
declarations.comment: the infinite-order half, for an exceptional curve of the first kind: that the exceptional divisor of the blowup is one is the unproved half of Tag 0AGQ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.picardGroupEquivInt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5G, granted generation.** Let `D` be an exceptional curve of the
first kind on a scheme `X` over a field `k`, and suppose every Picard class of `X` is an
integral multiple of the class of `𝒪_X(D)`. Then `n ↦ n • [𝒪_X(D)]` is an isomorphism
`ℤ ≃+ Pic(X)`: it is surjective by hypothesis and injective because `[𝒪_X(D)]` has infinite
order.
declarations.statement:
def IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.picardGroupEquivInt
    {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme} (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (hgen : Function.Surjective fun n : ℤ => n • Stacks.Divisors.picardClass D) :
    ℤ ≃+ Stacks.Picard.ofScheme X
declarations.comment: granted generation, which is hypothesized: the source's generation step needs the Weil divisor of the canonical section of O_X(D) to be identified with D, which the library lacks; and that the exceptional divisor of the blowup is an exceptional curve of the first kind is the unproved half of Tag 0AGQ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.picardGroupEquivInt_one
declarations.doc:
The isomorphism `ℤ ≃+ Pic(X)` carries `1` to the class of `𝒪_X(D)`, so `Pic(X)` is
infinite cyclic *on that class*.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind.picardGroupEquivInt_one
    {e : projectiveLineProj k ≅ D.subscheme} (hE : D.IsExceptionalCurveOfFirstKind k e)
    (hgen : Function.Surjective fun n : ℤ => n • Stacks.Divisors.picardClass D) :
    hE.picardGroupEquivInt D k hgen 1 = Stacks.Divisors.picardClass D
declarations.comment: granted generation, which is hypothesized: the generator clause

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.subsingleton_picardGroup_compl_exceptionalIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C5G, the third step of the source's proof.** Let `A` be a regular
local ring and let `X ⟶ Spec A` be the blowup of `Spec A` in its maximal ideal, with exceptional
divisor `E`. Then `Pic(X ∖ E)` is trivial.

The blowup is an isomorphism over the complement of its centre (Tag 02OS), that complement is
the punctured spectrum of `A`, and a regular local ring is a unique factorization domain, so the
Picard group of its punctured spectrum vanishes (Tag 0F2H). No hypothesis on the dimension of
`A` is used.
declarations.statement:
theorem subsingleton_picardGroup_compl_exceptionalIdeal (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    [IsRegularLocalRing A] :
