declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.intersection_self_eq_neg_weight_of_contribution_neg
declarations.doc:
The diagonal intersection number of a component with negative contribution to
the genus is the negative of its weight.
declarations.statement:
public lemma intersection_self_eq_neg_weight_of_contribution_neg
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 1 < T.componentCount) (i : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : (T.multiplicity i : ℚ) *
      ((T.weight i : ℚ) * ((T.componentGenus i : ℚ) - 1) -
        (T.intersection i i : ℚ) / 2) < 0) :
    T.intersection i i = -T.weight i
declarations.comment: diagonal intersection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.IsMinusOneIndex
declarations.doc:
An index is a minus-one index if its component genus is zero and its diagonal intersection
number is the negative of its weight.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsMinusOneIndex (T : NumericalType) (i : Fin T.componentCount) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.contractLast
declarations.doc:
The contraction of a numerical type along its last component, together with
the defining formulas and invariance of its genus.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def contractLast (T : NumericalType)
    (h : IsMinusOneIndex T (lastIndex T)) : {T' : NumericalType // IsContraction T T'}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.one_sub_componentCount_add_edgeCount_nonneg
declarations.doc:
For a numerical type, one minus the number of components plus the number of
positive-intersection pairs is nonnegative.
declarations.statement:
public lemma one_sub_componentCount_add_edgeCount_nonneg (T : NumericalType) :
    0 ≤ (1 : ℤ) - T.componentCount + edgeCount T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.topologicalGenus
declarations.doc:
The **topological genus** of a numerical type: one minus its number of
components plus the number of pairs of distinct components whose intersection
number is positive.
declarations.statement: public def topologicalGenus (T : NumericalType) : ℤ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.IsMinimal
declarations.doc: A numerical type is **minimal** if it has no minus-one index.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsMinimal (T : NumericalType) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.one_le_genus_of_isMinimal
declarations.doc: A minimal numerical type with more than one component has genus at least one.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.one_sub_componentCount_add_edgeCount_le_genus_of_isMinimal
declarations.doc:
The topological genus of a minimal numerical type with more than one
component is at most its genus.
declarations.statement:
public lemma one_sub_componentCount_add_edgeCount_le_genus_of_isMinimal
    (T : NumericalType) (hT : IsMinimal T) (hn : 1 < T.componentCount) :
    (1 : ℤ) - T.componentCount + edgeCount T ≤ genus T

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.componentGenus_eq_zero_of_contribution_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
A component of zero contribution in a numerical type with more than one
component has component genus zero.
declarations.statement:
public lemma componentGenus_eq_zero_of_contribution_eq_zero
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 1 < T.componentCount) (i : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : (T.multiplicity i : ℚ) *
      ((T.weight i : ℚ) * ((T.componentGenus i : ℚ) - 1) -
        (T.intersection i i : ℚ) / 2) = 0) :
    T.componentGenus i = 0
declarations.comment: component genus

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.intersection_self_eq_neg_two_mul_weight_of_contribution_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
A component of zero contribution in a numerical type with more than one
component has diagonal intersection number equal to minus twice its weight.
declarations.statement:
public lemma intersection_self_eq_neg_two_mul_weight_of_contribution_eq_zero
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 1 < T.componentCount) (i : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : (T.multiplicity i : ℚ) *
      ((T.weight i : ℚ) * ((T.componentGenus i : ℚ) - 1) -
        (T.intersection i i : ℚ) / 2) = 0) :
    T.intersection i i = -2 * T.weight i
declarations.comment: diagonal intersection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.IsMinusTwoIndex
declarations.doc:
An index is a minus-two index if its component genus is zero and its diagonal intersection
number is negative twice its weight.
declarations.statement: public abbrev IsMinusTwoIndex (T : NumericalType) (i : Fin T.componentCount) : Prop

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.picardGroup
declarations.doc:
The Picard group of a numerical type, namely the cokernel of its relation
matrix.
declarations.statement: public abbrev picardGroup (T : NumericalType)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.rank_picardGroup
declarations.doc: The Picard group of a numerical type has rank one.
declarations.statement:
public theorem rank_picardGroup (T : NumericalType) :
    Module.rank ℤ (picardGroup T) = 1
declarations.comment: rank one

registrations.name: Module.Finite.quotient
registrations.comment: finite generation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.contractPicardMap
declarations.doc:
The Picard-group homomorphism induced by contracting the final minus-one
component.
declarations.comment: the induced homomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.contractPicardMap_mk
declarations.doc:
On cokernel representatives, the contraction homomorphism is induced by the
coordinate map `p`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem contractPicardMap_mk (T : NumericalType)
    (h : IsMinusOneIndex T (lastIndex T))
    (x : Fin T.componentCount → ℤ) :
    contractPicardMap T h (Submodule.Quotient.mk x) =
      Submodule.Quotient.mk (contractPicardRepresentative T h x)
declarations.comment: formula on representatives

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.contractPicardMap_injective
declarations.doc: Contraction of a minus-one component induces an injection on Picard groups.
declarations.comment: injectivity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.two_smul_mem_contractPicardMap_range
declarations.doc: The cokernel of the Picard-group map induced by contraction has exponent two.
declarations.statement:
public theorem two_smul_mem_contractPicardMap_range (T : NumericalType)
    (h : IsMinusOneIndex T (lastIndex T))
    (x : picardGroup (contractLast T h).val) :
    2 • x ∈ (contractPicardMap T h).range
declarations.comment: elementary abelian two-group cokernel

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.picardGroup_addEquiv_int_of_genus_nonpos
declarations.doc: A numerical type of nonpositive genus has infinite cyclic Picard group.
declarations.statement:
public theorem picardGroup_addEquiv_int_of_genus_nonpos (T : NumericalType)
    (hT : genus T ≤ 0) : Nonempty (picardGroup T ≃+ ℤ)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.isTwoVertexConfiguration_or_swap
declarations.doc:
A positively intersecting pair of minus-two indices in a numerical type with
more than two components has type `A₂`, `B₂`, or `G₂`, up to exchanging the
indices.
declarations.statement:
public lemma isTwoVertexConfiguration_or_swap (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 2 < T.componentCount) (i j : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : IsMinusTwoIndex T i) (hj : IsMinusTwoIndex T j)
    (hij : 0 < T.intersection i j) :
    IsTwoVertexConfiguration T i j ∨ IsTwoVertexConfiguration T j i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.exists_ordering_of_three_minus_two_indices
declarations.doc:
Three distinct minus-two indices in a numerical type with more than three
components, at least two of whose pairwise intersections are nonzero, can be
ordered so that their numerical data have one of the three listed weighted-path
forms.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_ordering_of_three_minus_two_indices
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 3 < T.componentCount)
    (i j k : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : IsMinusTwoIndex T i) (hj : IsMinusTwoIndex T j)
    (hk : IsMinusTwoIndex T k) (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hjk : j ≠ k)
    (hintersections :
      (T.intersection i j ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection i k ≠ 0) ∨
      (T.intersection i j ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection j k ≠ 0) ∨
      (T.intersection i k ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection j k ≠ 0)) :
    ∃ v : Fin 3 → Fin T.componentCount,
      Function.Injective v ∧ Set.range v = {i, j, k} ∧
        ((∃ w : ℤ,
            T.weight (v 0) = w ∧
            T.weight (v 1) = w ∧
            T.weight (v 2) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 0) = -2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 2) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 0) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 1) = -2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 0) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 1) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 2) = -2 * w ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 0) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 0) + T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤
              2 * T.multiplicity (v 1) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 2)) ∨
          (∃ w : ℤ,
            T.weight (v 0) = w ∧
            T.weight (v 1) = w ∧
            T.weight (v 2) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 0) = -2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 2) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 0) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 1) = -2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 0) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 1) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 2) = -4 * w ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 0) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 0) + 2 * T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤
              2 * T.multiplicity (v 1) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 2)) ∨
          (∃ w : ℤ,
            T.weight (v 0) = 2 * w ∧
            T.weight (v 1) = 2 * w ∧
            T.weight (v 2) = w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 0) = -4 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 0) (v 2) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 0) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 1) = -4 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 0) = 0 ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 1) = 2 * w ∧
            T.intersection (v 2) (v 2) = -2 * w ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 0) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 0) + T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤
              2 * T.multiplicity (v 1) ∧
            T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ T.multiplicity (v 2)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.four_minus_two_indices
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C7V.** A proper chain of four minus-two indices has,
after reordering, one of the four listed weighted intersection matrices.
declarations.statement:
public theorem four_minus_two_indices
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 4 < T.componentCount)
    (i j k l : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hdistinct : Function.Injective ![i, j, k, l])
    (hi : IsMinusTwoIndex T i) (hj : IsMinusTwoIndex T j)
    (hk : IsMinusTwoIndex T k) (hl : IsMinusTwoIndex T l)
    (hij : T.intersection i j ≠ 0) (hjk : T.intersection j k ≠ 0)
    (hkl : T.intersection k l ≠ 0) :
    ∃ (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)) (w : ℤ),
      let r : Fin 4 → Fin T.componentCount := ![i, j, k, l] ∘ σ
      (((fun p => T.weight (r p)) = ![w, w, w, w] ∧
          (fun p q => T.intersection (r p) (r q)) =
            ![![-2 * w, w, 0, 0],
              ![w, -2 * w, w, 0],
              ![0, w, -2 * w, w],
              ![0, 0, w, -2 * w]] ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 0) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 1) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 0) + T.multiplicity (r 2) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 2) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) + T.multiplicity (r 3) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 3) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 2)) ∨
        ((fun p => T.weight (r p)) = ![w, w, w, 2 * w] ∧
          (fun p q => T.intersection (r p) (r q)) =
            ![![-2 * w, w, 0, 0],
              ![w, -2 * w, w, 0],
              ![0, w, -2 * w, 2 * w],
              ![0, 0, 2 * w, -4 * w]] ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 0) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 1) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 0) + T.multiplicity (r 2) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 2) ≥
            T.multiplicity (r 1) + 2 * T.multiplicity (r 3) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 3) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 2)) ∨
        ((fun p => T.weight (r p)) = ![2 * w, 2 * w, 2 * w, w] ∧
          (fun p q => T.intersection (r p) (r q)) =
            ![![-4 * w, 2 * w, 0, 0],
              ![2 * w, -4 * w, 2 * w, 0],
              ![0, 2 * w, -4 * w, 2 * w],
              ![0, 0, 2 * w, -2 * w]] ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 0) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 1) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 0) + T.multiplicity (r 2) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 2) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) + T.multiplicity (r 3) ∧
          T.multiplicity (r 3) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 2)) ∨
        ((fun p => T.weight (r p)) = ![w, w, 2 * w, 2 * w] ∧
          (fun p q => T.intersection (r p) (r q)) =
            ![![-2 * w, w, 0, 0],
              ![w, -2 * w, 2 * w, 0],
              ![0, 2 * w, -4 * w, 2 * w],
              ![0, 0, 2 * w, -4 * w]] ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 0) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 1) ≥
            T.multiplicity (r 0) + 2 * T.multiplicity (r 2) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 2) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 1) + T.multiplicity (r 3) ∧
          2 * T.multiplicity (r 3) ≥ T.multiplicity (r 2)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.exists_d4_configuration_of_four_isMinusTwoIndex
declarations.doc:
Four distinct minus-two components, with one component meeting the other
three, form a D4 configuration.
declarations.statement:
public lemma exists_d4_configuration_of_four_isMinusTwoIndex
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 4 < T.componentCount)
    (i j k l : Fin T.componentCount)
    (hij : i ≠ j) (hik : i ≠ k) (hil : i ≠ l)
    (hjk : j ≠ k) (hjl : j ≠ l) (hkl : k ≠ l)
    (hi : IsMinusTwoIndex T i) (hj : IsMinusTwoIndex T j)
    (hk : IsMinusTwoIndex T k) (hl : IsMinusTwoIndex T l)
    (haij : T.intersection i j ≠ 0)
    (haik : T.intersection i k ≠ 0)
    (hail : T.intersection i l ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : ℤ,
      0 < w ∧
      T.weight i = w ∧ T.weight j = w ∧
      T.weight k = w ∧ T.weight l = w ∧
      T.intersection i i = -2 * w ∧
      T.intersection j j = -2 * w ∧
      T.intersection k k = -2 * w ∧
      T.intersection l l = -2 * w ∧
      T.intersection i j = w ∧ T.intersection j i = w ∧
      T.intersection i k = w ∧ T.intersection k i = w ∧
      T.intersection i l = w ∧ T.intersection l i = w ∧
      T.intersection j k = 0 ∧ T.intersection k j = 0 ∧
      T.intersection j l = 0 ∧ T.intersection l j = 0 ∧
      T.intersection k l = 0 ∧ T.intersection l k = 0 ∧
      2 * T.multiplicity i ≥
        T.multiplicity j + T.multiplicity k + T.multiplicity l ∧
      2 * T.multiplicity j ≥ T.multiplicity i ∧
      2 * T.multiplicity k ≥ T.multiplicity i ∧
      2 * T.multiplicity l ≥ T.multiplicity i ∧
      T.multiplicity j ≤ T.multiplicity i ∧
      T.multiplicity k ≤ T.multiplicity i ∧
      T.multiplicity l ≤ T.multiplicity i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.five_chain_is_A5_or_C5_or_B5
declarations.doc:
Five distinct minus-two indices joined consecutively in a numerical type
with more than five components form, after reordering, a configuration of type
`A₅`, `C₅`, or `B₅`.
declarations.statement:
public lemma five_chain_is_A5_or_C5_or_B5 (T : NumericalType)
    (hcount : 5 < T.componentCount)
    (v : Fin 5 → Fin T.componentCount) (hv : Function.Injective v)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (hadjacent : ∀ r : Fin 4,
      T.intersection (v r.castSucc) (v r.succ) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 5), ∃ w : ℤ, 0 < w ∧
      (IsA5Configuration T (fun r ↦ v (σ r)) w ∨
        IsC5Configuration T (fun r ↦ v (σ r)) w ∨
        IsB5Configuration T (fun r ↦ v (σ r)) w)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.not_exists_fourfold_of_five_lt_componentCount
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C86.** A numerical type with more than five components
does not have five distinct minus-two indices with one meeting all four others.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_exists_fourfold_of_five_lt_componentCount
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) :
    ¬ ∃ v : Fin 5 → Fin T.componentCount,
      Function.Injective v ∧
        (∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r)) ∧
        (∀ r, r ≠ 0 → 0 < T.intersection (v 0) (v r))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.exists_weight_eq_d5_of_isMinusTwoIndex
declarations.doc:
Five minus-two indices forming the edges of a `D5` diagram in a numerical
type with more than five components have equal weights, the standard `D5`
intersection matrix.
declarations.comment: weights and intersections

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_zero
declarations.doc: The first multiplicity inequality for a proper `D5` subgraph.
declarations.statement:
public lemma multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_zero (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) (v : Fin 5 ↪ Fin T.componentCount)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (h₀₁ : T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) ≠ 0)
    (h₁₂ : T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₃ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 3) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₄ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 4) ≠ 0) :
    T.multiplicity (v 1) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 0)
declarations.comment: first multiplicity inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_one
declarations.doc: The second multiplicity inequality for a proper `D5` subgraph.
declarations.statement:
public lemma multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_one (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) (v : Fin 5 ↪ Fin T.componentCount)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (h₀₁ : T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) ≠ 0)
    (h₁₂ : T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₃ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 3) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₄ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 4) ≠ 0) :
    T.multiplicity (v 0) + T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤
      2 * T.multiplicity (v 1)
declarations.comment: second multiplicity inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_two
declarations.doc: The central multiplicity inequality for a proper `D5` subgraph.
declarations.statement:
public lemma multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_two (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) (v : Fin 5 ↪ Fin T.componentCount)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (h₀₁ : T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) ≠ 0)
    (h₁₂ : T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₃ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 3) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₄ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 4) ≠ 0) :
    T.multiplicity (v 1) + T.multiplicity (v 3) + T.multiplicity (v 4) ≤
      2 * T.multiplicity (v 2)
declarations.comment: third multiplicity inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_three
declarations.doc: The fourth multiplicity inequality for a proper `D5` subgraph.
declarations.statement:
public lemma multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_three (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) (v : Fin 5 ↪ Fin T.componentCount)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (h₀₁ : T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) ≠ 0)
    (h₁₂ : T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₃ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 3) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₄ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 4) ≠ 0) :
    T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 3)
declarations.comment: fourth multiplicity inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_four
declarations.doc: The fifth multiplicity inequality for a proper `D5` subgraph.
declarations.statement:
public lemma multiplicity_le_of_d5_at_four (T : NumericalType)
    (hn : 5 < T.componentCount) (v : Fin 5 ↪ Fin T.componentCount)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (v r))
    (h₀₁ : T.intersection (v 0) (v 1) ≠ 0)
    (h₁₂ : T.intersection (v 1) (v 2) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₃ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 3) ≠ 0)
    (h₂₄ : T.intersection (v 2) (v 4) ≠ 0) :
    T.multiplicity (v 2) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (v 4)
declarations.comment: fifth multiplicity inequality

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.classify_long_chain_of_minus_two_indices
declarations.doc:
A proper chain of more than five distinct minus-two indices has one of the
three long-chain configurations, after possibly reversing the chain.
declarations.statement:
public lemma classify_long_chain_of_minus_two_indices {t : ℕ} (T : NumericalType)
    (i : Fin t → Fin T.componentCount) (ht : 5 < t)
    (hproper : t < T.componentCount) (hinj : Function.Injective i)
    (hminusTwo : ∀ j, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i j))
    (hadjacent : ∀ j k, k.val = j.val + 1 → T.intersection (i j) (i k) ≠ 0) :
    IsLongChainConfiguration T i ∨
      IsLongChainConfiguration T (fun j => i (Fin.rev j))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.eq_fork_of_isMinusTwoIndex
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C8D.** A fork on more than five minus-two vertices
inside a proper subset of the components of a numerical type has constant
weights, with every edge equal to that weight and every other off-diagonal
intersection equal to zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem eq_fork_of_isMinusTwoIndex
    (T : NumericalType) (t : ℕ) (ht : 4 < t)
    (hn : t + 1 < T.componentCount)
    (i : Fin (t + 1) → Fin T.componentCount)
    (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hminus : ∀ j, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i j))
    (hchain : ∀ j : Fin (t - 1),
      T.intersection (i ⟨j, by omega⟩) (i ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) ≠ 0)
    (hbranch : T.intersection (i ⟨t - 2, by omega⟩) (i ⟨t, by omega⟩) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : ℤ,
      (∀ j, T.weight (i j) = w) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin (t - 1),
        T.intersection (i ⟨j, by omega⟩) (i ⟨j + 1, by omega⟩) = w) ∧
      T.intersection (i ⟨t - 2, by omega⟩) (i ⟨t, by omega⟩) = w ∧
      (∀ j k : Fin (t + 1), k < j →
          ¬ (j.val = k.val + 1 ∧ k.val < t - 1) →
          ¬ (j.val = t ∧ k.val = t - 2) →
          T.intersection (i j) (i k) = 0)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.weight_eq_of_e6
declarations.doc:
The weights at six distinct minus-two indices containing the five edges of an
E6 diagram are all equal.
declarations.statement:
public lemma weight_eq_of_e6 (T : NumericalType) (hcount : 6 < T.componentCount)
    (i : Fin 6 → Fin T.componentCount) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i r))
    (hedge : ∀ r s, IsE6ForwardEdge r s → T.intersection (i r) (i s) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ r, T.weight (i r) = T.weight (i 0)
declarations.comment: weights

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.intersection_eq_e6Matrix
declarations.doc:
The intersection matrix on six distinct minus-two indices containing the five
edges of an E6 diagram is the standard weighted E6 matrix.
declarations.statement:
public lemma intersection_eq_e6Matrix (T : NumericalType) (hcount : 6 < T.componentCount)
    (i : Fin 6 → Fin T.componentCount) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i r))
    (hedge : ∀ r s, IsE6ForwardEdge r s → T.intersection (i r) (i s) ≠ 0) :
    (fun r s => T.intersection (i r) (i s)) = e6IntersectionMatrix (T.weight (i 0))
declarations.comment: intersection matrix

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.e6_neighborMultiplicity_le
declarations.doc:
At each vertex of an E6 configuration, the sum of the multiplicities at its
neighbors is at most twice its own multiplicity.
declarations.statement:
public lemma e6_neighborMultiplicity_le (T : NumericalType) (hcount : 6 < T.componentCount)
    (i : Fin 6 → Fin T.componentCount) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hminus : ∀ r, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i r))
    (hedge : ∀ r s, IsE6ForwardEdge r s → T.intersection (i r) (i s) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ r, ∑ s with IsE6Adjacent r s, T.multiplicity (i s) ≤ 2 * T.multiplicity (i r)
declarations.comment: multiplicity inequalities

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.not_exists_double_triple_subgraph
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C8H.** There is no proper double-triple
configuration consisting of distinct minus-two indices in a numerical type.
declarations.statement:
public lemma not_exists_double_triple_subgraph
    (T : NumericalType) (t : ℕ) (ht : 4 ≤ t)
    (hproper : t + 2 < T.componentCount) :
    ¬ ∃ indices : ℕ → Fin T.componentCount,
      Set.InjOn indices (Set.Iio (t + 2)) ∧
        (∀ j < t + 2, IsMinusTwoIndex T (indices j)) ∧
        (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ t - 1 →
          0 < T.intersection (indices j) (indices (j + 1))) ∧
        0 < T.intersection (indices 0) (indices 2) ∧
        0 < T.intersection (indices (t - 1)) (indices (t + 1))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.not_exists_seven_minusTwoIndices_with_affineE6_edges
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C8I.** A numerical type with more than seven components has no
seven distinct minus-two indices whose indicated intersections form the edges of the affine
E6 diagram.
declarations.statement:
public theorem not_exists_seven_minusTwoIndices_with_affineE6_edges
    (T : NumericalType) (hn : 7 < T.componentCount) :
    ¬ ∃ f g h i j k l : Fin T.componentCount,
      List.Pairwise (· ≠ ·) [f, g, h, i, j, k, l] ∧
      IsMinusTwoIndex T f ∧ IsMinusTwoIndex T g ∧ IsMinusTwoIndex T h ∧
      IsMinusTwoIndex T i ∧ IsMinusTwoIndex T j ∧ IsMinusTwoIndex T k ∧
      IsMinusTwoIndex T l ∧
      T.intersection f g ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection g h ≠ 0 ∧
      T.intersection i j ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection j h ≠ 0 ∧
      T.intersection k l ≠ 0 ∧ T.intersection l h ≠ 0

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.NumericalType.e8_submatrix_of_minus_two_indices
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0C8L.** A proper `E₈`-shaped configuration of
minus-two indices has constant weight and the weighted `E₈` intersection
matrix.
declarations.statement:
public theorem e8_submatrix_of_minus_two_indices
    (T : NumericalType) (hcard : 8 < T.componentCount)
    (i : Fin 8 → Fin T.componentCount) (hi : Function.Injective i)
    (hminus : ∀ k, IsMinusTwoIndex T (i k))
    (h12 : T.intersection (i 0) (i 1) ≠ 0)
    (h23 : T.intersection (i 1) (i 2) ≠ 0)
    (h34 : T.intersection (i 2) (i 3) ≠ 0)
    (h45 : T.intersection (i 3) (i 4) ≠ 0)
    (h56 : T.intersection (i 4) (i 5) ≠ 0)
    (h67 : T.intersection (i 5) (i 6) ≠ 0)
    (h58 : T.intersection (i 4) (i 7) ≠ 0) :
    ∃ w : ℤ,
      (∀ k, T.weight (i k) = w) ∧
      (fun k l ↦ T.intersection (i k) (i l)) = e8IntersectionMatrix w
declarations.comment: weights and intersections
