theorem isSmooth_iff_isSmooth_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    IsSmooth B S hS f ↔ IsSmooth B S hS f'
declarations.comment: smooth

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isSyntomic_iff_isSyntomic_ambient
declarations.doc:
Under the hypotheses of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`,
and assuming that syntomicity of morphisms of algebraic spaces is local on the source for the
syntomic precoverage and local on the target for the fpqc precoverage, the restricted 1-morphism
`f` passes the existential smooth-diagram test at syntomicity of morphisms of algebraic spaces if
and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` does.
declarations.statement:
theorem isSyntomic_iff_isSyntomic_ambient
    [MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtSource
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (k : F ⟶ G) => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k.hom)
      (Space.Topology.precoverage.{u, u + 1} .syntomic B S hS)]
    [MorphismProperty.IsLocalAtTarget
      (fun ⦃F G : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS⦄ (k : F ⟶ G) => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k.hom)
      (Space.Topology.precoverage.{u, u + 1} .fpqc B S hS)]
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    Stack.HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS
        (fun _ _ k => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k) f.hom ↔
      Stack.HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS
        (fun _ _ k => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k) f'.hom
declarations.comment: syntomic

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_isLocallyQuasiFinite_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, locally quasi-finite.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`, the restricted 1-morphism
`f` is locally quasi-finite if and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` is locally quasi-finite.

Local quasi-finiteness is by **Stacks 06PU** three conditions, and each is carried separately;
none of them goes through the smooth-diagram reduction of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_iff_of_flatDeformation`, local
quasi-finiteness not being smooth local on the source.

The quasi-DM condition is item (8) of **Stacks 0CJ9**,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isQuasiDM_inner_iff_outer`, read on the morphism of thickenings whose
ambient 1-morphism is `f'` and whose restricted one is `f` — the two thickenings being the base
changes of `iB`, which are thickenings by **Stacks 0BPR** — and converted to the longhand reading
of Stacks 04YW by `.isQuasiDMWithRepresentableDiagonal_iff_isQuasiDM`, the representability of a
relative diagonal being free (**Stacks 04XS**, part (1)).

Local finite type holds for *both* 1-morphisms outright, with no appeal to the thickening: `pX'`
is locally of finite presentation, hence locally of finite type (**Stacks 0464**), and `houter`
identifies it with `f' ≫ pY'`, so `f'` is locally of finite type by the cancellation
**Stacks 06U9** (`.isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_comp`), which needs nothing of `pY'`. For `f` it is
the base change of that (**Stacks 06FU**), and it is not even needed: it is read off the
hypothesis in the forward direction and supplied by base change in the converse.

The condition on the fibres is where the thickening enters. `Spec` of a field is reduced, so a
field-valued point of the ambient target lifts along the thickening `𝒴 ⟶ 𝒴'` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_hom_comp_iso_of_isThickening_of_isReducedStack`, and the fibre of
`f'` over it is the fibre of `f` over the lift by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.discreteTopology_points_twoFibreProduct_of_isThickening_lift`; the
reducedness of the field's stack is the scheme case of **Stacks 04YF**.

The converse is base change in one step: **Stacks 06UB**, `.isLocallyQuasiFinite_baseChange`, at
the cartesian square `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.restrictedSourceSq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff_isLocallyQuasiFinite_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f ↔ IsLocallyQuasiFinite B S hS f'
declarations.comment: locally quasi-finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_iff_isMonomorphism_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Item (4) of Stacks 0CJC, monomorphism.** Under the
hypotheses of `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`, the restricted
1-morphism `f` is a monomorphism in the sense of **Stacks 04ZW** if and only if the ambient
1-morphism `f'` is.

Being a monomorphism is representability by algebraic spaces together with a condition of Stacks
04XB at the monomorphisms of algebraic spaces. The first conjunct transfers by item (12) of
**Stacks 0CJ9**, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isRepresentableByAlgebraicSpaces_inner_iff_outer`, read
on the morphism of thickenings whose ambient 1-morphism is `f'` and whose restricted one is `f`.
The second is `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.hasRelativeProperty_iff_of_pointTest` at
`CategoryTheory.MorphismProperty.monomorphisms`, whose point test is part (6) of **Stacks 0BPJ**,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mono_iff_of_cartesianSquareOfThickeningHoms`, which asks no flatness;
fppf-target-locality of the monomorphisms is **Stacks 042D** and stability under base change an
instance.

Item (12) of Stacks 0CJ9 is unconditional, so nothing beyond the source's own hypotheses is
carried in either direction.
declarations.statement:
theorem isMonomorphism_iff_isMonomorphism_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : Stack.IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (_hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (_hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    IsMonomorphism B S hS f ↔ IsMonomorphism B S hS f'
declarations.comment: monomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFinite_iff_isFinite_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Item (10) of Stacks 0CJC, finite.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`, the restricted 1-morphism `f`
is finite in the sense of **Stacks 03ZP** read through Stacks 03YK if and only if the ambient
1-morphism `f'` is.

The companion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isMonomorphism_iff_isMonomorphism_ambient` at
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finiteMorphismProperty`, whose point test is part (2) of **Stacks
0BPJ**, `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.finiteMorphismProperty_iff_of_cartesianSquareOfThickeningHoms`:
a morphism of algebraic spaces is finite exactly when it is proper and locally quasi-finite
(**Stacks 0A4X**), and both of those transfer across a cartesian square of thickenings with
locally-of-finite-type horizontals, with no flatness. Stability under base change and
fppf-target-locality (**Stacks 0426**) are both instances.

Representability of the two 1-morphisms comes from item (12) of Stacks 0CJ9 as in that theorem,
and is unconditional for the same reason.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinite_iff_isFinite_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : Stack.IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (_hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (_hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    IsFinite B S hS f ↔ IsFinite B S hS f'
declarations.comment: finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isEquivalence_iff_isEquivalence_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, isomorphism.** For a commutative diagram of thickenings of algebraic stacks over
`S` over a thickening `iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'` of bases, with `𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'` locally of finite type, `𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'`
flat and locally of finite presentation and the two restricted stacks the base changes of the
ambient ones along `iB`, the restricted 1-morphism `f` is an isomorphism if and only if the
ambient 1-morphism `f'` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquivalence_iff_isEquivalence_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f.hom).IsEquivalence ↔
      (CatFiberedInGroupoids.homFunctor f'.hom).IsEquivalence
declarations.comment: isomorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isOpenImmersion_iff_isOpenImmersion_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, open immersion.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isEquivalence_iff_isEquivalence_ambient`, the restricted
1-morphism `f` is an open immersion if and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isOpenImmersion_iff_isOpenImmersion_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    IsOpenImmersion B S hS f ↔ IsOpenImmersion B S hS f'
declarations.comment: open immersion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_isSyntomic_iff_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, syntomic.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isEquivalence_iff_isEquivalence_ambient`, the restricted
1-morphism `f` is syntomic — passes the existential smooth-diagram test of **Stacks 06FN** at
syntomicity of morphisms of algebraic spaces, which is how the source defines a syntomic
1-morphism of algebraic stacks — if and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram_isSyntomic_iff_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}
    {PX : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pX' iB} {PY : Bicategory.TwoCommSq pY' iB}
    {f : PX.pt ⟶ PY.pt} {f' : 𝒳' ⟶ 𝒴'}
    (hiB : IsThickening iB)
    (hcartX : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PX) (hcartY : Bicategory.IsTwoFibreProduct PY)
    (houter : f' ≫ pY' ≅ pX')
    (hrestrict : f ≫ PY.fst ≅ PX.fst ≫ f')
    (hinner : f ≫ PY.snd ≅ PX.snd)
    (hcoh : Bicategory.whiskerLeft f PY.iso.hom ≫ Bicategory.whiskerRight hinner.hom iB =
      Bicategory.whiskerRight hrestrict.hom pY' ≫
        Bicategory.whiskerLeft PX.fst houter.hom ≫ PX.iso.hom)
    (hYft : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS pY')
    (hXflat : IsFlat B S hS pX')
    (hXfp : IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS pX') :
    Stack.HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS
        (fun _ _ k => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k) f.hom ↔
      Stack.HasPropertyOnSomeSmoothDiagram B S hS
        (fun _ _ k => Space.IsSyntomic B S hS k) f'.hom
declarations.comment: syntomic

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isUnramified_iff_isUnramified_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, unramified.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`, the restricted 1-morphism
`f` is unramified if and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` is unramified.
declarations.statement:
theorem isUnramified_iff_isUnramified_ambient

declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJC, étale.** Under the hypotheses of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.AlgebraicStacks.isFlat_iff_isFlat_ambient`, the restricted 1-morphism
`f` is étale if and only if the ambient 1-morphism `f'` is étale.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_iff_isEtale_ambient
    {iB : ℬ ⟶ ℬ'} {pX' : 𝒳' ⟶ ℬ'} {pY' : 𝒴' ⟶ ℬ'}

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJP, the objects.** For a thickening `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` of algebraic stacks over `S` and
a smooth 1-morphism `x` from an algebraic space `W` to `𝒳`, a *smooth lift of an étale open of
`W`* consists of an algebraic space `U` étale over `W` through `a : U ⟶ W`, an algebraic space
`U'` containing it through `i : U ⟶ U'`, a smooth 1-morphism `x' : U' ⟶ 𝒳'`, and a 2-morphism
filling the square with sides `a`, `x`, `ι`, `i`, `x'` which exhibits it as the 2-fibre product
`U = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} U'`.

The last condition forces `i` to be a thickening, so no thickening hypothesis is imposed on
it.
declarations.statement:
structure EtaleSmoothLift (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {𝒳 𝒳' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳') (_hι : IsThickening ι)
    (W : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (x : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W ⟶ 𝒳)
    (_hx : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x)
declarations.comment: objects

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.Hom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJP, the morphisms.** A morphism of smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` from
`(U, U', a, i, x', α)` to `(V, V', b, j, y', β)` is a morphism `f : U ⟶ V` over `W`, a morphism
`f' : U' ⟶ V'` restricting to `f` on `U`, and a 2-morphism `γ : x' ⟶ y' ∘ f'` filling the
right-hand triangle, compatible with the two fillers in the sense that `i^*γ ∘ α = f^*β`.
declarations.statement: structure Hom (ξ η : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx)
declarations.comment: morphisms

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.instCategory
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJP, the category.** The smooth lifts of the étale opens of `W` along the
thickening `ι`, with the morphisms above, their identities and their composition.
declarations.statement: instance instCategory : Category (EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx)
declarations.comment: category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.proj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJP, the projection.** The functor sending a smooth lift to the étale open
`a : U ⟶ W` it lies over and a morphism of smooth lifts to its component `f : U ⟶ V`.
declarations.statement: def proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ Space.SpacesEtale B S hS W
declarations.comment: projection

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isThickening_inclusion
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJP, the inclusion of an object is a thickening.** For a smooth lift
`(U, U', a, i, x', α)` the 2-fibre product condition `U = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} U'` exhibits `i : U ⟶ U'` as
the base change of the thickening `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` along `x' : U' ⟶ 𝒳'`, so `i` is a thickening by
**Stacks 0BPR**, `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isThickening_baseChange`.

This is the source's "In particular `U ⊂ U'` is a thickening", which Remark 0CJP asserts and
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.Stacks.LiftingAffinesCategory` records only in prose; Stacks 0CJU
re-uses it as "above we have already shown that there is a thickening `i : U ⟶ U'`". The
conclusion is read in the 2-category of algebraic stacks, that is for the 1-morphism which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.algebraicSpaceStackFunctor` attaches to `i`; see the implementation
notes for why it cannot yet be read as `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsThickeningHom` on `i`
itself.
declarations.statement:
theorem isThickening_inclusion (ξ : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) :
    IsThickening ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map ξ.inclusion)
declarations.comment: the inclusion of an object is a thickening

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.Hom.isEtale_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJS.** For a morphism `(f, f', γ)` of smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` along the
thickening `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` (**Stacks 0CJP**), from `(U, U', a, i, x', α)` to
`(V, V', b, j, y', β)`, the component `f' : U' ⟶ V'` between the ambient algebraic spaces is
étale.

As in the source: `f` is étale as a morphism of the spaces-étale site of `W`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isEtale_base`, **Stacks 03FV**), and the étale clause
of **Stacks 0CJC** applies
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.isEtale_of_isTwoFibreProduct_of_isThickening`), because `x'` and `y'`
are smooth — hence flat and locally of finite presentation, resp. locally of finite type — and
`U = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} U'`, `V = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} V'` are the `isTwoFibreProduct` fields of the two smooth
lifts.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_ambient (ξ η : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) (m : ξ ⟶ η) :
    Space.IsEtale B S hS (Hom.ambient m).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isEtale_ambient
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJS.** For a morphism `(f, f', γ)` of smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` along the
thickening `ι`, the component `f' : U' ⟶ V'` between the ambient algebraic spaces is étale.

The hypothesis `hCJC` is the étale clause, item (9), of **Stacks 0CJC** for the thickening `ι`,
written out for a morphism of two cartesian squares over `ι` whose right-hand legs come from
algebraic spaces: given that the target's leg `y'` is locally of finite type, that the source's
leg `x'` is flat and locally of finite presentation, that the two squares are 2-fibre products,
and that `(f, f', γ)` is a morphism of them over `𝒳'`, étaleness of `f` gives étaleness of `f'`.
See the implementation notes for why that clause is not available from the three formalized clauses
of 0CJC.

Everything 0CJC asks for is supplied here from the two smooth lifts and the morphism between
them: the squares are their `isTwoFibreProduct` fields, the restriction equation, the comparison
2-morphism and its coherence are the fields of the morphism, and the three conditions on `x'`
and `y'` follow from smoothness of the ambient maps — local finite presentation by
**Stacks 0DNP**, local finite type by **Stacks 06Q5** on top of it, and flatness by
monotonicity of the smooth-diagram criterion. Étaleness of `f` is `isEtale_base`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_ambient
    (hCJC : ∀ (U U' V V' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (i : U ⟶ U') (j : V ⟶ V')
      (u : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U ⟶ 𝒳)
      (v : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V ⟶ 𝒳)
      (x' : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U' ⟶ 𝒳')
      (y' : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V' ⟶ 𝒳')
      (α : u ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ≫ x')
      (β : v ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j ≫ y'),
      IsTwoFibreProduct
          (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U, u,
            (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i, α⟩ : TwoCommSq ι x') →
        IsTwoFibreProduct
            (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V, v,
              (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j, β⟩ : TwoCommSq ι y') →
          AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS x' →
            AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS x' →
              AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS y' →
                ∀ (f : U ⟶ V) (f' : U' ⟶ V')
                  (hL : u ≫ ι = (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map f ≫ (v ≫ ι)),
                  i ≫ f' = f ≫ j →
                    ∀ (γ : x' ⟶ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map f' ≫ y')
                      (hR : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map f ≫
                          ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j ≫ y') =
                        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ≫
                          ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map f' ≫ y')),
                      α.hom ≫ ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ◁ γ) =
                          eqToHom hL ≫
                            ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map f ◁ β.hom) ≫ eqToHom hR →
                        Space.IsEtale B S hS f.hom → Space.IsEtale B S hS f'.hom)
    (ξ η : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) (m : ξ ⟶ η) :
    Space.IsEtale B S hS (Hom.ambient m).hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isFiberedInGroupoids_proj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJT.** The category of smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` along the thickening
`ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` (**Stacks 0CJP**), projected to the spaces-étale site of `W`, is fibred in
groupoids (**Stacks 003S**).

Both conditions of Stacks 003S are proved outright, with no hypothesis beyond those of
Stacks 0CJP. Existence of lifts is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.exists_hom_isHomLift`, the source's construction of
`f^*ξ` from the topological invariance of the étale site along the thickening `U ⊂ U'`. Unique
fill-ins hold for *every* pair of morphisms with a common target, which is what Stacks 003S asks
and is stronger than the source's strongly cartesian verification for its chosen pullbacks
together with its groupoid-fibre argument: for `φ : η ⟶ ξ`, `ψ : ζ ⟶ ξ` and `h` with
`φ ∘ h = ψ` on the base, the fill-in is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.fillIn` — its ambient component comes from fullness of
the étale base change along `U ⊂ U'` (**Stacks 05ZH**, the source's **Stacks 07VW**), applied to
the cartesian squares of `φ` and `ψ` and to their ambient components, étale by **Stacks 0CJS** —
and it is unique by faithfulness of that base change and invertibility of the comparison
2-morphism of `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiberedInGroupoids_proj :
    (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _).IsFiberedInGroupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.fiber_isGroupoid
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJT, the fibre categories are groupoids.** A morphism of the fibre over an étale
open `U` of `W` lies over the identity of `U`, so its base component is invertible; its ambient
component is then invertible by `hiso`, and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isIso_of_isIso_components` makes the morphism itself
invertible.

The hypothesis `hiso` is the isomorphism clause of **Stacks 0CJC** for the thickening `ι`,
written out for this category: if the base component of a morphism of smooth lifts is an
isomorphism then so is its ambient component. It is carried because that clause of 0CJC is not
available here — see the implementation notes — and **Stacks 0CJC** is the tag that would
discharge it.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiber_isGroupoid
    (hiso : ∀ (ζ ζ' : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) (n : ζ ⟶ ζ'),
      IsIso (Hom.base n) → IsIso (Hom.ambient n))
    (U : Space.SpacesEtale B S hS W) :
    IsGroupoid ((proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _).Fiber U)
declarations.comment: the fibre categories are groupoids

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJT.** The category of smooth lifts of the étale opens of `W` along the thickening
`ι`, projected to the spaces-étale site of `W`, is fibred in groupoids. The fibre categories are
groupoids by `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.fiber_isGroupoid`, and that together with
the fibred-category half gives the conclusion by **Stacks 003V**.

Two hypotheses are carried. The first, `hiso`, is the isomorphism clause of **Stacks 0CJC** for
`ι`; see `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.fiber_isGroupoid`. The second, `hfib`, is that
the projection is a fibred category, which is **Stacks 02XM** in the source's own words, stated
here as `CategoryTheory.Functor.IsFibredCategory` and converted to Mathlib's class by
`CategoryTheory.Functor.isFibredCategory_iff_isFibered`: every morphism of the spaces-étale site
of `W` has a strongly cartesian lift. It is carried because its substantive input is the
topological invariance of the small étale site along an arbitrary thickening, **Stacks 07VW**,
which is not available here — every available form of it asks the thickening to be first order — and
because the source omits the strongly cartesian verification itself. **Stacks 07VW** is the tag
that would discharge it; see the implementation notes for the full evidence. What `hfib` supplies
is existence of strongly cartesian lifts; the uniqueness of fill-ins demanded by **Stacks 003S**
is supplied by the groupoid-fibre half proved here.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFiberedInGroupoids
    (hiso : ∀ (ζ ζ' : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) (n : ζ ⟶ ζ'),
      IsIso (Hom.base n) → IsIso (Hom.ambient n))
    (hfib : (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _).IsFibredCategory) :
    (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _).IsFiberedInGroupoids
declarations.comment: fibred in groupoids, granted the fibred-category half

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isStackInGroupoids_proj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJU.** The category `p : 𝒞 ⟶ W_{spaces, étale}` of smooth lifts constructed in
Stacks 0CJP is a stack in groupoids: the three conditions of Stacks 02ZI, for covering families
indexed by an arbitrary universe `t`.

There is no hypothesis beyond those of Stacks 0CJP. Condition (1) is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isFiberedInGroupoids_proj` (Stacks 0CJT); conditions
(2) and (3) come from `AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isStack_proj` through
`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsStack.isStackInGroupoids`. See the module docstring for the proof of
effectivity.
declarations.statement:
theorem isStackInGroupoids_proj :
    Functor.IsStackInGroupoids.{t} (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _)
      (Space.SpacesEtale.topology B S hS W)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isEtale_relation
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJU, the two legs of the relation are étale.** Both `s_{kk'}` and `t_{kk'}` are
ambient components of morphisms of the category of smooth lifts, so **Stacks 0CJS** applies to
each of them.

The hypothesis `hCJC` is the one carried by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isEtale_ambient`: the étale clause, item (9), of
**Stacks 0CJC** for the thickening `ι`, which is not available in this library.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEtale_relation
    (hCJC : ∀ (U U' V' V'' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (i : U ⟶ U') (j : V' ⟶ V'')
      (u : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U ⟶ 𝒳)
      (v : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V' ⟶ 𝒳)
      (y : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U' ⟶ 𝒳')
      (y' : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V'' ⟶ 𝒳')
      (α : u ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ≫ y)
      (β : v ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j ≫ y'),
      IsTwoFibreProduct
          (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj U, u,
            (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i, α⟩ : TwoCommSq ι y) →
        IsTwoFibreProduct
            (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj V', v,
              (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j, β⟩ : TwoCommSq ι y') →
          AlgebraicStacks.IsFlat B S hS y →
            AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS y →
              AlgebraicStacks.IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS y' →
                ∀ (g : U ⟶ V') (g' : U' ⟶ V'')
                  (hL : u ≫ ι = (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g ≫ (v ≫ ι)),
                  i ≫ g' = g ≫ j →
                    ∀ (γ : y ⟶ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g' ≫ y')
                      (hR : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g ≫
                          ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map j ≫ y') =
                        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ≫
                          ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g' ≫ y')),
                      α.hom ≫ ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ◁ γ) =
                          eqToHom hL ≫
                            ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g ◁ β.hom) ≫ eqToHom hR →
                        Space.IsEtale B S hS g.hom → Space.IsEtale B S hS g'.hom)
    (k k' : K) :
    Space.IsEtale B S hS (relationFst D k k').hom ∧
      Space.IsEtale B S hS (relationSnd D k k').hom
declarations.comment: the two legs of the relation are étale

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.relation_refl
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJU, reflexivity of the relation.** A fibre automorphism `e` of `ξ_k` which is the
pullback along the diagonal `Δ : U_k ⟶ U_k ×_U U_k ×_U U_k` of each of the three gluing
isomorphisms of the triple `(k, k, k)` has identity ambient component. This is the first
identity of **Stacks 026C** read on the ambient spaces.

The hypotheses `hiso` and `hfib` are the two carried by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isFiberedInGroupoids` (**Stacks 0CJT**), which is where
the fibred-in-groupoids hypothesis of Stacks 026C comes from.
declarations.statement:
theorem relation_refl
    (hiso : ∀ (ζ ζ' : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx) (n : ζ ⟶ ζ'),
      IsIso (Hom.base n) → IsIso (Hom.ambient n))
    (hfib : (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _).IsFibredCategory)
    (k : K) {d : V k ⟶ Vijk k k k}
    {hd₁ : 𝟙 (V k) = d ≫ q₁ k k k} {hd₂ : 𝟙 (V k) = d ≫ q₂ k k k}
    {hd₃ : 𝟙 (V k) = d ≫ q₃ k k k}
    {e : D.x k ⟶ D.x k}
    (he : Functor.FibreHom (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _)
      (D.x k) (D.x k) (D.hx k) (D.hx k) e)
    (heij : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d hd₁ hd₂
      (D.wi k k k) (D.wj k k k)
      (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k)) (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k))
      (D.αij k k k) e)
    (hejk : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d hd₂ hd₃
      (D.wj k k k) (D.wk k k k)
      (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k)) (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k))
      (D.αjk k k k) e)
    (heik : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d hd₁ hd₃
      (D.wi k k k) (D.wk k k k)
      (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k)) (Functor.Restriction.id _ (D.x k) (D.hx k))
      (D.αik k k k) e) :
    ambientSpaceFunctor.map e = 𝟙 (D.x k).ambient
declarations.comment: reflexivity of the relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.relation_symm
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJU, symmetry of the relation.** Over the overlap `U_k ×_U U_{k'}` the gluing
isomorphism `φ_{kk'}` and the pullback `σ^*φ_{k'k}` of `φ_{k'k}` along the switching morphism
have mutually inverse ambient components: this is the second identity of **Stacks 026C** read on
the ambient spaces, and it is the source's observation that `φ_{kk'}⁻¹` is the flip of
`φ_{k'k}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relation_symm (k k' : K) {d₁₃ : Vij k k' ⟶ Vijk k k' k}
    {hd₁ : pr₁ k k' = d₁₃ ≫ q₁ k k' k} {hd₂ : pr₂ k k' = d₁₃ ≫ q₂ k k' k}
    {hd₃ : pr₁ k k' = d₁₃ ≫ q₃ k k' k}
    {σφ : (D.xrji k k').pt ⟶ (D.xrij k k').pt}
    (hσφ : Functor.FibreHom (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _)
      (D.xrji k k').pt (D.xrij k k').pt (D.xrji k k').hpt (D.xrij k k').hpt σφ)
    (hij : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d₁₃ hd₁ hd₂
      (D.wi k k' k) (D.wj k k' k) (D.xrij k k') (D.xrji k k') (D.αij k k' k) (D.φ k k'))
    (hji : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d₁₃ hd₂ hd₃
      (D.wj k k' k) (D.wk k k' k) (D.xrji k k') (D.xrij k k') (D.αjk k k' k) σφ)
    (hik : Functor.IsRestrictionOf (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _) d₁₃ hd₁ hd₃
      (D.wi k k' k) (D.wk k k' k) (D.xrij k k') (D.xrij k k') (D.αik k k' k)
      (𝟙 (D.xrij k k').pt)) :
    ambientSpaceFunctor.map (D.φ k k') ≫ ambientSpaceFunctor.map σφ =
      𝟙 (D.xrij k k').pt.ambient
declarations.comment: symmetry of the relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.relation_trans
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJU, transitivity of the relation.** Over the triple overlap the cocycle condition
of the descent datum says that the gluing isomorphism from `ξ_k` to `ξ_{k''}` is the composite
of the ones from `ξ_k` to `ξ_{k'}` and from `ξ_{k'}` to `ξ_{k''}`; the same therefore holds of
their ambient components. This is the source's transitivity of the relation.
declarations.statement:
theorem relation_trans (k k' k'' : K) :
    ambientSpaceFunctor.map (D.αik k k' k'') =
      ambientSpaceFunctor.map (D.αij k k' k'') ≫ ambientSpaceFunctor.map (D.αjk k k' k'')
declarations.comment: transitivity of the relation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_etaleCovering_etaleSmoothLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJV, the covering.** Let `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` be a thickening of algebraic stacks over
`S`, let `W` be an algebraic space over `S` and let `x : W ⟶ 𝒳` be a smooth 1-morphism. Let
`p : V₀ ⟶ W` be a smooth morphism of algebraic spaces which is surjective on points, and suppose
that every affine scheme of the site which is étale over `W` through a morphism factoring through
`p` carries a smooth lift of that étale open along `ι`. Then there is a family of smooth lifts of
étale opens of `W` along `ι` whose bases form an étale covering of `W`.

The hypothesis `hlift` stands in for Steps 2–4 of the source's proof, which construct the lift
over one affine member of the covering: the immersion of the affine member into an affine space
over the chart is a Koszul-regular immersion, its equations lift to the ambient chart of `𝒳'`,
and the closed subspace they cut out there is smooth over `𝒳'` by **Stacks 0CER**. The covering
itself is not assumed: it is produced from `p` by **Stacks 0CFV**, and the members are shrunk to
affine opens.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_etaleCovering_etaleSmoothLift
    {𝒳 𝒳' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳') (hι : IsThickening ι)
    (W : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (x : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W ⟶ 𝒳)
    (hx : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x)
    (V₀ : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (p : V₀ ⟶ W)
    (hp : Space.IsSmooth B S hS p.hom)
    (hpsurj : Function.Surjective (Space.pointsMap B S hS V₀.obj p.hom))
    (hlift : ∀ (T : BigFppfOver B S hS), IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj T) →
      ∀ (t : yoneda.obj T ⟶ W.obj) (ht : Space.IsEtale B S hS t),
        (∃ s : yoneda.obj T ⟶ V₀.obj, s ≫ p.hom = t) →
          ∃ ξ : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx,
            ξ.base = Space.SpacesEtale.ofRepresentable B S hS W T t ht) :
    ∃ (J : Type (u + 1)) (ξ : J → EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx),
      Space.IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun j => ((ξ j).base.obj.left).obj)
        (fun j => ((ξ j).base.obj.hom).hom)
declarations.comment: the covering, from the lifts over the affine members

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isEtaleCovering_etaleSmoothLift
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJV.** Let `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` be a thickening of algebraic stacks over `S`, let `W` be an
algebraic space over `S` and let `x : W ⟶ 𝒳` be a smooth 1-morphism. Then there is a family of
smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` along `ι` whose bases form an étale covering of `W`: an étale
covering `{W_j ⟶ W}` with cartesian squares `W_j = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} W'_j` and `W'_j ⟶ 𝒳'` smooth.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isEtaleCovering_etaleSmoothLift
    {𝒳 𝒳' : AlgebraicStacks.{u, w} B S hS} (ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳') (hι : IsThickening ι)
    (W : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (x : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor.{u, w} B S hS).obj W ⟶ 𝒳)
    (hx : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x) :
    ∃ (J : Type (u + 1)) (ξ : J → EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx),
      Space.IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun j => ((ξ j).base.obj.left).obj)
        (fun j => ((ξ j).base.obj.hom).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.exists_isEtaleCovering_ambientComparison
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJW.** Let `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` be a thickening of algebraic stacks over `S` and let
`W = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} W'` and `W = 𝒳 ×_{𝒳'} W''` be two 2-fibre products, along `x' : W' ⟶ 𝒳'` and
`x'' : W'' ⟶ 𝒳'`, with `W`, `W'`, `W''` algebraic spaces, inclusions `i : W ⟶ W'`,
`i'' : W ⟶ W''`, fillers `α'`, `α''` and the vertical 1-morphisms `x`, `x'`, `x''` smooth. Then
there are an étale covering `{f'_k : W'_k ⟶ W'}`, étale morphisms `f''_k : W'_k ⟶ W''` and
2-isomorphisms `γ_k : x'' ∘ f''_k ≅ x' ∘ f'_k` such that, for each `k`, a single algebraic space
`U` with `e : U ⟶ W'_k` and `g : U ⟶ W` is a pullback both of `i` along `f'_k` and of `i''` along
`f''_k` — that is, `(f'_k)⁻¹(W) = (f''_k)⁻¹(W)` and the two restrictions to it agree — and `γ_k`
restricted to `U` is the filler `α''⁻¹ ≫ α'` of the given diagram over `W`, restricted along `g`.

This is `exists_isEtaleCovering_ambientComparison_of_lifting` at Stacks 0CHJ,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isEtaleCovering_lift_of_isSmooth_of_isThickeningHom`. The
smoothness of `x` is part of the source's hypotheses and is not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isEtaleCovering_ambientComparison
    (hι : IsThickening ι) {W W' W'' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    {x : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W ⟶ 𝒳}
    {x' : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W' ⟶ 𝒳'}
    {x'' : (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W'' ⟶ 𝒳'}
    (hx : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x) (hx' : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x')
    (hx'' : AlgebraicStacks.IsSmooth B S hS x'')
    {i : W ⟶ W'} {i'' : W ⟶ W''}
    {α' : x ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i ≫ x'}
    {α'' : x ≫ ι ≅ (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i'' ≫ x''}
    (h' : IsTwoFibreProduct (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W, x,
        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i, α'⟩ : TwoCommSq ι x'))
    (h'' : IsTwoFibreProduct (⟨(algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).obj W, x,
        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map i'', α''⟩ : TwoCommSq ι x'')) :
    ∃ (K : Type (u + 1)) (V : K → AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (f' : ∀ k, V k ⟶ W')
      (f'' : ∀ k, V k ⟶ W'')
      (γ : ∀ k, (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map (f'' k) ≫ x'' ≅
        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map (f' k) ≫ x'),
      Space.IsEtaleCovering B S hS (fun k => (V k).obj) (fun k => (f' k).hom) ∧
      (∀ k, Space.IsEtale B S hS (f'' k).hom) ∧
      ∀ k, ∃ (U : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (e : U ⟶ V k) (g : U ⟶ W)
        (h₁ : IsPullback g e i (f' k)) (h₂ : IsPullback g e i'' (f'' k)),
        (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map e ◁ (γ k).hom =
          eqToHom (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor_map_comp_whisker_eq h₂.w.symm x'') ≫
            ((algebraicSpaceStackFunctor B S hS).map g ◁ (α''.inv ≫ α'.hom)) ≫
            eqToHom (algebraicSpaceStackFunctor_map_comp_whisker_eq h₁.w x')

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Stack.EtaleSmoothLift.isGerbe_proj
declarations.doc:
The category `p : 𝒞 ⟶ W_{spaces, étale}` of smooth lifts of étale opens of `W` along the
thickening `ι : 𝒳 ⟶ 𝒳'` constructed in Stacks 0CJP is a gerbe (Stacks 06NZ), for covering
families indexed by an arbitrary universe `t` in the stack condition.
declarations.statement:
theorem isGerbe_proj :
    Functor.IsGerbe.{t} (proj : EtaleSmoothLift B S hS ι hι W x hx ⥤ _)
      (Space.SpacesEtale.topology B S hS W)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJY, with no hypothesis on the universes.** Let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a gerbe over the site
`(𝒞, J)`: fibred in groupoids, a stack, locally nonempty and locally connected. Assume that for
every `U` and every object `x` of the fibre `𝒮_U` the sheaf of groups
`Aut(x) = Isom(x, x) = Mor(x, x)` on `𝒞/U` is abelian, that is that the endomorphisms of every
object of every fibre commute. Then there are

1. a sheaf `𝒢` of abelian groups on `𝒞`, and
2. for every `U` and every object `x` of `𝒮_U` an isomorphism `θ x : 𝒢|_U ≅ Aut(x)` of sheaves of
   groups on `𝒞/U`, that is an isomorphism of presheaves whose components are multiplicative,

such that for every `U` and every morphism `φ : x ⟶ y` of `𝒮_U` conjugation by `φ` carries `θ x` to
`θ y`: on sections over `g : V ⟶ U` one has `θ y a = φ|_V ∘ θ x a ∘ (φ|_V)⁻¹`.

`𝒢` is the band, `CategoryTheory.Gerbe.Band`, which lives in `Type (max u₁ v₁ v₂)` and not in the
universe `v₂` of `Aut(x)`; the isomorphism of (2) is therefore stated against the universe lift of
`Aut(x)`, which is what makes the statement true in every universe. See
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self` for the unlifted form, which needs
`UnivLE.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}` and is false without it.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞)
    (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hst : p.IsStack J)
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (hlc : p.LocallyConnected J)
    (habel : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (α β : x ⟶ x), α ≫ β = β ≫ α) :
    haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    haveI : ∀ U : 𝒞, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber U) := hp.fiber_isGroupoid
    ∃ (𝒢 : Sheaf J CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})
      (θ : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U),
        (Over.forget U).op ⋙ 𝒢.obj ⋙ forget CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ≅
          p.morPresheaf x x ⋙ uliftFunctor.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}),
      (∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (g : Over U) (a b : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) (a * b)).down =
            ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) a).down ≫ ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) b).down) ∧
        ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x y : p.Fiber U) (φ : x ⟶ y) (g : Over U) (a : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ U y).hom.app (op g) a).down =
            pullbackFiberHom (CategoryTheory.inv φ) g.hom ≫ ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) a).down ≫
              pullbackFiberHom φ g.hom

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJY.** Let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a gerbe over the site `(𝒞, J)` whose automorphism sheaves
are abelian. Then there are a sheaf `𝒢` of abelian groups on `𝒞` and, for every `U` and every
object `x` of the fibre `𝒮_U`, an isomorphism `θ x : 𝒢|_U ≅ Aut(x)` of sheaves of groups on `𝒞/U`,
and these are compatible with conjugation.

The hypothesis `UnivLE.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}` is what makes `𝒢` exist in the universe `v₂` of the
morphisms of `𝒮`, and it cannot be dropped: `Type 0`-many copies of a nontrivial `ℤ/2`-gerbe give a
band whose sections at the top object have cardinality `2 ^ |Type 0|`, which is the cardinality of
no `Type 0`. Without it the statement still holds in the form
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor`, with `Aut(x)` lifted into
the universe `𝒢` is valued in.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self [UnivLE.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}] (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞)
    (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hst : p.IsStack J)
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (hlc : p.LocallyConnected J)
    (habel : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (α β : x ⟶ x), α ≫ β = β ≫ α) :
    haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    haveI : ∀ U : 𝒞, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber U) := hp.fiber_isGroupoid
    ∃ (𝒢 : Sheaf J CommGrpCat.{v₂})
      (θ : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U),
        (Over.forget U).op ⋙ 𝒢.obj ⋙ forget CommGrpCat.{v₂} ≅ p.morPresheaf x x),
      (∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (g : Over U) (a b : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          (θ U x).hom.app (op g) (a * b) =
            (θ U x).hom.app (op g) a ≫ (θ U x).hom.app (op g) b) ∧
        ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x y : p.Fiber U) (φ : x ⟶ y) (g : Over U) (a : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          (θ U y).hom.app (op g) a =
            pullbackFiberHom (CategoryTheory.inv φ) g.hom ≫ (θ U x).hom.app (op g) a ≫
              pullbackFiberHom φ g.hom

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor_base
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CJY, with the compatibility of the comparisons over varying base object.** Let
`p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be a gerbe over the site `(𝒞, J)` whose automorphism sheaves are abelian. Then there
are a sheaf `𝒢` of abelian groups on `𝒞` and, for every `U` and every object `x` of the fibre
`𝒮_U`, an isomorphism `θ x : 𝒢|_U ≅ Aut(x)` of sheaves of groups on `𝒞/U`, such that

1. each `θ x` is multiplicative on sections,
2. for `φ : x ⟶ y` in `𝒮_U`, conjugation by `φ` carries `θ x` to `θ y`, and
3. `θ x` read on sections over `g : Over U` is `θ (x|_g)` read on sections over the identity of
   `g.left`, conjugated by the contraction of the chosen pullback along that identity.

Clauses (1) and (2) are the conclusion of Stacks 0CJY as the source states it, so this is
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor` with (3) added. Clause (3)
is the compatibility of the local comparisons over varying `U` whose verification the source's
proof omits; for the band it is `CategoryTheory.Gerbe.Band.fiberHom_pullbackFiber_base`, the
naturality of a band section. It is what makes "the sheaf of abelian groups constructed in Stacks
0CJY" pin `𝒢` down well enough to use it as the coefficient sheaf of Stacks 0CK0, so that no
hypothesis of
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_band_nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing` has to be assumed.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor_base (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞)
    (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞) (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hst : p.IsStack J)
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (hlc : p.LocallyConnected J)
    (habel : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (α β : x ⟶ x), α ≫ β = β ≫ α) :
    haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    haveI : ∀ U : 𝒞, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber U) := hp.fiber_isGroupoid
    ∃ (𝒢 : Sheaf J CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})
      (θ : ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U),
        (Over.forget U).op ⋙ 𝒢.obj ⋙ forget CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ≅
          p.morPresheaf x x ⋙ uliftFunctor.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}),
      (∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (g : Over U) (a b : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) (a * b)).down =
            ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) a).down ≫ ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) b).down) ∧
        (∀ (U : 𝒞) (x y : p.Fiber U) (φ : x ⟶ y) (g : Over U) (a : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ U y).hom.app (op g) a).down =
            pullbackFiberHom (CategoryTheory.inv φ) g.hom ≫ ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) a).down ≫
              pullbackFiberHom φ g.hom) ∧
        ∀ (U : 𝒞) (x : p.Fiber U) (g : Over U) (a : 𝒢.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ U x).hom.app (op g) a).down =
            (pullbackFiberIdIso (pullbackFiber p x g.hom)).inv ≫
              ((θ g.left (pullbackFiber p x g.hom)).hom.app (op (Over.mk (𝟙 g.left))) a).down ≫
                (pullbackFiberIdIso (pullbackFiber p x g.hom)).hom

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CK0.** Let `p : S ⥤ C` be a gerbe over the site `(C, J)` — fibred in groupoids, a
stack, locally nonempty, locally connected — and let `G` be the sheaf of abelian groups
constructed in Stacks 0CJY: an abelian sheaf given with comparisons `θ y : G|_V ≅ Aut(y)`, one
for every object `y` of every fibre, multiplicative and compatible with conjugation and with base
change. Let `U` be an object of `C` such that

1. there is a cofinal system `Cov` of coverings of `U` — a set of covering families refining every
   covering sieve of `U` — with `H¹(U_i, G) = 0` for every member `U_i` of every family in it and
   `H¹(U_i ×_U U_j, G) = 0` for every pair of members, and
2. `H²(U, G) = 0`.

Then there is an object of `S` lying over `U`.

That the automorphism sheaves of the gerbe are abelian needs no separate hypothesis: each `θ y` is
a multiplicative isomorphism onto `Aut(y)` from a sheaf of abelian groups, so `Aut(y)` is abelian.
For the form in which `G` and its comparisons are produced rather than assumed, see
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_band_nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing
    {C : Type u₁} {S : Type u₂}
    [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} S]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (p : S ⥤ C)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hst : p.IsStack J)
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (hlc : p.LocallyConnected J)
    [∀ X : C, HasSheafify (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂}]
    [∀ X : C, HasExt.{x} (Sheaf (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})]
    (G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})
    (hBand :
      haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
      haveI : ∀ V : C, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber V) := hp.fiber_isGroupoid
      ∃ (θ : ∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V),
          (Over.forget V).op ⋙ G.obj ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.toCommGrp.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ⋙
              forget CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ≅
            p.morPresheaf y y ⋙ uliftFunctor.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}),
        (∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V) (g : Over V) (a b : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a + b))).down =
            ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
              ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd b)).down) ∧
        (∀ (V : C) (y z : p.Fiber V) (φ : y ⟶ z) (g : Over V)
            (a : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V z).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down =
            Functor.pullbackFiberHom (CategoryTheory.inv φ) g.hom ≫
              ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
                Functor.pullbackFiberHom φ g.hom) ∧
        (∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V) (g : Over V)
            (a : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down =
            (Functor.pullbackFiberIdIso (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).inv ≫
              ((θ g.left (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).hom.app
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 g.left))) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
                  (Functor.pullbackFiberIdIso (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).hom))
    (U : C) (Cov : Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U))
    (hCover : ∀ E ∈ Cov, E.sieve₀ ∈ J U)
    (hCofinal : ∀ R ∈ J U, ∃ E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U,
      E ∈ Cov ∧ E.sieve₀ ≤ R)
    (hPullback : ∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U), E ∈ Cov →
      ∀ i j : E.I₀, HasPullback (E.f i) (E.f j))
    (hH1 : ∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U), E ∈ Cov →
      ∀ i : E.I₀, Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over (E.X i)) 1))
    (hH1pair : ∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U) (hE : E ∈ Cov)
      (i j : E.I₀),
      let : HasPullback (E.f i) (E.f j) := hPullback E hE i j
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over (pullback (E.f i) (E.f j))) 1))
    (hH2 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over U) 2)) :
    Nonempty (p.Fiber U)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_band_nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CK0, with nothing assumed.** Let `p : S ⥤ C` be a gerbe over the site `(C, J)` whose
automorphism sheaves are abelian. Then there are a sheaf `G` of abelian groups on `C` and
comparisons `θ y : G|_V ≅ Aut(y)` — that is, the sheaf constructed in Stacks 0CJY, together with
the data that identifies it: multiplicativity, compatibility with conjugation, and compatibility
over varying base object — such that for every object `U` of `C` with

1. a cofinal system `Cov` of coverings of `U` whose members `U_i` have `H¹(U_i, G) = 0` and whose
   pairs of members have `H¹(U_i ×_U U_j, G) = 0`, and
2. `H²(U, G) = 0`

there is an object of `S` lying over `U`.

This is `CategoryTheory.Gerbe.nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing` with its hypothesis on `G`
discharged: `G` is here the band of
`CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_sheaf_iso_morPresheaf_self_uliftFunctor_base`, carried from
`CommGrpCat` to `AddCommGrpCat` — the universe in which `Sheaf.H` takes its coefficients — along
`commGroupAddCommGroupEquivalence`, whose unit and counit are `Iso.refl`, so the comparisons
transport unchanged. No hypothesis of this statement is the conclusion of another tag.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_band_nonempty_fiber_of_cohomology_vanishing
    {C : Type u₁} {S : Type u₂}
    [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} S]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (p : S ⥤ C)
    (hp : p.IsFiberedInGroupoids) (hst : p.IsStack J)
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (hlc : p.LocallyConnected J)
    (habel : ∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V) (α β : y ⟶ y), α ≫ β = β ≫ α)
    [∀ X : C, HasSheafify (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂}]
    [∀ X : C, HasExt.{x} (Sheaf (J.over X) AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})] :
    haveI : p.IsFibered := hp.isFibered
    haveI : ∀ V : C, IsGroupoid (p.Fiber V) := hp.fiber_isGroupoid
    ∃ (G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂})
      (θ : ∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V),
        (Over.forget V).op ⋙ G.obj ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.toCommGrp.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ⋙
            forget CommGrpCat.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} ≅
          p.morPresheaf y y ⋙ uliftFunctor.{max u₁ v₁, v₂}),
      (∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V) (g : Over V) (a b : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd (a + b))).down =
            ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
              ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd b)).down) ∧
        (∀ (V : C) (y z : p.Fiber V) (φ : y ⟶ z) (g : Over V)
            (a : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V z).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down =
            Functor.pullbackFiberHom (CategoryTheory.inv φ) g.hom ≫
              ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
                Functor.pullbackFiberHom φ g.hom) ∧
        (∀ (V : C) (y : p.Fiber V) (g : Over V)
            (a : G.obj.obj (op g.left)),
          ((θ V y).hom.app (op g) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down =
            (Functor.pullbackFiberIdIso (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).inv ≫
              ((θ g.left (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).hom.app
                (op (Over.mk (𝟙 g.left))) (Multiplicative.ofAdd a)).down ≫
                  (Functor.pullbackFiberIdIso (p.pullbackFiber y g.hom)).hom) ∧
        ∀ (U : C) (Cov : Set (PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U)),
          (∀ E ∈ Cov, E.sieve₀ ∈ J U) →
          (∀ R ∈ J U, ∃ E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U, E ∈ Cov ∧ E.sieve₀ ≤ R) →
          ∀ hPullback : ∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U), E ∈ Cov →
              ∀ i j : E.I₀, HasPullback (E.f i) (E.f j),
            (∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U), E ∈ Cov →
              ∀ i : E.I₀, Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over (E.X i)) 1)) →
            (∀ (E : PreZeroHypercover.{max u₁ v₁ v₂} U) (hE : E ∈ Cov) (i j : E.I₀),
              let : HasPullback (E.f i) (E.f j) := hPullback E hE i j
              Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over (pullback (E.f i) (E.f j))) 1)) →
            Subsingleton (Sheaf.H (G.over U) 2) → Nonempty (p.Fiber U)

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Gerbe.exists_covering_fiber_nonempty_of_cofinal_h1_isZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CK0, the refinement step.** Let `p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞` be locally nonempty for `J` — clause
(2) of the definition of a gerbe, Stacks 06NZ — let `𝒢` be an abelian sheaf on `(𝒞, J)`, and let
`U` be an object of `𝒞` satisfying hypothesis (1) of Stacks 0CK0: there is a cofinal system of
coverings of `U`, that is a family of covering families refining every covering sieve of `U`,
each member `U_i` of which has `H¹(U_i, 𝒢) = 0` and each double overlap `U_i ×_U U_j` of which
has `H¹(U_i ×_U U_j, 𝒢) = 0`.

Then there is a covering family `{U_i → U}` with all of that vanishing which in addition carries
an object of `𝒮` over every member.

This is the source's "Choose a covering `{U_i → U}` and objects `x_i` of `𝒮` over `U_i`. By
assumption (1) we may choose the covering such that `H¹(U_i, 𝒢) = 0` and
`H¹(U_i ×_U U_j, 𝒢) = 0`." Local nonemptiness supplies a covering sieve of `U` along every arrow
of which the fibre of `p` is nonempty; cofinality refines it to a member of the system, whose
every arrow `U_i → U` lies in that sieve.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_covering_fiber_nonempty_of_cofinal_h1_isZero
    (p : 𝒮 ⥤ 𝒞) (J : GrothendieckTopology 𝒞)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v₁}] [HasExt.{x} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v₁})]
    (hne : p.LocallyNonempty J) (𝒢 : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v₁}) (U : 𝒞)
    (hcof : ∀ R ∈ J U, ∃ (I : Type w) (V : I → 𝒞) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U ∧ Sieve.ofArrows V f ≤ R ∧
      (∀ i, IsZero (Sheaf.H' 𝒢 1 (V i))) ∧
      ∃ (Vij : I → I → 𝒞) (pr₁ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V i) (pr₂ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V j),
        (∀ i j, IsPullback (pr₁ i j) (pr₂ i j) (f i) (f j)) ∧
        ∀ i j, IsZero (Sheaf.H' 𝒢 1 (Vij i j))) :
    ∃ (I : Type w) (V : I → 𝒞) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ U),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ J U ∧
      (∀ i, Nonempty (p.Fiber (V i))) ∧
      (∀ i, IsZero (Sheaf.H' 𝒢 1 (V i))) ∧
      ∃ (Vij : I → I → 𝒞) (pr₁ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V i) (pr₂ : ∀ i j, Vij i j ⟶ V j),
        (∀ i j, IsPullback (pr₁ i j) (pr₂ i j) (f i) (f j)) ∧
        ∀ i j, IsZero (Sheaf.H' 𝒢 1 (Vij i j))
declarations.comment: the refinement step of the proof: a covering of U drawn from the cofinal system of hypothesis (1), carrying an object of 𝒮 over each of its members

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.differenceDerivation_derivationActionSheaf
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks Project, Tag 0CK1], for arbitrary schemes.** Let `S` be a scheme, let
`i : X ⟶ X'` be a first-order thickening, let `j : Y ⟶ Y'` be an immersion with structure
morphism `q : Y' ⟶ S`, let `(a, a')` be a morphism of thickenings `(X ⊂ X') ⟶ (Y ⊂ Y')` over
`S`, and let `θ : a^*Ω_{Y/S} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` be an `𝒪_X`-linear map. The source writes `θ ⬝ a'` for
the lift [Stacks Project, Tag 02H5] attaches to `θ`, which is
`Stacks.Thickenings.derivationActionSheaf`, and says that this notation *means nothing else than*
the following two things.

* The derivation `D` of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FG] attached to the pair `(a', θ ⬝ a')` — the
  `𝒪_S`-derivation `𝒪_Y ⟶ a_*𝒞_{X/X'}` of
  `Stacks.Thickenings.derivationActionDifferenceDerivation` — is related to `θ` by Equation
  [Stacks Project, Tag 04BV]: it is `d_{Y/S}` followed by `θ`, read through the transpose of `θ`
  along `a^* ⊣ a_*`. That is the first conjunct.
* The comorphisms `(a')^♯` and `(θ ⬝ a')^♯` differ by `D`: on a section `s` of `𝒪_{Y'}` over an
  open `V`, `(θ ⬝ a')^♯ s = (a')^♯ s + D (j^♯ s)`, the value of `D` being read inside `𝒪_{X'}`
  through the inclusion `𝒞_{X/X'} ⟶ 𝒪_{X'}` by `Stacks.Thickenings.conormalSectionι`. That is
  the second conjunct.

Nothing is affine, and the datum is the one of the source: a morphism of sheaves of `𝒪_X`-modules
out of the pulled-back sheaf of relative differentials. The derivation is the one
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FG] attaches to the pair, with all three of that tag's hypotheses
discharged for it — in particular condition (2), which is
`Stacks.Thickenings.immersionConormalSheafMap_derivationActionSheaf`.
declarations.statement:
theorem differenceDerivation_derivationActionSheaf :
    derivationActionDifferenceDerivation hi q ca θ =
        (Scheme.Hom.universalRelativeDerivation (j ≫ q)).postcomp
          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction a).homEquiv
            (Scheme.Hom.relativeDifferentials (j ≫ q))
            (Stacks.Conormal.conormalSheaf i) θ).val ∧
      ∀ (V : Y'.Opens) (s : Γ(Y', V)),
        ((derivationActionSheaf hi q ca θ).app V).hom s =
          (a'.app V).hom s +
            conormalSectionι hi ca V
              ((derivationActionDifferenceDerivation hi q ca θ).d (X := op (j ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                ((j.app V).hom s))

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.epi_modulePullback_immersionConormalSheafMap
declarations.doc:
**The canonical map of conormal sheaves coming from the base stays surjective after
pullback.** For `Y = Z ×_{Z'} Y'` the canonical map `h^* 𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ 𝒞_{Y/Y'}` of
[Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] is an epimorphism by [Stacks Project, Tag 0473], and the module
pullback along any morphism `c : W ⟶ Y` preserves epimorphisms, being a left adjoint.

Taken at `c = a` this is the surjectivity of `g^* 𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^* 𝒞_{Y/Y'}` used in
[Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2]; taken at `c = ι_{i⁻¹V} ≫ a` it is the same statement over an open
of `X'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem epi_modulePullback_immersionConormalSheafMap [IsImmersion j] [IsImmersion k]
    {W : Scheme.{u}} {h : Y ⟶ Z} {h' : Y' ⟶ Z'} (sq : IsPullback j h h' k) (c : W ⟶ Y) :
    Epi ((modulePullback c.toLRSHom.toShHom).map
      (immersionConormalSheafMap j k h h' (toShHom_square sq.w)))
declarations.comment: surjectivity of the conormal map coming from the base, after pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.eq_of_isBaseCompatibleConormalMap
declarations.doc:
**The conormal datum of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH] is determined by `a` over a thickened
base.** If two maps `A, B : a^* 𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` are both compatible with the base, they are
equal: the map they are precomposed with is an epimorphism by
`Stacks.Thickenings.epi_modulePullback_immersionConormalSheafMap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem eq_of_isBaseCompatibleConormalMap (sq : IsPullback j h h' k)
    (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k)
    {A B : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i}
    (hA : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i j k h h' g' a sq.w ci A)
    (hB : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i j k h h' g' a sq.w ci B) : A = B
declarations.comment: the conormal datum is determined by the map on the closed subschemes

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_lift
declarations.doc:
**The conormal datum of a lift over the base is compatible with the base.** For a morphism
`b : V ⟶ Y'` over `Z'` restricting to `a` on `i⁻¹V`, the canonical map of conormal sheaves of the
square it forms is compatible with the base: stacking that square on the cartesian square gives
the square `(i ∣_ V) ≫ (V.ι ≫ g') = (ι_{i⁻¹V} ≫ a ≫ h) ≫ k`, whose canonical map does not
involve `b`.

This is the assertion of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] that the composition
`g^*𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` "has to be the canonical map induced by `g'`", read for
the datum attached to an actual lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_lift (sq : IsPullback j h h' k)
    (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k) {V : X'.Opens} {b : V.toScheme ⟶ Y'}
    (hb₁ : b ≫ h' = V.ι ≫ g') (hb₂ : i ∣_ V ≫ b = ((i ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ a) ≫ j) :
    IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap (i ∣_ V) j k h h' (V.ι ≫ g') ((i ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ a) sq.w
      (comm_restrict_base i k h g' a ci V)
      (immersionConormalSheafMap (i ∣_ V) j ((i ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ a) b (toShHom_square hb₂))
declarations.comment: the composition g^*𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'} is the canonical map induced by g', for the datum of a lift

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_isCompatibleLift
declarations.doc:
**A conormal datum that admits a compatible lift is compatible with the base.** If some
morphism `b : V ⟶ Y'` out of an open `V` of `X'` is a compatible lift of `a` for the datum `A`,
then the restriction of `A` to `V` is compatible with the base: condition (3) of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] identifies that restriction with the canonical map of the square `b`
forms, which is compatible with the base by
`Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_lift`.

This is the assertion of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] that the composition
`g^*𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` *has to be* the canonical map induced by `g'`, read for
the given datum: wherever the sheaf of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH] has a section, `A` is forced
to be base compatible, and by `Stacks.Thickenings.eq_of_isBaseCompatibleConormalMap` that pins
it down. So base compatibility is not a restriction on the data the source considers; it is the
source's determination of `A` by `a`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_isCompatibleLift (sq : IsPullback j h h' k)
    (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k)
    {A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i} {V : X'.Opens} {b : V.toScheme ⟶ Y'}
    (hb : IsCompatibleLift g' h' a A V b) :
    IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap (i ∣_ V) j k h h' (V.ι ≫ g') ((i ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ a) sq.w
      (comm_restrict_base i k h g' a ci V) (restrictConormalSheafMap a A V)
declarations.comment: the composition g^*𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'} has to be the canonical map induced by g', for the given datum: a datum with a compatible lift over an open is base compatible there

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isCompatibleLift_iff_of_isBaseCompatible
declarations.doc:
**The third condition of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FI] is automatic over a thickened base.** For
`A` compatible with the base, a morphism `b : V ⟶ Y'` out of an open `V` of `X'` is a compatible
lift of `a` exactly when it is a morphism over `Z'` restricting to `a` on `i⁻¹V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isCompatibleLift_iff_of_isBaseCompatible (sq : IsPullback j h h' k)
    (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k)
    {A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i}
    (hA : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i j k h h' g' a sq.w ci A) (V : X'.Opens)
    (b : V.toScheme ⟶ Y') :
    IsCompatibleLift g' h' a A V b ↔
      b ≫ h' = V.ι ≫ g' ∧ i ∣_ V ≫ b = ((i ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ≫ a) ≫ j
declarations.comment: the conormal condition on a lift is automatic

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.compatibleLiftsPresheafIsoLiftsOverBasePresheafOfBase
declarations.doc:
**The sheaf of [Stacks Project, Tag 04FH] is the elementary rule over a thickened base.** For
`A` compatible with the base, the presheaf of compatible lifts of `a` is isomorphic to the
presheaf `Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBasePresheaf` of morphisms `V ⟶ Y'` over `Z'` restricting
to `a` on `i⁻¹V`, by the isomorphism which is the identity on underlying morphisms.

This is the description of the sheaf asserted by [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2]. The simply
transitive action of `Hom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/Z}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` on the elementary rule — the last
assertion of that remark — is
`Stacks.Thickenings.exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBaseOfBase` in
`StacksFrontier.AlgebraicGeometry.MoreMorphisms.InfinitesimalDeformationThickenedBaseAction`,
obtained by transporting the unrestricted [Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ] for the base `Z'` along
this isomorphism and along the identification `Ω_{Y/Z'} ≅ Ω_{Y/Z}` that holds because `k` is an
immersion.
declarations.comment: the elementary description of the lifting sheaf

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBaseOfBase
declarations.doc:
**The action clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2].** Let `k : Z ⟶ Z'` be an immersion, let
`i : X ⟶ X'` be a first order thickening and `j : Y ⟶ Y'` an immersion, both over `Z'` by
`g' : X' ⟶ Z'` and `h' : Y' ⟶ Z'`, assume `Y = Z ×_{Z'} Y'`, let `a : X ⟶ Y` and let `A` be a
conormal datum compatible with the base. Then the sheaf `Hom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/Z}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` —
differentials relative to `Z`, as the source writes them — **acts** on the elementary rule
`Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBasePresheaf` of the remark: over every open `V` of `X'` the
additive group of its sections over `i⁻¹V` acts on the morphisms `V ⟶ Y'` over `Z'` restricting
to `a` on `i⁻¹V`, the action commutes with the restriction maps of that rule, and over an open
carrying a lift it is **simply transitive**.

No affineness is assumed, of `Z'`, `X'`, `Y'` or `V`, and no condition on conormal sheaves
appears in the conclusion: this is the action on the elementary rule itself, which is what the
remark asserts.

The action is `Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBaseVAddOfBase`: the unrestricted
[Stacks Project, Tag 04FJ] for the base `Z'`, carried over by the identification
`Ω_{Y/Z'} ≅ Ω_{Y/Z}` of `Stacks.Thickenings.pullbackCotangentSheafIsoOfBase` and by the
identification of the two notions of lift.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBaseOfBase (hsq : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (sq : IsPullback j h h' k) (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k)
    {A : (modulePullback a.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i}
    (hA : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i j k h h' g' a sq.w ci A) :
    ∃ act : ∀ V : X'.Opens, deformationHomSections i a h V →
        liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V → liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V,
      (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (c : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V), act V 0 c = c) ∧
        (∀ (V : X'.Opens) (θ η : deformationHomSections i a h V)
          (c : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V), act V (θ + η) c = act V θ (act V η c)) ∧
        (∀ (V V' : X'.Opens) (hV : V' ≤ V) (θ : deformationHomSections i a h V)
          (c : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V),
          liftsOverBaseRestrict i j g' h' a hV (act V θ c)
            = act V' (moduleHomSections.restrict (i.preimage_mono hV) θ)
                (liftsOverBaseRestrict i j g' h' a hV c)) ∧
        ∀ (V : X'.Opens) (b₀ c₀ : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a V),
          ∃! θ : deformationHomSections i a h V, act V θ b₀ = c₀
declarations.comment: the action of Hom(a^*Ω_{Y/Z}, 𝒞_{X/X'}) on the elementary lifting rule, with the group laws, the compatibility with restriction, and simple transitivity over an open carrying a lift

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.liftsOverBaseVAddOfBase_comp_of_homSectionValue_comm
declarations.doc:
**The action of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] on the elementary lifting rule is natural in the
thickening.** This is the input a statement about a *sum* of first-order deformations needs: the
sum is realized over the doubled coordinate module `M × M`
(`Deformation.exists_linearFunctorLift_sum`), so the action has to be run once over `k[M × M]`
and pushed forward along the two projections `k[M × M] ⟶ k[M]` and their sum, and this is the
compatibility of the action with those pushforwards.

Let two situations of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] be given, with vertical maps `(wX, w)` of the
thickenings and `(vY, v)` of the targets. Let `c` be an elementary lift over an open `V₁` of
`X₁'`, let `d` be one over an open `V₂` of `X₂'` with `d ≫ v = w ≫ c` on underlying morphisms,
and let `θ₁` and `θ₂` be sections of the two acting sheaves whose perturbations correspond under
`w^♯` and `v^♯`. Then acting and pushing forward commute:

`(θ₂ ⬝ d) ≫ v = w ≫ (θ₁ ⬝ c)`

on underlying morphisms. The hypothesis `hθ` is the commuting square of
[Stacks Project, Tag 04BZ] read on the conormal sections the two sections produce, and it is
transported to the acting sheaf of the source — the differentials relative to `Z₁` and to `Z₂` —
by `Stacks.Thickenings.baseDeformationHomSectionsEquiv`, which is the identification the action
is defined through.
declarations.statement:
theorem liftsOverBaseVAddOfBase_comp_of_homSectionValue_comm
    (hsq₁ : i₁.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (hsq₂ : i₂.ker ^ 2 = ⊥)
    (sq₁ : IsPullback j₁ h₁ h₁' k₁) (sq₂ : IsPullback j₂ h₂ h₂' k₂)
    (ci₁ : i₁ ≫ g₁' = (a₁ ≫ h₁) ≫ k₁) (ci₂ : i₂ ≫ g₂' = (a₂ ≫ h₂) ≫ k₂)
    {A₁ : (modulePullback a₁.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j₁) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i₁}
    {A₂ : (modulePullback a₂.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj (immersionConormalSheaf j₂) ⟶
      immersionConormalSheaf i₂}
    (hA₁ : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i₁ j₁ k₁ h₁ h₁' g₁' a₁ sq₁.w ci₁ A₁)
    (hA₂ : IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i₂ j₂ k₂ h₂ h₂' g₂' a₂ sq₂.w ci₂ A₂)
    (V₁ : X₁'.Opens) (V₂ : X₂'.Opens)
    (θ₁ : deformationHomSections i₁ a₁ h₁ V₁) (θ₂ : deformationHomSections i₂ a₂ h₂ V₂)
    (c : liftsOverBase i₁ j₁ g₁' h₁' a₁ V₁) (d : liftsOverBase i₂ j₂ g₂' h₂' a₂ V₂)
    {wX : (i₂ ⁻¹ᵁ V₂).toScheme ⟶ (i₁ ⁻¹ᵁ V₁).toScheme} {w : V₂.toScheme ⟶ V₁.toScheme}
    {vY : Y₂ ⟶ Y₁} {v : Y₂' ⟶ Y₁'}
    (cT : i₂ ∣_ V₂ ≫ w = wX ≫ i₁ ∣_ V₁) (cj : j₂ ≫ v = vY ≫ j₁)
    (cX : ((i₂ ⁻¹ᵁ V₂).ι ≫ a₂) ≫ vY = wX ≫ ((i₁ ⁻¹ᵁ V₁).ι ≫ a₁))
    (cA : d.1 ≫ v = w ≫ c.1)
    (hθ : ∀ (W : Y₁'.Opens) (s : Γ(Y₁', W)),
      (V₂.toScheme.presheaf.map (eqToHom (preimage_comp_eq cA W)).op).hom
          ((w.app (c.1 ⁻¹ᵁ W)).hom
            (homSectionValue hsq₁ h₁' c.2.2
              (baseDeformationHomSectionsEquiv sq₁ a₁ V₁ θ₁) W s))
        = homSectionValue hsq₂ h₂' d.2.2
            (baseDeformationHomSectionsEquiv sq₂ a₂ V₂ θ₂) (v ⁻¹ᵁ W) ((v.app W).hom s)) :
    (liftsOverBaseVAddOfBase hsq₂ sq₂ ci₂ hA₂ V₂ θ₂ d).1 ≫ v =
      w ≫ (liftsOverBaseVAddOfBase hsq₁ sq₁ ci₁ hA₁ V₁ θ₁ c).1
declarations.comment: the action of Hom(a^*Ω_{Y/Z}, 𝒞_{X/X'}) on the elementary lifting rule is natural in the thickening: for two situations of the tag with vertical maps, acting and pushing a lift forward commute, given the commuting square of Tag 04BZ for the two acting sections. This is naturality of the action, not a new construction of it

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_globalLift
declarations.doc:
**The conormal datum of a lift defined on all of `X'` is compatible with the base.** For a
morphism `b : X' ⟶ Y'` over `Z'` whose restriction along `i` is `a`, the square it forms with
`i` and `j` has a canonical map of conormal sheaves; stacking that square on the cartesian
square of the base gives the square `i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k`, whose canonical map does not
mention `b`. This is the assertion of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] that the composite
`g^*𝒞_{Z/Z'} ⟶ a^*𝒞_{Y/Y'} ⟶ 𝒞_{X/X'}` "has to be the canonical map induced by `g'`", read for
a lift over the whole space.

`Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_lift` is the same statement for a lift
defined on an open `V` of `X'`, where the thickening is `i ∣_ V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_globalLift (sq : IsPullback j h h' k)
    (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k) {b : X' ⟶ Y'} (hb₁ : b ≫ h' = g') (hb₂ : i ≫ b = a ≫ j) :
    IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap i j k h h' g' a sq.w ci
      (immersionConormalSheafMap i j a b (toShHom_square hb₂))
declarations.comment: the composition g^*C_{Z/Z'} -> a^*C_{Y/Y'} -> C_{X/X'} is the canonical map induced by g', for the datum of a lift defined on all of X'

declarations.name: Stacks.Thickenings.exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBaseOfGlobalLift
declarations.doc:
**The action clause of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] over the whole space, from a lift.** Let
`k : Z ⟶ Z'` be an immersion, let `i : X ⟶ X'` be a first order thickening and `j : Y ⟶ Y'` an
immersion, both over `Z'` by `g'` and `h'`, assume `Y = Z ×_{Z'} Y'`, and let `a : X ⟶ Y` admit
a lift `b : X' ⟶ Y'`, that is, a morphism over `Z'` whose restriction along `i` is `a`. Then the
additive group of sections over `X` of `SheafHom_{𝒪_X}(a^*Ω_{Y/Z}, 𝒞_{X/X'})` — differentials
relative to `Z`, as the source writes them — **acts simply transitively** on the morphisms
`X' ⟶ Y'` over `Z'` restricting to `a` along `i`.

No conormal datum appears: the lift produces one, by
`Stacks.Thickenings.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_of_globalLift`, and it is the only one
compatible with the base by `Stacks.Thickenings.eq_of_isBaseCompatibleConormalMap`. No
affineness is assumed, of `Z'`, `X'` or `Y'`, and the hypothesis that the open carries a lift —
which is what makes the action of that tag simply transitive — is discharged by `b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_simplyTransitive_addAction_liftsOverBaseOfGlobalLift [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (hsq : i.ker ^ 2 = ⊥) (sq : IsPullback j h h' k) (ci : i ≫ g' = (a ≫ h) ≫ k)
    {b : X' ⟶ Y'} (hb₁ : b ≫ h' = g') (hb₂ : i ≫ b = a ≫ j) :
    ∃ act : deformationHomSections i a h ⊤ →
        liftsOverBase i j g' h' a ⊤ → liftsOverBase i j g' h' a ⊤,
      (∀ c : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a ⊤, act 0 c = c) ∧
        (∀ (θ η : deformationHomSections i a h ⊤) (c : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a ⊤),
          act (θ + η) c = act θ (act η c)) ∧
          ∀ c₀ c₁ : liftsOverBase i j g' h' a ⊤, ∃! θ : deformationHomSections i a h ⊤,
            act θ c₀ = c₁
declarations.comment: the simply transitive action of Hom(a^*Omega_{Y/Z}, C_{X/X'}) on the lifts of a over the whole space, with the conormal datum discharged by an actual lift

declarations.name: Deformation.Examples.isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_deformationConormalMap
declarations.doc:
**The conormal map of an arrow of deformations is compatible with the base.** The
special-fibre immersion of `Q` sits over the closed point of `Spec A` through
`Q.toBase ≫ Spec φ.base`, and that square factors through `P.scheme`: the arrow's square followed
by the special-fibre square of `P`. Reading the canonical map of [Stacks Project, Tag 01R4] along
that factorisation is exactly the compatibility of [Stacks Project, Tag 0CK2] for the conormal
map of the arrow, with the flat-base-change map of `P` as the datum coming from the base.

This is `Stacks.Immersion.immersionConormalSheafMap_comp` and nothing else; the content is that
the two squares of a deformation and of an arrow of deformations stack to the square the
flat-base-change map of the target is read on.
declarations.statement:
theorem isBaseCompatibleConormalMap_deformationConormalMap (φ : P ⟶ Q) :
    IsBaseCompatibleConormalMap Q.specialMap P.specialMap (residueSpecMap P.base)
      X.hom P.toBase (φ.map ≫ P.toBase) (𝟙 X.left)
      P.specialCartesian.w (square_comp (specialMap_comp_map φ) P.specialCartesian.w)
      (immersionConormalSheafMap Q.specialMap P.specialMap (𝟙 X.left) φ.map
        (toShHom_square (specialMap_comp_map φ)))
