[Stacks, Tag 0D5T]; and the final identification uses that `b|_U` is an isomorphism, so that the
unit of the derived adjunction of [Stacks, Tag 079W] along it is invertible.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowDatum_derivedPushforward_tensor_restrict_iso
    (hE : (derivedPullback (ofScheme (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj E ≅
      (derivedPushforward (ofScheme (iZ ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).obj
        (structureSheafSingle (iZ ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme))
    (hproj : ((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor
            (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.sheaf).obj
          ((derivedPullback (ofScheme (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj
            ((derivedPullback (ofScheme p)).obj K))).obj
        ((derivedPushforward (ofScheme (iZ ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).obj
          (structureSheafSingle (iZ ⁻¹ᵁ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme)) ≅
      (derivedPushforward (ofScheme (iZ ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).obj
        ((derivedPullback (ofScheme (iZ ∣_ (q ⁻¹ᵁ V)))).obj
          ((derivedPullback (ofScheme (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj
            ((derivedPullback (ofScheme p)).obj K)))) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback (ofScheme V.ι)).obj ((derivedPushforward (ofScheme q)).obj
        (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor T.sheaf).obj
          ((derivedPullback (ofScheme p)).obj K)).obj E)) ≅
      (derivedPushforward (ofScheme (chowDatumMorphism p q iZ U V hb hW))).obj
        ((derivedPullback (ofScheme U.ι)).obj K))
declarations.comment: the derived comparison Rq_*(Lp^*K ⊗ᴸ E)|_V ≅ R(U → V)_*(K|_U), for arbitrary K in D(O_X) — more general than the source, which takes K in D_QCoh(O_X) — carrying two inputs as named hypotheses. (i) hproj is Tag 08EU, the projection formula, at the closed immersion i : W ⟶ q⁻¹V and at a GENERAL target complex: this library carries Tag 08EU only at the unit object (see the restriction on isIso_projectionFormulaMap_unitObject) and the source's devissage to that case is not available; it is also stated with the direct image on the right of the tensor product, so it differs from the Tag 0B53 map by the commutativity of ⊗ᴸ, which is likewise not carried. (ii) hE is clause (5) of Tag 0CSJ in the restricted form the source uses, that E restricted to q⁻¹V is Ri_*O_W: the library's Tag 0CSJ gives the stronger global form E ≅ (iZ)_*O_Z[0], but descending it to q⁻¹V needs exactness of direct image along a closed immersion and the unit comparison Lj^*(O_T[0]) ≅ O_W[0], which the Tag 08EU file records as unavailable. Everything else is proved here: Tag 08FE (localization of the total direct image, proved in this file for the standard functors), Tag 079U, Tags 0D5S and 0D5T, and the invertibility of the derived adjunction unit along the isomorphism b|_U. The two geometric assertions of the statement, that U ⟶ V is a closed immersion and is of finite presentation, are isClosedImmersion_chowDatumMorphism and finitePresentation_chowDatumMorphism

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.chowDatum_derivedPushforward_tensor_restrict_iso_of_isDQCoh
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CSK], the derived comparison, at a quasi-coherent complex.**  In the
situation of derived Chow's lemma — `p : T ⟶ X` and `q : T ⟶ P` the two projections of
`T = X ×_A ℙⁿ_A`, `iZ : Z ⟶ T` the closed subscheme, `b = iZ ≫ p` an isomorphism over the open
`U ⊆ X`, `c = iZ ≫ q`, and `b ⁻¹ᵁ U = c ⁻¹ᵁ V` for an open `V ⊆ P` — let `E` satisfy clause (5)
of [Stacks, Tag 0CSJ], that its restriction to `q ⁻¹ᵁ V` agrees with that of `(iZ)_*𝒪_Z`.  Then
for every `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`

`Rq_*(Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋 E)|_V ≅ R(c ∘ (b|_U)⁻¹)_*(K|_U)`.

This statement stands at the data of [Stacks, Tag 0CSJ] and nothing else: `hb`, `hW` and `hE`
are clauses (2), (4) and (5) of that lemma, in the shape
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_derivedChowDatum` produces them, and `hK` is the quasi-coherence
condition on `K` that [Stacks, Tag 0CSK] states.  The whole of Tag 0CSK, at the projections of
`X ×_A ℙᵐ_A`, is `AlgebraicGeometry.chowDatum_fourierMukai` below.  The proof is
`AlgebraicGeometry.chowDatum_derivedPushforward_tensor_restrict_iso`, whose two inputs are
supplied by `AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedChow.pushforwardUnitRestrictIso` and by
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedProjectionFormulaUnitRightIso`.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowDatum_derivedPushforward_tensor_restrict_iso_of_isDQCoh
    {X P T Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ X) (q : T ⟶ P) (iZ : Z ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion iZ]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : P.Opens) (hb : IsIso ((iZ ≫ p) ∣_ U))
    (hW : (iZ ≫ p) ⁻¹ᵁ U = (iZ ≫ q) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (E : DerivedCategory T.Modules)
    (hE : (derivedPullback (ofScheme (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj E ≅
      (derivedPullback (ofScheme (q ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor T.Modules 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward iZ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))))
    (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) :
    Nonempty ((derivedPullback (ofScheme V.ι)).obj ((derivedPushforward (ofScheme q)).obj
        (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor T.sheaf).obj
          ((derivedPullback (ofScheme p)).obj K)).obj E)) ≅
      (derivedPushforward (ofScheme (chowDatumMorphism p q iZ U V hb hW))).obj
        ((derivedPullback (ofScheme U.ι)).obj K))
declarations.comment: the derived comparison Rq_*(Lp^*K ⊗ᴸ E)|_V ≅ R(U → V)_*(K|_U) for K in D_QCoh(O_X), which is the condition on K that Tag 0CSK itself states. Everything else the statement fixes — p, q, iZ, U, V, E and the three conditions hb, hW, hE on them — is the datum of Lemma 0CSJ, hE being clause (5) of that lemma in the very shape exists_derivedChowDatum produces it. Nothing further enters: the projection formula of Tag 08EU and clause (5) in the restricted form the computation reads it in are both proved here, as derivedProjectionFormulaUnitRightIso and DerivedChow.pushforwardUnitRestrictIso. The whole statement, with the two geometric assertions that U ⟶ V is a closed immersion and is of finite presentation, is chowDatum_fourierMukai

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.chowDatum_fourierMukai
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CSK].**  Let `A` be a ring, let `f : X ⟶ Spec A` be locally of finite
presentation (in the source, `X` is separated and of finite presentation over `A`), let
`p : X ×_A ℙᵐ_A ⟶ X` and `q : X ×_A ℙᵐ_A ⟶ ℙᵐ_A` be the two projections, and let
`U ⊆ X`, `V ⊆ ℙᵐ_A`, `iZ : Z ⟶ X ×_A ℙᵐ_A` and `E ∈ D(𝒪_{X ×_A ℙᵐ_A})` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CSJ]: `iZ` is a closed immersion, `b = iZ ≫ p` is an isomorphism over `U`,
`c = iZ ≫ q` is a closed immersion over `V`, `b ⁻¹ᵁ U = c ⁻¹ᵁ V`, and the restriction of `E` to
`X ×_A V` is that of `(b, c)_*𝒪_Z` — each in the very shape
`AlgebraicGeometry.exists_derivedChowDatum` produces it.  Then the morphism
`c ∘ (b|_U)⁻¹ : U ⟶ V` is a closed immersion of finite presentation, and for every
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`

`Rq_*(Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋 E)|_V ≅ R(c ∘ (b|_U)⁻¹)_*(K|_U)`.

The clauses of [Stacks, Tag 0CSJ] not listed — finite presentation of `iZ`, the point `z`,
separatedness and quasi-compactness of `X`, pseudo-coherence and support of `E` — are not used,
so the statement is given without them.
declarations.statement:
theorem chowDatum_fourierMukai {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (m : ℕ) (U : X.Opens)
    (V : (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A))).Opens) {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (iZ : Z ⟶ pullback f (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)))
    [IsClosedImmersion iZ]
    (hb : IsIso ((iZ ≫ pullback.fst f
      (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))) ∣_ U))
    (hc : IsClosedImmersion ((iZ ≫ pullback.snd f
      (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))) ∣_ V))
    (hW : (iZ ≫ pullback.fst f
        (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))) ⁻¹ᵁ U =
      (iZ ≫ pullback.snd f
        (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))) ⁻¹ᵁ V)
    (E : DerivedCategory
      (pullback f (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))).Modules)
    (hE : Nonempty ((derivedPullback (ofScheme (pullback.snd f
        (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj E ≅
      (derivedPullback (ofScheme (pullback.snd f
        (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A)) ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι)).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (pullback f (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))).Modules 0).obj
          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward iZ).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf))))) :
    IsClosedImmersion (chowDatumMorphism (pullback.fst f _) (pullback.snd f _) iZ U V hb hW) ∧
      AlgebraicGeometry.FinitePresentation
        (chowDatumMorphism (pullback.fst f _) (pullback.snd f _) iZ U V hb hW) ∧
      ∀ K : DerivedCategory X.Modules,
        (∀ n : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules n).obj K).IsQuasicoherent) →
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback (ofScheme V.ι)).obj
            ((derivedPushforward (ofScheme (pullback.snd f
              (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))))).obj
              (((Stacks.DerivedTensor.RingedSite.derivedTensorProductFunctor
                  (pullback f (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))).sheaf).obj
                ((derivedPullback (ofScheme (pullback.fst f
                  (projectiveSpaceOver m (Spec (.of A)) ↘ Spec (.of A))))).obj K)).obj E)) ≅
          (derivedPushforward (ofScheme
            (chowDatumMorphism (pullback.fst f _) (pullback.snd f _) iZ U V hb hW))).obj
            ((derivedPullback (ofScheme U.ι)).obj K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isPseudoCoherent_of_derivedGlobalSectionsOver_tensor_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a ring, let `X` be a scheme separated and of finite presentation over `A`, with
structure morphism `f : X ⟶ Spec A`, and let `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`. If `RΓ(X, E ⊗^𝐋 K)` is a
pseudo-coherent object of `D(A)` for every pseudo-coherent object `E` of `D(𝒪_X)`, then `K` is
pseudo-coherent relative to `A`.

"Separated and of finite presentation over `A`" is `IsSeparated f`, `QuasiCompact f` and
`LocallyOfFinitePresentation f` (quasi-separatedness follows from separatedness);
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is quasi-coherence of its cohomology sheaves; `RΓ(X, -)` is the `A`-linear
`AlgebraicGeometry.derivedGlobalSectionsOver f`; pseudo-coherence relative to `A` is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.IsPseudoCoherent f` (Stacks 09UI).
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_of_derivedGlobalSectionsOver_tensor_isPseudoCoherent
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsSeparated f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (K : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj K).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hpc : ∀ E : DerivedCategory X.Modules, RingedSpace.IsPseudoCoherent (X := X.toRingedSpace) E →
      StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent
        ((derivedGlobalSectionsOver f).obj
          (((Stacks.SheafOfModules.derivedTensor X.sheaf).obj E).obj K))) :
    f.IsPseudoCoherent K

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_derivedPullback_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSN.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `{g i : Y i ⟶ X}` be an fppf
covering of schemes, let `E` be an object of `D(𝒪_X)` with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves and
let `m` be an integer. Then `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S` if and only if every
`L(g i)^*E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S`.

The forward implication is Stacks 0695 (a member of an fppf covering is flat and locally of
finite presentation, hence pseudo-coherent) followed by Stacks 09US,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_comp_derivedPullback`; it needs neither joint
surjectivity nor the quasi-coherence of `E`. The converse is
`Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_of_forall_derivedPullback_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage` (Stacks 05WN,
0683, 09US, 09UK, 08EU, 09UN and Zariski gluing). The membership of `g i ≫ f` in the class of
morphisms locally of finite type, which the predicate takes as an instance argument, comes from the
covering.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_derivedPullback_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type v} (Y : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (hg : Presieve.ofArrows Y g ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage X)
    (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (hE : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E).IsQuasicoherent)
    (m : ℤ) :
    f.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m ↔
      ∀ i, letI : LocallyOfFinitePresentation (g i) :=
          locallyOfFinitePresentation_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage Y g hg i
        (g i ≫ f).IsPseudoCoherentFrom ((derivedPullback (g i).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E) m
declarations.comment: both implications, at the source's hypotheses: f locally of finite type, an arbitrary fppf covering of X (Presieve.ofArrows in Scheme.fppfPrecoverage, any index universe), E with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, any m

registrations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_derivedPullback_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage'
registrations.comment:
THE FORWARD IMPLICATION ONLY, with the Stacks 09US hypothesis DISCHARGED;
the tag is an iff and its converse is NOT proved. Base already registers the forward half at
PseudoCoherent/RelativeFppfDescent.lean:148, which carries 09US as a hypothesis; that file's own
notes say discharging it is what would make the implication unconditional. 09US is now proved
(PseudoCoherent/DerivedPullback09US.lean:634), so this restatement carries only 0E23
(DerivedBaseChangeIsoOfTorIndependent), which 09US itself already requires -- strictly fewer
hypotheses than the base form. The covering is genuinely fppf (Presieve.ofArrows in
Scheme.fppfPrecoverage), not etale or Zariski; no quasi-compactness, finiteness or Noetherian
hypothesis is added, and nothing is assumed about E's cohomology sheaves. THE CONVERSE needs
exactly two things the library lacks: Stacks 08EU at a GENERAL K (the library has it only at
K = O_Y[0], and its docstring says the devissage to general K is not carried out), and
the local splitting of O_X -> pi_* O_Y for a surjective finite locally free pi, which is absent
entirely.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_comp_iff_of_flat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSP.** Let `f : X ⟶ T` be locally of finite type, let `g : T ⟶ S` be flat and
locally of finite presentation, let `E` be an object of `D(𝒪_X)` and let `m` be an integer. Then
`E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S` if and only if it is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative
to `T`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherentFrom_comp_iff_of_flat
    {X T S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ T) (g : T ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat g]
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (m : ℤ) :
    (f ≫ g).IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m ↔ f.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_pullback_snd_of_pseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSQ for a pseudo-coherent `f`.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a pseudo-coherent morphism of
schemes, let `{g i : S i ⟶ S}` be an fppf covering, let `E` be an object of `D(𝒪_X)` and let `m`
be an integer. Then `E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S` if and only if the derived pullback
of `E` to `X ×_S S i` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S i` for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_pullback_snd_of_pseudoCoherent
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [PseudoCoherent f] {ι : Type v} (Y : ι → Scheme.{u})
    (g : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ S) (hg : Presieve.ofArrows Y g ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage S)
    (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (m : ℤ) :
    f.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m ↔
      ∀ i, (pullback.snd f (g i)).IsPseudoCoherentFrom
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f (g i)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E) m
declarations.comment: both directions, for a pseudo-coherent f -- by Stacks 0684 this is every f locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base; no hypothesis on the cohomology sheaves of E is used

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_pullback_snd
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSQ.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `{g a : Y a ⟶ S}` be an fppf
covering, let `E` be an object of `D(𝒪_X)` and let `m` be an integer. Then `E` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S` if and only if the derived pullback of `E` to `X ×_S Y a` is
`m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `Y a` for every `a`.

The forward direction is Stacks 09UR at the flat morphism `g a`; the converse is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_of_forall_pullback_snd`. No hypothesis on the
cohomology sheaves of `E` is used.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Scheme.Hom.isPseudoCoherentFrom_iff_forall_pullback_snd {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {ι : Type v} (Y : ι → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ a, Y a ⟶ S)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows Y g ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage S) (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules)
    (m : ℤ) :
    f.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m ↔
      ∀ a, (pullback.snd f (g a)).IsPseudoCoherentFrom
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f (g a)).toLRSHom.toShHom).obj E) m

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedQuasicoherentPushforwardSquare
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CSR].**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`,
with `X` and `Y` quasi-compact with affine diagonal over `ℤ`.  Let `Φ` be a right derived functor
of `f_* : QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ QCoh(𝒪_Y)` with unit `αΦ`, and `Rf_*` a right derived functor of the
direct image of all modules with unit `α`.  Then the square

`D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⟶^{Rf_*} D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`,
`D(QCoh(𝒪_X)) ⟶^{Φ} D(QCoh(𝒪_Y)) ⟶ D_QCoh(𝒪_Y)`

commutes, its rows being the comparison functors of [Stacks, Tag 08F1]; it is stated after the
fully faithful inclusion `D_QCoh(𝒪_Y) ⥤ D(𝒪_Y)`, as for [Stacks, Tag 08GY].

`f_*` preserves quasi-coherence because `f` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated
([Stacks, Tag 03M9]), by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_isQuasiCompactWithAffineDiagonal`.
The isomorphism is the canonical comparison of the two right derived functors.
declarations.statement:
def derivedQuasicoherentPushforwardSquare {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXdiag : IsAffineHom B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ (diag (viewOverIntegers B S hS hZ X.1)))
    (hYqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS Y.1)
    (hYdiag : IsAffineHom B (⊤_ Scheme.{u}) hZ (diag (viewOverIntegers B S hS hZ Y.1)))
    (Φ : DerivedCategory (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2))
    (αΦ : (quasicoherentPushforward B S hS f
        (pushforwardPreservesQuasicoherence_of_isQuasiCompactWithAffineDiagonal B S hS hZ f
          ⟨hXqc, hXdiag⟩ ⟨hYqc, hYdiag⟩)).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Φ)
    [Φ.IsRightDerivedFunctor αΦ
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (QuasicoherentSheaves.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (Rf : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2))
    (α : (modulePushforward B S hS f).mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Qh ⟶ DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ Rf)
    [Rf.IsRightDerivedFunctor α
      (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))] :
    Φ ⋙ quasicoherentDerivedComparisonSchemeUniverse B S hS Y.1 Y.2 ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).O))).ι ≅
      quasicoherentDerivedComparisonSchemeUniverse B S hS X.1 X.2 ⋙
        (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
          (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
            (Stacks.SheafOfModules.Tensor.ringSheaf
              (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⋙ Rf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isZero_homology_coherator_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSS.**  Let `S` be a scheme and `X` a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic
space over `S`, and let `DQ_X` be the right adjoint of the inclusion `D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)`
(Stacks 0CR4; any right adjoint, with its adjunction).  There is an integer `N = N(X)` such that
for all integers `a`, `b` and every `K` in `D(𝒪_X)` with `H^i(U, K) = 0` for every affine `U`
étale over `X` and every `i ∉ [a, b]`, the cohomology sheaves `H^i(DQ_X(K))` vanish for
`i ∉ [a, b + N]`.

The affine `U` étale over `X` are the étale charts `U` of `X` whose scheme is affine, and
`H^i(U, K)` is the `i`-th cohomology of the complex of sections over `U` of a K-injective complex
`I` representing `K`, i.e. of the unbounded derived sections `RΓ(U, K)`; the hypothesis is asked
of every such representative.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_homology_coherator_obj (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1)
    (DQ : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⊣ DQ) :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ (a b : ℤ) (K : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)),
      (∀ U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1, IsAffineChart B S hS X.1 U →
        ∀ I : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ℤ, I.IsKInjective →
          Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ K) → ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
            IsZero ((((chartSectionsAb B S hS X U).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj I).homology i)) →
      ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b + N < i →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) i).obj
          ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
            (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
              (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι.obj (DQ.obj K)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDerivedLimit_coherator_obj
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CST, the coherator commutes with derived limits.**  Let `X` be an algebraic space
over `S`, `DQ` a right adjoint of the inclusion `ι : D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)` and `F` an inverse
system in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.  If `L` is a derived limit of `F` computed in `D(𝒪_X)`, then the
product of `F` exists in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and `DQ L` is a derived limit of `F` there:
`DQ_X(R lim Fₙ) = (R lim in D_QCoh(𝒪_X))(Fₙ)`.

Such a `DQ` exists when `X` is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, by Stacks 0CR4
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLeftAdjoint_ι_derivedCategoryB_isQuasicoherentOnSite`); the system of
the source is the system of quasi-coherent sheaves `(𝓕ₙ)`, placed in degree `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_coherator_obj
    (DQ : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⊣ DQ)
    (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).FullSubcategory)
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ (F ⋙ (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι).obj (op n)]
    (L : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hL : IsDerivedLimit (F ⋙ (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι) L) :
    ∃ h : HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ F.obj (op n),
      letI := h
      IsDerivedLimit F (DQ.obj L)
declarations.comment: assertion DQ_X(R lim F_n) = (R lim in D_QCoh(O_X))(F_n): for every right adjoint DQ of the inclusion D_QCoh(O_X) -> D(O_X), at every model of D(O_X), and every inverse system in D_QCoh(O_X); DQ_X exists on a qcqs X by 0CR4

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_homology_chartSections_iso_of_isDerivedLimit_single
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CST, `H^i(U, K) = H^i(R lim Γ(U, 𝓕ₙ))`.**  Let `(𝓕ₙ)` be an inverse system of
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules on an algebraic space `X`, let `L = R lim 𝓕ₙ` be a derived limit in
`D(𝒪_X)` of the system `(𝓕ₙ)` placed in degree `0`, and let `U` be an affine étale chart of `X`.
Then for every derived limit `R = R lim Γ(U, 𝓕ₙ)` in `D(Ab)` of the abelian groups `Γ(U, 𝓕ₙ)`
placed in degree `0`, and every `i`, `H^i(U, L) ≅ H^i(R)`.

`H^i(U, L)` is the cohomology of the complex of sections over `U` of any K-injective complex `I`
representing `L`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_homology_chartSections_iso_of_isDerivedLimit_single
    (𝓕 : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℕ, (𝓕.obj (op n)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
      (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).obj (op n)]
    (L : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hL : IsDerivedLimit (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0) L)
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (hU : IsAffineChart B S hS X.1 U)
    (I : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (eI : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ L))
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓕 ⋙ chartSectionsAb B S hS X U ⋙
      DerivedCategory.singleFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} 0).obj (op n)]
    (R : DerivedCategory AddCommGrpCat.{u})
    (hR : IsDerivedLimit (𝓕 ⋙ chartSectionsAb B S hS X U ⋙
      DerivedCategory.singleFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} 0) R)
    (i : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((((chartSectionsAb B S hS X U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      I).homology i ≅ (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} i).obj R)
declarations.comment: assertion H^i(U, K) = H^i(R lim Gamma(U, F_n)) for K = R lim F_n in D(O_X) and U affine etale over X; R lim Gamma(U, F_n) is any derived limit in D(Ab), at any models; H^i(U, K) is computed on a K-injective representative, as in 0CSS

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_homology_chartSections_of_isDerivedLimit_single
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CST, `H^i(U, K) = 0` unless `i ∈ [0, 1]`.**  Let `(𝓕ₙ)` be an inverse system of
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules on an algebraic space `X` and `L = R lim 𝓕ₙ` a derived limit in
`D(𝒪_X)` of the system `(𝓕ₙ)` placed in degree `0`.  Then `H^i(U, L) = 0` for every affine étale
chart `U` of `X` and every `i ∉ [0, 1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_homology_chartSections_of_isDerivedLimit_single
    (𝓕 : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hqc : ∀ n : ℕ, (𝓕.obj (op n)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
      (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).obj (op n)]
    (L : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hL : IsDerivedLimit (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0) L)
    (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (hU : IsAffineChart B S hS X.1 U)
    (I : CochainComplex (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ℤ) (hI : I.IsKInjective)
    (eI : Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj I ≅ L)) (i : ℤ) (hi : i < 0 ∨ 1 < i) :
    IsZero ((((chartSectionsAb B S hS X U).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      I).homology i)
declarations.comment: assertion H^i(U, R lim F_n) = 0 for i outside [0, 1] and U affine etale over X, at any model of D(O_X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isZero_homology_coherator_obj_of_isDerivedLimit_single
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CST, `DQ_X(R lim 𝓕ₙ)` is in `D^b_QCoh(𝒪_X)` with no negative cohomology.**  Let
`X` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated algebraic space over `S` and `DQ` a right adjoint of
the inclusion `D_QCoh(𝒪_X) ⥤ D(𝒪_X)`.  There is an integer `N` such that for every inverse system
`(𝓕ₙ)` of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules and every derived limit `L = R lim 𝓕ₙ` in `D(𝒪_X)` of
`(𝓕ₙ)` placed in degree `0`, the cohomology sheaves `H^i(DQ L)` vanish for `i < 0` and for
`i > 1 + N`.  By `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isDerivedLimit_coherator_obj`, `DQ L` is the `R lim`
of `(𝓕ₙ)` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.

This is Stacks 0CSS (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isZero_homology_coherator_obj`) with
`[a, b] = [0, 1]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_homology_coherator_obj_of_isDerivedLimit_single (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS)
    (hXqc : IsQuasiCompactSpace B S hS X.1)
    (hXqs : IsAbsolutelyQuasiSeparated B S hS B.contains_terminal X.1)
    (DQ : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) ⥤
      (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
        (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).FullSubcategory)
    (adj : (DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
      (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι ⊣ DQ) :
    ∃ N : ℤ, ∀ (𝓕 : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2),
      (∀ n : ℕ, (𝓕.obj (op n)).IsQuasicoherentOnSite) →
      ∀ [HasProduct fun n : ℕ ↦
        (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) 0).obj (op n)]
        (L : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)),
        IsDerivedLimit (𝓕 ⋙ DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0) L →
        ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 ∨ 1 + N < i →
          IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) i).obj
            ((DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
              (SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherentOnSite.{u + 1, u, u, u}
                (ringSheaf (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).O))).ι.obj (DQ.obj L)))
declarations.comment: conclusion: the R lim in D_QCoh(O_X), i.e. DQ_X(R lim F_n), lies in D^b_QCoh(O_X) and has vanishing cohomology sheaves in negative degrees (in [0, 1 + N], N = N(X) uniform), by 0CSS; at the standard model, the one of 0CSS

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isQuasicoherent_homology_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type and let `E` be an object of
`D(𝒪_X)` which is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `S`. Then the cohomology sheaf `H^i(E)` is a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module for every `i > m`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isQuasicoherent_homology_of_isPseudoCoherentFrom {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (m i : ℤ)
    (hE : f.IsPseudoCoherentFrom E m) (hi : m < i) :
    ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor X.Modules i).obj E).IsQuasicoherent
declarations.comment: quasi-coherence of the cohomology sheaves above the bound

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Hom.isQuasicoherentDerived_of_isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes locally of finite type and let `E` be an object of
`D(𝒪_X)` which is pseudo-coherent relative to `S`. Then `E` is an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, that
is, `H^i(E)` is quasi-coherent for every `i`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isQuasicoherentDerived_of_isPseudoCoherent {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (E : DerivedCategory X.Modules) (hE : f.IsPseudoCoherent E) :
    DerivedCategoryB.derivedCategoryB
      (_root_.SheafOfModules.isQuasicoherent X.ringCatSheaf) E
declarations.comment: membership in the quasi-coherent derived category

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.locallyOfFiniteType_of_represents
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSW.** If a morphism `f` of algebraic spaces over `S` is locally of finite
type and a morphism `f₀` of objects of the site represents it, through isomorphisms
`yoneda.obj U ≅ X` and `yoneda.obj V ≅ Y`, then the scheme morphism underlying `f₀` is
locally of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem locallyOfFiniteType_of_represents (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f) (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (f₀ : U ⟶ V)
    (eX : yoneda.obj U ≅ X) (eY : yoneda.obj V ≅ Y)
    (hrep : yoneda.map f₀ ≫ eY.hom = eX.hom ≫ f) :
    LocallyOfFiniteType ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map f₀)
declarations.comment: representing_locally_finite_type

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_representableDerivedPullback_iso
declarations.doc:
Let `X` be an algebraic space represented by the scheme `X₀` underlying `U`, through
`eX : h_U ≅ X`. Every object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is the pullback of an object `E₀` of
`D(𝒪_{X₀})` with quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, and `E₀` is unique: any object of
`D_QCoh(𝒪_{X₀})` whose pullback is isomorphic to `E` is isomorphic to `E₀`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_representableDerivedPullback_iso
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX) :
    ∃ E₀ : DerivedCategory ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U).Modules,
      (∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj E₀).IsQuasicoherent) ∧
        Nonempty ((representableDerivedPullback B S hS hX eX).obj E₀ ≅ E.obj) ∧
          ∀ E₀' : DerivedCategory ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U).Modules,
            (∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ i).obj E₀').IsQuasicoherent) →
              Nonempty ((representableDerivedPullback B S hS hX eX).obj E₀' ≅ E.obj) →
                Nonempty (E₀' ≅ E₀)
declarations.comment: every E in D_QCoh(O_X) is the pullback of a unique E_0 in D_QCoh(O_{X_0}), by Tag 071Q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRepresentablyRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X → Y` be a morphism of representable algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally of
finite type, represented by the morphism of schemes `f₀ : X₀ → Y₀` underlying `f₀ : U ⟶ V`
through `eX : h_U ≅ X` and `eY : h_V ≅ Y`. An object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is
*`m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `Y`* when the object `E₀` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_{X₀})` whose pullback is
`E` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `Y₀` in the sense of Stacks 09UI. This makes sense because
`f₀` is locally of finite type (`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.locallyOfFiniteType_of_represents`), and
it does not depend on the choice of `E₀`
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRepresentablyRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom_iff`).
declarations.statement:
def IsRepresentablyRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX) (m : ℤ) : Prop
declarations.comment: the convention: E is m-pseudo-coherent relative to Y when E_0 is m-pseudo-coherent relative to Y_0 (Tag 09UI)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativePseudoCoherence_chart_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSX.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` locally of
finite type, let `m` be an integer and let `E` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.  With the complex
`E|_U` of Remark 0CSW the following are equivalent:

1. for every commuting square of étale scheme charts `U ⟶ V` over `X ⟶ Y`, the complex `E|_U` is
   `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `V`;
2. for some such square with `U ⟶ X` surjective, the complex `E|_U` is `m`-pseudo-coherent
   relative to `V`;
3. for every such square with `U` and `V` affine, the complex `RΓ(U, E)` of `𝒪_X(U)`-modules is
   `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `𝒪_Y(V)`.

See the module docstring for the four inputs that `h` carries.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativePseudoCoherence_chart_tfae (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (h : RelativePseudoCoherenceInput B S hS)
    {X Y : (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u} (hX : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS X)
    (hY : IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS Y) (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsLocallyOfFiniteType B S hS f)
    (E : QuasicoherentDerivedCategory.{u, u} B S hS X hX) (m : ℤ) :
    List.TFAE
      [∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b)
          (hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f),
          IsPseudoCoherentFromOnChart B S hS h hX f hf E m U V a b g ha hb hc,
       ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b),
          IsSurjective B S hS a ∧ ∃ hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f,
            IsPseudoCoherentFromOnChart B S hS h hX f hf E m U V a b g ha hb hc,
       ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b)
          (hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f)
          (hU : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
          (hV : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V)),
          haveI : LocallyOfFiniteType ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g) :=
            hf U V a b g ha hb hc
          haveI := hU
          haveI := hV
          ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map g).DerivedSectionsPseudoCoherentOn'
            (h.chartComplex hX E ha).obj m (isAffineOpen_top _) (isAffineOpen_top _)
            (by simp)]
declarations.comment: proved relative to the carried inputs `h`. Its `comparison` field is the second sentence of Remark 0CSW — that an object of D_QCoh of a representable algebraic space is the pullback of a unique object of D_QCoh of a representing scheme, which is what gives E|_U its meaning — and is absent from the library, whose 0CSW is the first sentence only; `chartComplexPullback` is its compatibility with passing to a finer chart. The descent half of 0CSN is carried as `fppfDescent` because only the forward half is proved. 09US is not carried: it is recovered from its own 0E23 input, carried through as `torIndependentBaseChange`.

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.relativePseudoCoherence_etaleSquare_tfae
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSX.**  Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` which is locally
of finite type, let `m` be an integer and let `E` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`.  With the
notation of Remark 0CSW the following are equivalent:

1. for every commutative square `U ⟶ V` over `f` of schemes `U`, `V` with étale charts
   `U ⟶ X`, `V ⟶ Y`, the complex `E|_U` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `V`;
2. for some such square with `U ⟶ X` surjective, `E|_U` is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `V`;
3. for every such square with `U` and `V` affine, the complex `RΓ(U, E)` of `𝒪_X(U)`-modules is
   `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `𝒪_Y(V)`.

(1) ⟹ (2) and (1) ⟹ (3) and (3) ⟹ (1) are
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_isPseudoCoherentFromOnEtaleSquare`,
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedSectionsPseudoCoherentOnEtaleSquare_of_forall` and
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherentFromOnEtaleSquare_of_forall_derivedSections`.  For
(2) ⟹ (1), `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_surjective_etale_isPseudoCoherentFrom_derivedPullback`
gives, on a second square, relative `m`-pseudo-coherence of the pullback of `E|_{U'}` along a
surjective étale morphism `W ⟶ U'`; that morphism alone is an fppf covering, and Stacks 0CSN
descends the property to `E|_{U'}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativePseudoCoherence_etaleSquare_tfae :
    List.TFAE
      [∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b)
          (hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f),
          IsPseudoCoherentFromOnEtaleSquare hX f hf E m U V a b g ha hb hc,
       ∃ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b),
          IsSurjective B S hS a ∧ ∃ hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f,
            IsPseudoCoherentFromOnEtaleSquare hX f hf E m U V a b g ha hb hc,
       ∀ (U V : BigFppfOver B S hS) (a : yoneda.obj U ⟶ X) (b : yoneda.obj V ⟶ Y) (g : U ⟶ V)
          (ha : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) a)
          (hb : HasSchemeProperty B S hS (@AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.{u}) b)
          (hc : yoneda.map g ≫ b = a ≫ f)
          (hU : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj U))
          (hV : IsAffine ((BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj V)),
          DerivedSectionsPseudoCoherentOnEtaleSquare hX f hf E m U V a b g ha hb hc hU hV]
declarations.comment: all three conditions and their equivalence, at the source's hypotheses: f a morphism of algebraic spaces over S locally of finite type, E in D_QCoh(O_X), any m; the phrase 'E|_U is m-pseudo-coherent relative to V' is the convention of Remark 0CSW

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSY, part (1).** An object `E` of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is *`m`-pseudo-coherent relative
to `Y`* when, for every commuting square of étale scheme charts `U` of `X` and `V` of `Y` over
`f` with `U` and `V` affine, the complex `RΓ(U, E)` of `𝒪_X(U)`-modules is `m`-pseudo-coherent
relative to the ring `𝒪_Y(V)` in the sense of Tag 065I.

This is condition (3) of Tag 0CSX; see "Which of the equivalent conditions of Tag 0CSX
is taken as the definition" in the module docstring.
declarations.comment: part (1): m-pseudo-coherence relative to Y of an object of D_QCoh, through condition (3) of Tag 0CSX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSY, part (2).** An object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` is *pseudo-coherent relative to `Y`*
when it is `m`-pseudo-coherent relative to `Y` for every integer `m`.
declarations.comment: part (2): pseudo-coherence relative to Y of an object of D_QCoh

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsModuleRelativelyPseudoCoherentFrom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSY, part (3).** A quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module is *`m`-pseudo-coherent relative
to `Y`* when the complex it determines in degree zero, an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.derivedCategoryB_singleFunctor_obj`, is.
declarations.comment: part (3): m-pseudo-coherence relative to Y of a quasi-coherent module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsModuleRelativelyPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CSY, part (4).** A quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module is *pseudo-coherent relative to
`Y`* when the complex it determines in degree zero is.
declarations.comment: part (4): pseudo-coherence relative to Y of a quasi-coherent module

declarations.name: henselianRing_ker_limit_π_of_surjective_of_ker_le_nilradical
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CT7.** Let `A` be the inverse limit of a sequence of commutative rings whose
transition maps are surjective with locally nilpotent kernels. Then the pair consisting of `A`
and the kernel of any limit projection `A → Aₙ` is henselian.
declarations.statement:
theorem henselianRing_ker_limit_π_of_surjective_of_ker_le_nilradical
    (F : ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cone F) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℕ,
      Function.Surjective (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom ∧
        RingHom.ker (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom ≤
          nilradical (F.obj (.op (n + 1)))) (n : ℕ) :
    HenselianRing c.pt (RingHom.ker (c.π.app (.op n)).hom)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isSeparated_and_locallyQuasiFinite_of_mono

A monomorphism of schemes which is locally of finite type is separated and locally
quasi-finite.

theorem isSeparated_and_locallyQuasiFinite_of_mono {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isClopen_isProper_of_henselianPair_of_compactification
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CT9] with [Stacks, Tag 0F41] carried as `hcpt` and clause (1) of
[Stacks, Tag 03H2] carried as `hconn`.**

Let `(A, I)` be a henselian pair and let `f : X ⟶ Spec A` be separated and of finite type.  An
open and closed subscheme `i : Y ⟶ X ×_{Spec A} Spec (A ⧸ I)` of the closed fibre which is proper
over `Spec (A ⧸ I)` is the closed fibre of an open and closed subscheme `w : W ⟶ X` which is
proper over `Spec A`.

Choosing a compactification `X ⟶ P ⟶ Spec A` of `f`, the image of `Y` in the closed fibre of `P`
is open and closed and lifts to an open and closed subset `V` of `P`.  Since the points of `V`
over the closed fibre lie in `X`, all of `V` does, and `V` cuts out the required subscheme of
`X`.

The tag's hypotheses and its full conclusion are exactly those below.  The two extra arguments
are the conclusions of other tags, quoted by the source and unavailable here:  `hcpt` is
Nagata's compactification theorem, Tag 0F41, and `hconn` is the connectedness conjunct of clause
(1) of Tag 03H2, which rests on Tag 0G7X and hence on Tags 02OC and 02OB.  The quantifier on
`hconn` is forced by `hcpt` being an existential:  the connectedness input is applied to the
compactification `P`, which is produced rather than given.  The source reaches the same
reduction through Chow's lemma (Tag 0202) and Tag 01RG instead of through Tag 0F41; that route
is equally unavailable, Tag 0202 being conditional here on
`Scheme.FiniteTypeApproximation.IsOneAffineOpenStep`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_isProper_of_henselianPair_of_compactification (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : HenselianPair A I) {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    (hcpt : ∃ (P : Scheme.{u}) (j : X ⟶ P) (π : P ⟶ Spec (.of A)),
      IsOpenImmersion j ∧ IsProper π ∧ j ≫ π = f)
    (hconn : ∀ {P : Scheme.{u}} (π : P ⟶ Spec (.of A)) [IsProper π],
      GeometricallyConnected π.toNormalization)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Y ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsProper (i ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))] :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (w : W ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion w) (_ : IsClosedImmersion w)
      (_ : IsProper (w ≫ f)),
      let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))
      let w₀ : pullback (w ≫ f) q ⟶ pullback f q :=
        pullback.lift (pullback.fst (w ≫ f) q ≫ w) (pullback.snd (w ≫ f) q)
          (by rw [Category.assoc]; exact pullback.condition)
      ∃ e : Y ≅ pullback (w ≫ f) q, e.hom ≫ w₀ = i
declarations.comment:
the whole statement, with two inputs the source quotes carried as named
hypotheses: `hcpt`, Nagata compactification (Stacks 0F41), and `hconn`, the connectedness
conjunct of clause (1) of Stacks 03H2 (through Stacks 0G7X, 02OC and 02OB); neither is proved in
this repository, and neither is any part of this tag's own conclusion

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isClopen_isProper_of_henselianPair
declarations.doc:
Let `(A, I)` be a henselian pair and let `f : X ⟶ Spec A` be separated and of finite type.  An
open and closed subscheme `i : Y ⟶ X ×_{Spec A} Spec (A ⧸ I)` of the closed fibre which is proper
over `Spec (A ⧸ I)` is the closed fibre of an open and closed subscheme `w : W ⟶ X` which is
proper over `Spec A`: there is an isomorphism `Y ≅ W ×_{Spec A} Spec (A ⧸ I)` over the closed
fibre.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isClopen_isProper_of_henselianPair (A : Type u) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : HenselianPair A I) {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of A))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Y ⟶ pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))
    [IsOpenImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [IsProper (i ≫ pullback.snd f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk I))))] :
    ∃ (W : Scheme.{u}) (w : W ⟶ X) (_ : IsOpenImmersion w) (_ : IsClosedImmersion w)
      (_ : IsProper (w ≫ f)),

        pullback.lift (pullback.fst (w ≫ f) q ≫ w) (pullback.snd (w ≫ f) q)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.torIndependent_pullback_product_of_flat
declarations.doc:
In a commutative square, flatness of the right-hand object
over the base and of the upper-left object over the lower-left object implies the indicated Tor
independence after arbitrary base change.
declarations.statement:
theorem torIndependent_pullback_product_of_flat
    {S S' X' Y' Z' : Scheme.{u}}
    (s : S ⟶ S') (x : X' ⟶ S') (y : Y' ⟶ S')
    (zx : Z' ⟶ X') (zy : Z' ⟶ Y') (hz : zx ≫ x = zy ≫ y)
    [Flat y] [Flat zx] :
    let _X := pullback x s
    let _Y := pullback y s
    let P := pullback (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s)
    let P' := pullback x y
    let pToP' : P ⟶ P' :=
      pullback.lift
        (pullback.fst (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫ pullback.fst x s)
        (pullback.snd (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫ pullback.fst y s)
        (by
          calc
            _ = pullback.fst (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                (pullback.fst x s ≫ x) := Category.assoc _ _ _
            _ = pullback.fst (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                (pullback.snd x s ≫ s) := by rw [pullback.condition]
            _ = (pullback.fst (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                pullback.snd x s) ≫ s := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm
            _ = (pullback.snd (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                pullback.snd y s) ≫ s := by rw [pullback.condition]
            _ = pullback.snd (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                (pullback.snd y s ≫ s) := Category.assoc _ _ _
            _ = pullback.snd (pullback.snd x s) (pullback.snd y s) ≫
                (pullback.fst y s ≫ y) := by rw [pullback.condition]
            _ = _ := (Category.assoc _ _ _).symm)
    let zToP' : Z' ⟶ P' := pullback.lift zx zy hz
    TorIndependent pToP' zToP'

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation
declarations.doc:
The standing data of Grothendieck's existence theorem for modules: an inverse system of rings
with surjective, locally nilpotent transitions, a separated scheme of finite presentation over the
inverse-limit ring, and a compatible system of finitely presented sheaves on its base changes
which are flat over, and have proper support over, the affine base at their level.
declarations.statement: structure ExistenceSituation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.nonempty_derivedLimitQCoh_and_isDerivedLimit_isGE_isLE
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CTD.** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC] consider
`K = R lim_{D_QCoh(𝒪_X)}(Fₙ) = DQ_X(R lim_{D(𝒪_X)} Fₙ)`. Then `K` is in `D^b_QCoh(𝒪_X)` and in
fact `K` has nonzero cohomology sheaves only in degrees `≥ 0`.

Here, at any model of `D(𝒪_X)`, the data `d` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh` are a derived limit
`L = R lim_{D(𝒪_X)} Fₙ` and `K = DQ_X(L)`, characterized by its universal property; such data
exist (first conjunct). For any of them, `K` is also a derived limit
`R lim_{D_QCoh(𝒪_X)}(Fₙ)` of the system read in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, which is the displayed equality,
and its cohomology sheaves vanish outside `[0, c]` for some `c`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedLimitQCoh_and_isDerivedLimit_isGE_isLE :
    Nonempty S.DerivedLimitQCoh ∧ ∀ d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh,
      (∃ _hp : HasProduct fun n : ℕ => S.quasiCoherentPushforwardSystem.obj ⟨n⟩,
        IsDerivedLimit S.quasiCoherentPushforwardSystem ⟨d.K, d.quasicoherent⟩) ∧
      d.K.IsGE 0 ∧ ∃ c : ℤ, d.K.IsLE c

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.isDerivedLimit_coherator_obj_pushforwardSystem
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTD], the displayed equality.** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC], if `K` is a
derived limit in `D(𝒪_X)` of the system `(iₙ,* Fₙ)` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.derivedPushforwardSystem`, then
`DQ_X(K)` is a derived limit of the system `(DQ_X(iₙ,* Fₙ))` in `D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`. This is the
equality `R lim_{D_QCoh(𝒪_X)}(Fₙ) = DQ_X(R lim_{D(𝒪_X)} Fₙ)` of the statement of the tag; the
existence of the product of the images is part of the conclusion.

The reason is the source's: `DQ_X` is a right adjoint, so it commutes with the countable product
occurring in a derived-limit triangle, and it is exact because the adjunction `ι ⊣ DQ_X` is
triangulated.
declarations.statement:
theorem isDerivedLimit_coherator_obj_pushforwardSystem (adj : quasiCoherentι S.X.left ⊣ DQ)
    [DQ.CommShift ℤ] [adj.IsTriangulated]
    [HasProduct fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystem.obj ⟨n⟩]
    (K : DerivedCategory S.X.left.Modules)
    (hK : IsDerivedLimit S.derivedPushforwardSystem K) :
    ∃ h : HasProduct fun n : ℕ => DQ.obj (S.derivedPushforwardSystem.obj ⟨n⟩),
      @IsDerivedLimit (quasiCoherentDerivedCategory S.X.left) _ _ _ _ _ _
        (S.derivedPushforwardSystem ⋙ DQ) h (DQ.obj K)
declarations.comment: the displayed equality only; the coherator of Stacks 0CR0 is an argument, as in Stacks 0CSA and 0CR2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh.isPerfect_and_isIso_sheafHomBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CTE, part (2).** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC] let `K` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CTD] and let `E` be a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)`. Then
`N = RHom_X(E, K) = RΓ_A(X, R𝓗om(E, K))` is a perfect object of `D(A)`, and there is a canonical
isomorphism `N ⊗^𝐋_A Aₙ ≅ RHom_{Xₙ}(E|_{Xₙ}, ℱₙ)` in `D(Aₙ)` for every `n`, with `E|_{Xₙ}` the
derived pullback: the derived base change of
`AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh.sheafHomLevelMap`,
built from a cone `p` exhibiting `L = R lim ℱₙ`, is invertible.

As in the source, part (2) and part (1) are translated into each other by
[Stacks, Tag 08DQ]; here part (2) is read off part (1) at `E^∨`. Stated at
`HasDerivedCategory.standard` (scoped to this declaration).
declarations.statement:
theorem DerivedLimitQCoh.isPerfect_and_isIso_sheafHomBaseChange (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh)
    (E : DerivedCategory S.X.left.Modules)
    (hE : RingedSpace.IsPerfect (X := S.X.left.toRingedSpace) E) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect ((derivedGlobalSectionsOver S.X.hom).obj
        (((derivedSheafHom S.X.left.sheaf).obj (op E)).obj d.K)) ∧
      ∀ (p : d.L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystemOfModel.obj ⟨n⟩),
        S.IsDerivedLimitCone p → ∀ n : ℕ,
          IsIso (derivedBaseChangeComparison (S.limitProjection n)
            (DerivedLimitQCoh.sheafHomLevelMap S d E hE p n))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh.isPerfect_and_isIso_tensorBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CTE, part (1).** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC] let `K` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CTD] and let `E` be a perfect object of `D(𝒪_X)`. Then
`M = RΓ(X, K ⊗^𝐋 E)` is a perfect object of `D(A)`, and the canonical map
`M ⊗^𝐋_A Aₙ ⟶ RΓ(Xₙ, ℱₙ ⊗^𝐋 E|_{Xₙ})` is an isomorphism in `D(Aₙ)` for every `n`, with
`E|_{Xₙ}` the derived pullback.

Here `K` is given by the data `d` of
`AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh`, the canonical map is
`(DerivedLimitQCoh.tensorBaseChange S d p n).app E`, built from a cone `p` exhibiting
`L = R lim ℱₙ`, and the index `n` stands for the level `n + 1` of the source. Stated at
`HasDerivedCategory.standard` (scoped to this declaration).
declarations.statement:
theorem DerivedLimitQCoh.isPerfect_and_isIso_tensorBaseChange (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh)
    (E : DerivedCategory S.X.left.Modules)
    (hE : Stacks.Cohomology.PerfectComplexes.IsPerfect (X := S.X.left.toRingedSpace) E) :
    StacksDraft.Perfect.IsPerfect ((derivedGlobalSectionsOver S.X.hom).obj
        (((derivedTensorProductFunctor S.X.left.toRingedSpace.sheaf).obj d.K).obj E)) ∧
      ∀ (p : d.L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystemOfModel.obj ⟨n⟩),
        S.IsDerivedLimitCone p → ∀ n : ℕ,
          IsIso ((DerivedLimitQCoh.tensorBaseChange S d p n).app E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.DerivedLimitQCoh.isPseudoCoherent
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTF].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC], let `K` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CTD], i.e. `K = DQ_X(R lim_{D(𝒪_X)} iₙ,* ℱₙ)`. Then `K` is pseudo-coherent relative
to `A = lim Aₙ`: relatively pseudo-coherent ([Stacks, Tag 09UI]) for the structure morphism
`X ⟶ Spec A`. Stated at the standard model.
declarations.statement:
theorem DerivedLimitQCoh.isPseudoCoherent (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh) :
    S.X.hom.IsPseudoCoherent d.K

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.isIso_sectionsOverComparison
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTG].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC], let `K` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CTD], with a derived-limit cone `p` of `R lim (iₙ,* ℱₙ)`. For every quasi-compact
open `U ⊆ X`, the canonical map `RΓ(U, K) ⊗_A^𝐋 Aₙ ⟶ RΓ(Uₙ, ℱₙ)` of `D(Aₙ)`, `Uₙ = U ∩ Xₙ`, is an
isomorphism. Stated at the standard model.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_sectionsOverComparison (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh)
    (p : d.L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystemOfModel.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hp : S.IsDerivedLimitCone p) (U : S.X.left.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set S.X.left))
    (n : ℕ) : IsIso (S.sectionsOverComparison d p U n)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.exists_open_isZero_homology_isFinitePresentation_isIso
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTH].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC], let `K` be as in
[Stacks, Tag 0CTD], with a derived-limit cone `p`. There is an open `W ⊆ X` containing `X₀` such
that `Hⁱ(K)|_W = 0` for `i ≠ 0`, `ℱ = H⁰(K)|_W` is of finite presentation, and
`ℱₙ = ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} 𝒪_{Xₙ}`: the canonical maps `iₙ^* H⁰(K) ⟶ ℱₙ`, adjoint to the maps
`H⁰(K) ⟶ iₙ,* ℱₙ` induced by `K ⟶ iₙ,* ℱₙ`, are isomorphisms. Stated at the standard model.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_isZero_homology_isFinitePresentation_isIso (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh)
    (p : d.L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystemOfModel.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hp : S.IsDerivedLimitCone p) :
    ∃ W : S.X.left.Opens, Set.range (S.closedImmersion 0) ⊆ W ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 →
        IsZero (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor S.X.left.Modules j).obj d.K).restrict W.ι)) ∧
      (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor S.X.left.Modules 0).obj d.K).restrict
        W.ι).IsFinitePresentation ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, IsIso
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (S.closedImmersion n)).homEquiv _ _).symm
          (S.zerothLevelMap d p n))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.exists_open_isProperOver_supp
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTI].** In Situation [Stacks, Tag 0CTC], with `K` as in [Stacks, Tag 0CTD]
and `W` as in [Stacks, Tag 0CTH]: after shrinking `W`, the support of `ℱ = H⁰(K)|_W` is proper over
`A`. The open produced keeps the three properties of [Stacks, Tag 0CTH]. Stated at the standard
model.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_open_isProperOver_supp (d : S.DerivedLimitQCoh)
    (p : d.L ⟶ ∏ᶜ fun n : ℕ => S.derivedPushforwardSystemOfModel.obj ⟨n⟩)
    (hp : S.IsDerivedLimitCone p) :
    ∃ W : S.X.left.Opens, Set.range (S.closedImmersion 0) ⊆ W ∧
      (∀ j : ℤ, j ≠ 0 →
        IsZero (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor S.X.left.Modules j).obj d.K).restrict W.ι)) ∧
      (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor S.X.left.Modules 0).obj d.K).restrict
        W.ι).IsFinitePresentation ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, IsIso
        (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction (S.closedImmersion n)).homEquiv _ _).symm
          (S.zerothLevelMap d p n))) ∧
      ∃ Z : Closeds W.toScheme, (Z : Set W.toScheme) = SheafOfModules.supp
          (((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor S.X.left.Modules 0).obj d.K).restrict W.ι) ∧
        IsProperOver (W.ι ≫ S.X.hom) Z

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isIso_of_forall_spec_factors_of_isLimit
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be the limit of a sequence of rings whose transition maps are surjective with locally
nilpotent kernels. A monomorphism `f : T ⟶ Spec A` locally of finite type through which every
`Spec Aₙ ⟶ Spec A` factors is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_of_forall_spec_factors_of_isLimit (hc : IsLimit c)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℕ, Function.Surjective (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom ∧
      RingHom.ker (F.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op).hom ≤ nilradical (F.obj (.op (n + 1))))
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (f : T ⟶ Spec c.pt) [Mono f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (hfac : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ g : Spec (F.obj (.op n)) ⟶ T, g ≫ f = Spec.map (c.π.app (.op n))) :
    IsIso f

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.GrothendieckExistence.ExistenceSituation.exists_algebraization
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0CTK], Grothendieck's existence theorem for flat modules.** In Situation
[Stacks, Tag 0CTC] there is a finitely presented `𝒪_X`-module `ℱ`, flat over `A`, with support
proper over `A`, such that `ℱₙ = ℱ ⊗_{𝒪_X} 𝒪_{Xₙ}` for all `n` compatibly with the maps `φₙ`.
The derived categories in the proof are the standard ones; none appears in the statement.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_algebraization :
    ∃ (F : S.X.left.Modules) (_ : F.IsFinitePresentation),
      IsFlatOver S.X.hom.toLRSHom.toShHom F ∧
      (∃ Z : Closeds S.X.left, (Z : Set S.X.left) = SheafOfModules.supp F ∧
        IsProperOver S.X.hom Z) ∧
      ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, (Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.closedImmersion n)).obj F ≅ S.F n,
        ∀ n : ℕ,
          (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp (S.transitionScheme n) (S.closedImmersion (n + 1))).app F ≪≫
            (Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr (S.transition_fst n)).app F ≪≫ e n =
          (Scheme.Modules.pullback (S.transitionScheme n)).mapIso (e (n + 1)) ≪≫ S.φ n

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_derivedModulePushforward_derivedTensor_and_isIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTL.** For `f : X ⟶ Y` of finite presentation, a pseudo-coherent `E` and a bounded
above complex `𝒢^•` of `𝒪_X`-modules of finite presentation, flat over `Y`, with support proper
over `Y`, `Rf_*(E ⊗^L 𝒢^•)` is pseudo-coherent, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base
change: for every cartesian square,
`Lg^*Rf_*(E ⊗^L 𝒢^•) ⟶ Rf'_*(L(g')^*E ⊗^L (g')^*𝒢^•)` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_derivedModulePushforward_derivedTensor_and_isIso_baseChange
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hE : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPseudoCoherent E)
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)) ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i, b < i → IsZero (G.X i)) (hGfp : ∀ n, (G.X n).IsFinitePresentation)
    (hGflat : ∀ n, IsFlatOver B S hS X.2 f.hom (G.X n))
    (hGsupp : ∀ n, HasProperSupport B S hS X.2 Y.2 f.hom
      (isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation B S hS hf.1)
      ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj (G.X n))) :
    (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).IsPseudoCoherent
        ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).obj
          (((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B S hS X).obj E).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))) ∧
      ∀ {X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g' : X' ⟶ X)
        (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g),
        IsIso (smallEtaleDerivedBaseChangeComp B S hS f g f' g' sq.w
          (((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B S hS X).obj E).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))
          (((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B S hS X').obj
            ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj E)).obj
            (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((modulePullback B S hS g').mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj G)))
          ((smallEtaleDerivedPullbackTensorIso g').hom.app (E, DerivedCategory.Q.obj G) ≫
            ((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B S hS X').obj
              ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS g').obj E)).map
              (smallEtaleDerivedModulePullbackQComparison g' G)))
