declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isPseudoCoherent_derivedModulePushforward_and_isIso_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTN.** For a flat and proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of finite presentation and a
pseudo-coherent `E`, `Rf_*E` is pseudo-coherent, and its formation commutes with arbitrary base
change: for every cartesian square, the base change map `Lg^*Rf_*E ⟶ Rf'_*L(g')^*E` of
Stacks 07A7 is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isPseudoCoherent_derivedModulePushforward_and_isIso_baseChange
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfl : IsFlat B S hS f.hom) (hpr : IsProper B S hS f.hom)
    (hf : IsFinitePresentation B S hS f.hom)
    (E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2))
    (hE : (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS X.1 X.2).IsPseudoCoherent E) :
    (smallEtaleRingedSite B S hS Y.1 Y.2).IsPseudoCoherent
        ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS f).obj E) ∧
      ∀ {X' Y' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (g' : X' ⟶ X) (f' : X' ⟶ Y')
        (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g),
        IsIso (smallEtaleDerivedModuleBaseChangeMap B S hS f g f' g' sq.w E)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.torIndependent_baseChange_product_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a scheme, let
```
Z' ⟶ Y'
↓     ↓
X' ⟶ B'
```
be a commutative square of algebraic spaces over `S`, let `Bb ⟶ B'` be a morphism and let `Xb`
and `Yb` be the base changes of `X'` and `Y'` to `Bb`.  If `Y' ⟶ B'` and `Z' ⟶ X'` are flat,
then `Xb ×_{Bb} Yb` and `Z'` are Tor independent over `X' ×_{B'} Y'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem torIndependent_baseChange_product_of_isFlat
    {Bb B' X' Y' Z' Xb Yb P P' : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    {bb : Bb ⟶ B'} {x : X' ⟶ B'} {y : Y' ⟶ B'} {zx : Z' ⟶ X'} {zy : Z' ⟶ Y'}
    (hz : zx ≫ x = zy ≫ y)
    {xX' : Xb ⟶ X'} {xB : Xb ⟶ Bb} (sqX : IsPullback xX'.hom xB.hom x.hom bb.hom)
    {yY' : Yb ⟶ Y'} {yB : Yb ⟶ Bb} (sqY : IsPullback yY'.hom yB.hom y.hom bb.hom)
    {pXb : P ⟶ Xb} {pYb : P ⟶ Yb} (sqP : IsPullback pXb.hom pYb.hom xB.hom yB.hom)
    {p'X : P' ⟶ X'} {p'Y : P' ⟶ Y'} (sqP' : IsPullback p'X.hom p'Y.hom x.hom y.hom)
    (pp' : P ⟶ P') (hpp'X : pp' ≫ p'X = pXb ≫ xX') (hpp'Y : pp' ≫ p'Y = pYb ≫ yY')
    (zp' : Z' ⟶ P') (hzp'X : zp' ≫ p'X = zx) (hzp'Y : zp' ≫ p'Y = zy)
    (hy : IsFlat B S hS y.hom) (hzx : IsFlat B S hS zx.hom) :
    TorIndependent P.2 Z'.2 P'.2 pp'.hom zp'.hom

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.nonempty_derivedChowDatum
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTR (derived Chow lemma).** Let `A` be a ring and `X` an algebraic space separated
and of finite presentation over `A`. Every point `x ∈ |X|` carries a datum of the derived Chow
lemma: `n ≥ 0`, a closed subspace `Z ⊂ X ×_A ℙⁿ_A` of finite presentation, an open `V ⊂ ℙⁿ_A`,
a point of `c⁻¹(V)` over `x` and `E ∈ D(𝒪_{X ×_A ℙⁿ_A})` with properties (1)–(5) of the source
(`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DerivedChowDatum`).
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_derivedChowDatum (X : AlgebraicSpaces B (Spec (.of A)) hA)
    (hsep : IsSeparated B (Spec (.of A)) hA (toBase B (Spec (.of A)) hA X).hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B (Spec (.of A)) hA (toBase B (Spec (.of A)) hA X).hom)
    (x : points B (Spec (.of A)) hA X.1) :
    Nonempty (DerivedChowDatum X x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DerivedChowDatum.isFinitePresentation_overOpenToOpen
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTS, first assertion.** For `X` of finite presentation over `S`, the closed
immersion `c|_W : W ⟶ V` is of finite presentation.
declarations.statement:
theorem isFinitePresentation_overOpenToOpen
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B S hS (toBase B S hS X).hom) :
    IsFinitePresentation B S hS (overOpenToOpen D.i D.v).hom
declarations.comment: the closed immersion c|_W : W ⟶ V of the statement is of finite presentation

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.DerivedChowDatum.nonempty_restrict_derivedPushforward_tensor_iso
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTS.** For a datum `(n, Z, z, V, E)` of the derived Chow lemma on `X` and
`K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)`, `Rq_*(Lp^*K ⊗^𝐋 E)|_V ≅ R(c|_W)_* K|_W`, where `p` and `q` are the two
projections of `X ×_S ℙⁿ_S`, `c|_W : W ⟶ V` is the closed immersion of the datum and `K|_W` is
the derived pullback along the étale morphism `b : W ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_restrict_derivedPushforward_tensor_iso
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (ringedToposStructureRingSheaf B S hS X)))
    (hK : QcohDerived B S hS X K) :
    Nonempty ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS D.v).obj
        ((derivedModulePushforward B S hS (productSnd X D.n D.contains)).obj
          (((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B S hS (product B S hS X D.n D.contains)).obj
            ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS (productFst X D.n D.contains)).obj K)).obj
              D.E)) ≅
      (derivedModulePushforward B S hS (overOpenToOpen D.i D.v)).obj
        ((smallEtaleDerivedModulePullback B S hS
          (overOpenι D.i D.v ≫ D.i ≫ productFst X D.n D.contains)).obj K))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isRelativelyPseudoCoherent_of_isPseudoCoherent_derivedSections_tensor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTT.** Let `X` be an algebraic space separated and of finite presentation over `A`
and `K ∈ D_QCoh(𝒪_X)` with `RΓ(X, E ⊗^𝐋 K)` pseudo-coherent over `A` for every pseudo-coherent
`E`. Then `K` is pseudo-coherent relative to `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativelyPseudoCoherent_of_isPseudoCoherent_derivedSections_tensor
    {X : AlgebraicSpaces B (Spec (CommRingCat.of A)) hA}
    (hsep : IsSeparated B _ hA (toBase B _ hA X).hom)
    (hfp : IsFinitePresentation B _ hA (toBase B _ hA X).hom)
    (K : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B _ hA X.1 X.2)) (hK : QcohDerived B _ hA X K)
    (h : ∀ E : DerivedCategory (Modules.{u, u} B _ hA X.1 X.2),
      (smallEtaleRingedSite B _ hA X.1 X.2).IsPseudoCoherent E →
        StacksDraft.PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent
          ((representedAffineDerivedSections B _ hA (baseSiteObj B _ hA)).obj
            ((derivedModulePushforward B _ hA (toBase B _ hA X)).obj
              (((smallEtaleDerivedTensor B _ hA X).obj E).obj K)))) :
    IsRelativelyPseudoCoherent B _ hA X.1 X.2 (toBase B _ hA X).hom
      (isLocallyOfFiniteType_of_isLocallyOfFinitePresentation B _ hA hfp.1) ⟨K, hK⟩

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.weaklyAssociated_tfae_henselization
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CTU.** A point is weakly associated to a quasi-coherent sheaf if and
only if the maximal ideal of its stalk is weakly associated to the stalk module; equivalently,
the corresponding maximal ideal remains weakly associated after extension to a henselization or
a strict henselization.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociated_tfae_henselization
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (x : X)
    {Rh Rsh : Type u}
    [CommRing Rh] [IsLocalRing Rh] [Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) Rh]
    [IsHenselization (X.presheaf.stalk x) (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) Rh]
    [CommRing Rsh] [IsLocalRing Rsh] [Algebra (X.presheaf.stalk x) Rsh]
    [Algebra (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (ResidueField Rsh)]
    [IsSepClosure (ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk x)) (ResidueField Rsh)]
    [IsHenselization (X.presheaf.stalk x) (ResidueField Rsh) Rsh] :
    let F' : PresheafOfModules (X.presheaf ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat) := F.val
    let M := ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk F'.presheaf x)
    letI : Module (X.presheaf.stalk x) M := inferInstance
    List.TFAE
      [Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint F x,
       IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (X.presheaf.stalk x) M
         (maximalIdeal (X.presheaf.stalk x)),
       IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime Rh (TensorProduct (X.presheaf.stalk x) Rh M)
         (maximalIdeal Rh),
       IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime Rsh (TensorProduct (X.presheaf.stalk x) Rsh M)
         (maximalIdeal Rsh)]

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Zariski and étale weak association agree at a point of a chart scheme.** Let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_Z`-module and let `w` be a point of the scheme of an étale chart `W` of `Z`.
Then `w` is weakly associated to the restriction `F|_W`, in the Zariski sense of Stacks 056L,
exactly when the point of `Z` it lies over is weakly associated to `F` in the sense of
Stacks 0CTX.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint
    (Z : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Z.1 Z.2)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (W : SmallEtale B S hS Z.1) (w : chartScheme W) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS Z.2 F W) w ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Z F (chartSchemeToPoints B S hS Z.1 W w)
declarations.comment:
conditions (1) and (2) at a point of a chart scheme, with no geometric point in
the statement

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (4) and (5) at a point of a chart scheme.** Let `X` be a locally
Noetherian algebraic space, `F` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `w` a point of the scheme of
an étale chart `W` of `X`. Then `w` is *associated* to the restriction `F|_W`, in the Zariski
sense of Stacks 02OJ, exactly when the point of `X` it lies over is weakly associated to `F` in
the sense of Stacks 0CTX.

The chart's scheme is locally Noetherian by Stacks 03E8, so the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{W, w}` is
finitely generated and association at `w` is weak association at `w` by Stacks 05AR; that is
conditions (1) and (2).
declarations.statement:
theorem isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : chartScheme W) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) w ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F (chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W w)
declarations.comment: conditions (4) and (5) at a point of a chart scheme

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, condition (4).** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space and `F` a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. A point `x` of `X` is weakly associated to `F` exactly when there
is *some* étale scheme chart `W` of `X` and some point `w` of its scheme above `x` which is
associated to the restriction `F|_W`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x ↔
      ∃ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : chartScheme W),
        chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W w = x ∧
          Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) w
declarations.comment: condition (4)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_forall_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, condition (5).** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space and `F` a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. A point `x` of `X` is weakly associated to `F` exactly when
*every* point of the scheme of *every* étale chart of `X` lying above `x` is associated to the
restriction of `F` to that chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_forall_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x ↔
      ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : chartScheme W),
        chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W w = x →
          Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) w
declarations.comment: condition (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_forall
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (4) and (5).** On a locally Noetherian algebraic space ordinary
association of some point of some étale scheme chart above `x` is ordinary association of every
point of every such chart.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_forall
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    (∃ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : chartScheme W),
        chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W w = x ∧
          Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) w) ↔
      ∀ (W : SmallEtale B S hS X.1) (w : chartScheme W),
        chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 W w = x →
          Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F W) w
declarations.comment: conditions (4) and (5)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (4) and (5) against condition (3).** Let `X` be a locally
Noetherian algebraic space, `F` a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and `φ : (U, ū) → (X, x̄)` an
étale neighbourhood of a geometric point whose chart `U` is a scheme. Then `u` is associated to
`φ^*F` exactly when the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is a weakly associated prime of the
geometric stalk `F_{x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
        (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V) ↔
      letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
        isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
      letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))
declarations.comment: conditions (4) and (5) against condition (3)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (4) and (5) against condition (6).** In the situation of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime`, `u` is
associated to `φ^*F` exactly when the maximal ideal of the étale local ring `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is an
associated prime of the geometric stalk `F_{x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
    (hLN : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
    letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
    (Stacks.Divisors.IsAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
        (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V) ↔
      IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)))
declarations.comment: conditions (4) and (5) against condition (6)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_maximalIdeal_iff_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (3) ⟺ (6).** Let `F` be an `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space and `x̄` a
geometric point of `X` at which the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is finitely generated. That
maximal ideal is a weakly associated prime of the geometric stalk `F_{x̄}` if and only if it is
an associated prime of `F_{x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_maximalIdeal_iff_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
    letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
    (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)).FG →
      (IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)) ↔
        IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)))
declarations.comment: conditions (3) and (6) at a geometric point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (3) ⟺ (6)** on a Noetherian algebraic space: a point is weakly associated to
an `𝒪_X`-module exactly when, at some geometric point above it, the maximal ideal of the étale
local ring is an associated prime of the geometric stalk.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (hNoetherian : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ X.1)
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x ↔
      ∃ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, xbar.LiesOver x ∧
        letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
          isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
        letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
        IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))
declarations.comment: conditions (3) and (6) on a Noetherian algebraic space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_setOf_exists_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (3) ⟺ (6)** on a Noetherian algebraic space, as an equality of sets of
points: `WeakAss(F)` is the set of points carrying a geometric point at whose stalk the maximal
ideal of the étale local ring is an associated prime.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_setOf_exists_isAssociatedPrimeStacks
    (hZ : B.Contains (⊤_ Scheme.{u})) (hNoetherian : IsNoetherian B S hS hZ X.1)
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F =
      {x : points B S hS X.1 | ∃ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, xbar.LiesOver x ∧
        letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
          isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
        letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
        IsAssociatedPrimeStacks (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))}
declarations.comment: conditions (3) and (6) as a set of points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_maximalIdeal_geometricModuleStalk_of_chart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (1) ⟹ (3).** Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let
`φ : (U, ū) → (X, x̄)` be an étale neighbourhood of a geometric point `x̄` whose chart `U` is a
scheme. If `u` is weakly associated to `φ^*F`, then the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is a weakly
associated prime of the geometric stalk `F_{x̄}`.

By Stacks 05VP the geometric stalk is `(φ^*F)_u ⊗_{𝒪_{U, u}} 𝒪_{X, x̄}` and the comparison map
is flat and carries the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{U, u}` onto that of `𝒪_{X, x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_maximalIdeal_geometricModuleStalk_of_chart
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (h : Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
    letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))
declarations.comment: condition (1) implies condition (3) at a geometric point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (3) ⟹ (1).** Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let
`φ : (U, ū) → (X, x̄)` be an étale neighbourhood of a geometric point `x̄` whose chart `U` is a
scheme. If the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is a weakly associated prime of `F_{x̄}` then `u` is
weakly associated to `φ^*F`.

This is the descent of weak association from a strict henselization, Stacks 0CTU: the étale
local ring at `x̄` is the strict henselization of `𝒪_{U, u}` chosen in
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.chartHenselizationTower` by Stacks 04KF, and the geometric stalk is the
base change of the Zariski stalk `(φ^*F)_u` along it by Stacks 05VP.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (h : letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
          isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
        letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
            (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
        IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)
declarations.comment: condition (3) implies condition (1) at an étale neighbourhood

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_of_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (3) ⟹ (1), by flat descent over finitely many weakly associated primes.**
The conclusion of
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime`,
reached instead by flat descent of weak association along the comparison map of Stacks 05VP,
under finiteness of the set of weakly associated primes of the Zariski module stalk of the
chart.

`Stacks.WeaklyAssociatedPrimes.isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_comap_tensorProduct`, used here, turns
the covering of the maximal ideal by the weakly associated primes of the localization into an
equality by prime avoidance over finitely many primes. That is not the source's own route:
Stacks 0CTW proves (1), (2) and (3) equivalent with nothing beyond quasi-coherence, by
More on Flatness, Lemma 38.2.9, which is Tag 0CTU, and which
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime`
above now takes. This form is retained as the one a local finiteness statement about the weakly
associated points of the chart discharges directly, since the primes of the local ring at a
point all lie in every neighbourhood of it.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_of_finite
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (hfin : (weaklyAssociatedPrimes (chartLocalRing B S hS X.1 V)
      (chartZariskiModuleStalk B S hS X.1 X.2 V F)).Finite)
    (h : letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
          isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
        letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
            (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
        IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)
declarations.comment:
condition (3) implies condition (1) at a chart whose Zariski module stalk has
finitely many weakly associated primes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (1) ⟺ (3)** at an étale neighbourhood: the point `u` of the chart is weakly
associated to `φ^*F` exactly when the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is a weakly associated prime
of `F_{x̄}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_iff
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
        (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V) ↔
      letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
        isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
      letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) :=
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F).isModule
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F)
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (3) at an étale neighbourhood

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, (1) ⟹ (3) in the form of Stacks 0CTX.** If the point `u` of an étale scheme
chart is weakly associated to `φ^*F` then the point of `X` it lies over is weakly associated
to `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (x : points B S hS X.1)
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (hxbar : xbar.LiesOver x)
    (V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (h : Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x
declarations.comment: condition (1) implies the weak association of Stacks 0CTX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_restrictToChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (1) and (2).** Weak association at a chart point does not depend
on the chart: if the point of one étale scheme chart of `x̄` is weakly associated to the
restriction of `F` there, so is the point of any other.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_restrictToChart_of_restrictToChart
    {xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1} (V V' : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (h : Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V'.chart)
      (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V')
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2) for the étale neighbourhoods of a geometric point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_restrictToChart
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTW, conditions (1) and (2) in the form of Stacks 0CTX.** A point of `X` is weakly
associated to a quasi-coherent `F` exactly when, at some geometric point above it, the
corresponding point of some étale scheme chart is weakly associated to the restriction of `F`
there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_exists_restrictToChart
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x ↔
      ∃ (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1), xbar.LiesOver x ∧
        ∃ V : SmallEtaleNeighborhood xbar,
          Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (restrictToChart B S hS X.2 F V.chart)
            (chartPoint B S hS X.1 V)
declarations.comment: conditions (1) and (2) as the weak association of Stacks 0CTX

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_moduleStalkLarge
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTX**, weak association read before the extension of scalars: a point of an
algebraic space is weakly associated to an `𝒪_X`-module exactly when, at some geometric point
above it, the maximal ideal of the stalk of the structure sheaf at the corresponding point of
the small étale site is weakly associated to the stalk of the module there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_iff_moduleStalkLarge (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u})
    (hS : B.Contains S) (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x ↔
      ∃ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, xbar.LiesOver x ∧
        letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
          isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
        letI : IsLocalRing
            (((etaleSitePoint B S hS X.1 xbar X.2).presheafFiber (A := CommRingCat.{u})).obj
              (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O.obj) :=
          (pointStalkRingEquiv B S hS X xbar).symm.isLocalRing
        IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime
          (((etaleSitePoint B S hS X.1 xbar X.2).presheafFiber (A := CommRingCat.{u})).obj
            (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O.obj)
          (Stacks.moduleStalkLarge (etaleSitePoint B S hS X.1 xbar X.2)
            (smallEtaleRingedTopos B S hS X).O F)
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _)
declarations.comment: weak association on the stalk at the point of the small étale site

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_forall_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTX**, the algebraic criterion for weak association. A point of an algebraic space
is weakly associated to an `𝒪_X`-module as soon as, at some geometric point above it, the
geometric stalk has a nonzero element some power of each non-unit of the étale local ring
annihilates: the annihilator of that element lies in the maximal ideal because the ring is local,
and a prime below the maximal ideal containing the annihilator then contains every non-unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_forall_exists_pow_smul_eq_zero
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) (hxbar : xbar.LiesOver x)
    (t : geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar F) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hpow : ∀ a : etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar, ¬ IsUnit a → ∃ n : ℕ, a ^ n • t = 0) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x
declarations.comment: weak association from a stalk element killed by powers of the non-units

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTX, part (1).** A point `x` of an algebraic space `X` is *weakly associated* to
an `𝒪_X`-module `F` when, at some geometric point above `x`, the maximal ideal of the étale
local ring is a weakly associated prime of the geometric stalk of `F`, that is, when it is
minimal among the primes containing the annihilator of some element of that stalk.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (x : points B S hS X.1) : Prop
declarations.comment: weakly associated point

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTX, part (2).** The set `WeakAss(F)` of points of an algebraic space weakly
associated to an `𝒪_X`-module `F`.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable abbrev weaklyAssociatedPoints (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    Set (points B S hS X.1)
declarations.comment: set of weakly associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPointsOfSpace
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTX, part (3).** The weakly associated points `WeakAss(X)` of an algebraic space
`X` are the weakly associated points of its structure sheaf.
declarations.statement: noncomputable abbrev weaklyAssociatedPointsOfSpace : Set (points B S hS X.1)
declarations.comment: weakly associated points of the space

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_supportOfSheaf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTY.** The weakly associated points of an `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space lie
in the support of its underlying abelian sheaf.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_supportOfSheaf
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F ⊆
      supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTZ, first inclusion.** In a short exact sequence of `𝒪_X`-modules on an
algebraic space, every weakly associated point of the first module is weakly associated to the
middle module.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_of_shortExact
    (σ : ShortComplex (Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2)) (hσ : σ.ShortExact) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₁ ⊆ weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₂
declarations.comment: subsheaf

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTZ, second inclusion.** In a short exact sequence of `𝒪_X`-modules on an
algebraic space, every weakly associated point of the middle module is weakly associated to one
of the outer modules.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact
    [Balanced (Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2)]
    (σ : ShortComplex (Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2)) (hσ : σ.ShortExact) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₂ ⊆
      weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₁ ∪ weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₃
declarations.comment: middle_term

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact_unconditional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CTZ, second inclusion.** In a short exact sequence of `𝒪_X`-modules on an
algebraic space, every weakly associated point of the middle module is weakly associated to one
of the outer modules.

This is `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact` with its
balancedness instance supplied by `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.balanced_modules_max`: the `𝒪_X`-modules
with sections in a universe containing the universe of the schemes are abelian, the small étale
site being essentially small there, and an abelian category is balanced.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset_union_of_shortExact_unconditional
    (σ : ShortComplex (Modules.{u, max u m} B S hS X.1 X.2)) (hσ : σ.ShortExact) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₂ ⊆
      weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₁ ∪ weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X σ.X₃
declarations.comment: middle_term, for sections in any universe containing the universe of the schemes and with no assumed inputs: the balancedness of the category of modules that the general form takes as an instance hypothesis is discharged here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty_of_isZero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CU0**, the direction that a vanishing module has no weakly associated points: a
zero `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space has empty set of weakly associated points.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty_of_isZero
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    (X : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS) (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : IsZero F) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F = ∅
declarations.comment: a zero module has no weakly associated points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isZero_iff_weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CU0.** A quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space is zero if and only if
it has no weakly associated point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isZero_iff_weaklyAssociatedPoints_eq_empty (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] : IsZero F ↔ weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F = ∅

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_subset_image_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then every weakly associated point of `f_*F` is the image of a
weakly associated point of `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_subset_image_of_isAffineHom
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) ⊆
      pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom '' weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.affinePushforwardWeaklyAssociatedImage
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Granted the hypothesis `h`, the same inclusion for a target
represented by an affine scheme of the site, every weakly associated point of `f_*F` is the
image of a weakly associated point of `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem affinePushforwardWeaklyAssociatedImage
    (h : SchemeTargetAffinePushforwardWeaklyAssociatedImage B S hS) :
    AffinePushforwardWeaklyAssociatedImage B S hS
declarations.comment: the reduction to a target represented by an affine scheme of the site, which is the hypothesis h; that case needs the comparison of the Zariski and small-étale modules of a represented algebraic space, absent here

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_relativeAssassin_of_mem_relativeAssassin_sections
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CU5.** A relative associated prime of the sections on an affine open
gives a relative associated point of the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_relativeAssassin_of_mem_relativeAssassin_sections
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := (f.appLE V U hUV).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(S, V) Γ(F, U) :=
      Module.compHom Γ(F, U) (f.appLE V U hUV).hom
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_compHom Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) ∈
      Module.relativeAssassin Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) →
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F
declarations.comment: forward implication

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.mem_relativeAssassin_sections_iff_of_locallyNoetherian_fibers
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CU5.** With locally Noetherian fibres, the relative associated
primes of affine sections are exactly the relative associated points of the sheaf.
declarations.statement:
public theorem mem_relativeAssassin_sections_iff_of_locallyNoetherian_fibers
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Opens) (V : S.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hUV : U ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V) (hf : ∀ s : S, IsLocallyNoetherian (f.fiber s))
    {x : X} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) := (f.appLE V U hUV).hom.toAlgebra
    letI : Module Γ(S, V) Γ(F, U) :=
      Module.compHom Γ(F, U) (f.appLE V U hUV).hom
    letI : IsScalarTower Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) :=
      IsScalarTower.of_compHom Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U)
    (hU.primeIdealOf ⟨x, hx⟩) ∈
      Module.relativeAssassin Γ(S, V) Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) ↔
      x ∈ Stacks.Divisors.relativeAssassin f F
declarations.comment: locally Noetherian equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.PureModules.exists_not_mem_and_mem_associatedPrimes_not_le_fiberIdeal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CU6.** An element can be chosen outside `q` whose image in the
fibre lies in every associated prime of the fibre module that is not contained in the
extension of `q`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_not_mem_and_mem_associatedPrimes_not_le_fiberIdeal
    {R S N : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.FinitePresentation S N]
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p] :
    letI : Algebra S (p.Fiber S) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ∃ g : S, g ∉ q ∧
      ∀ r ∈ associatedPrimes (p.Fiber S) (TensorProduct S (p.Fiber S) N),
        ¬ r ≤ Ideal.map
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S).toRingHom q →
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S) g ∈ r

declarations.name: Stacks.PureModules.comap_associatedPrime_le_fiberIdeal_of_isUnit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CU7.** With `g ∈ S` chosen as in Tag 0CU6, let `B` be an étale algebra
over the fibre ring `p.Fiber S` in which the image of `g` is a unit. Then every prime of `B`
associated to the base change of the fibre module contracts to a prime of `p.Fiber S` contained
in the extension of `q`.

Indeed, such a contraction is associated to the fibre module itself, because `B` is flat over the
fibre ring and the fibre ring is Noetherian; were it not contained in the extension of `q`, the
choice of `g` would put the image of `g` inside it, contradicting the fact that the image of `g`
in `B` is a unit.
declarations.statement:
theorem comap_associatedPrime_le_fiberIdeal_of_isUnit
    {R S N B : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    [Algebra.FinitePresentation R S] [AddCommGroup N] [Module S N]
    [Module.FinitePresentation S N]
    (p : Ideal R) (q : Ideal S) [p.IsPrime] [q.IsPrime] [q.LiesOver p]
    [CommRing B] [Algebra (p.Fiber S) B] [Algebra.Etale (p.Fiber S) B]
    (g : S)
    (hg : letI : Algebra S (p.Fiber S) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
      g ∉ q ∧
        (∀ r ∈ associatedPrimes (p.Fiber S)
          (TensorProduct S (p.Fiber S) N),
          (¬ r ≤ Ideal.map
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S).toRingHom q →
            (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S) g ∈ r)))
    (hunit : IsUnit ((algebraMap (p.Fiber S) B)
      ((Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S) g))) :
    letI : Algebra S (p.Fiber S) := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra
    ∀ r' ∈ associatedPrimes B
      (TensorProduct (p.Fiber S) B (TensorProduct S (p.Fiber S) N)),
      Ideal.comap (algebraMap (p.Fiber S) B) r' ≤
        Ideal.map
          (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight : S →ₐ[R] p.Fiber S).toRingHom q

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom_locallyNoetherian
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. If `X` is locally Noetherian, then the weakly associated points of
`f_*F` are exactly the images of the weakly associated points of `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom_locallyNoetherian
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (hX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1
      (fun T : Scheme.{u} => _root_.AlgebraicGeometry.IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) =
      pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom '' weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CU8.** Let `f : X → Y` be an affine morphism of algebraic spaces with `X` locally
Noetherian and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then the weakly associated points of
the direct image `f_*F` are exactly the images of the weakly associated points of `F`.

The inclusion `h0CU2` is Stacks 0CU2, and `h05VP` is the affine chart presentation of the two
geometric stalks of Stacks 05VP, which also carries the quasi-coherence of the direct image of
Stacks 03M9; both are assumed here in the affine, locally Noetherian, quasi-coherent situation
in which they are asserted.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isAffineHom
    (hf : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom)
    (hX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (h0CU2 : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom →
      HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T) →
      F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite →
      weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) ⊆
        pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom '' weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F)
    (h05VP : IsAffineHom B S hS f.hom →
      HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun T : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian T) →
      F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite →
      ∀ xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1,
        HasAffineStalkSquare B S hS f F ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) xbar) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) =
      pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom '' weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isFinite
declarations.doc:
**Weakly associated points of a finite direct image.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite morphism
of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S` and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then
`WeakAss(f_*F) = f(WeakAss(F))`.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_eq_image_of_isFinite
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS}
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsFinite B S hS f.hom) (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) =
      pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom '' weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUA.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism of algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let
`G` be an `𝒪_Y`-module, let `x` be a point of `X` with image `y`, and let `x̄` be a geometric
point above `x`. Suppose that `y` is weakly associated to `G`, that `f` is flat at `x`, and
that the local ring of the fibre of `f` at `x̄` has dimension zero — that is, the maximal ideal
of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is the radical of the ideal generated by the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{Y, ȳ}`. Then
`x` is weakly associated to `f^*G`.

The stalk of `f^*G` at `x̄` is the base change `𝒪_{X, x̄} ⊗_{𝒪_{Y, ȳ}} G_{ȳ}` by the
base-change clause of Stacks 05VQ, and weak association at `ȳ` follows from weak association
of `y` because the condition does not depend on the geometric point chosen above a point.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback (f : X ⟶ Y) (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1) (hxbar : xbar.LiesOver x)
    (hflat : IsFlatAt B S hS f.hom x) (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
    letI : Algebra (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
        (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) := (etaleLocalRingMap X.2 f.hom xbar).toAlgebra
    (Ideal.map (algebraMap (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
            (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar))
          (maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)))).radical =
        maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) →
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Y G (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom x) →
        IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) x
declarations.comment:
the zero-dimensional local ring of the fibre read as the equality of the maximal
ideal of the étale local ring with the radical of the ideal extended from the maximal ideal of
the target, at a geometric point above the given point

declarations.name: IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime.comap_tensorProduct_field
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUB.** Let `K / k` be a field extension, `R` a `k`-algebra and `M` an
`R`-module. If a prime `𝔮 ⊂ R ⊗[k] K` is weakly associated to `M ⊗[k] K`, here written as the
base change `(R ⊗[k] K) ⊗[R] M`, then the prime `𝔭 = 𝔮 ∩ R` it lies over is weakly associated to
`M`.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime.comap_tensorProduct_field {k K R M : Type*} [Field k]
    [Field K] [Algebra k K] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    {q : Ideal (R ⊗[k] K)} (hq : IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (R ⊗[k] K) ((R ⊗[k] K) ⊗[R] M) q) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime R M (q.comap (algebraMap R (R ⊗[k] K)))

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUC.** If a point of a field base change is weakly associated to the
pullback of a quasi-coherent module, then its image is weakly associated to the original
module.
declarations.statement:
lemma isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_baseChange {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (y : (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme.{u})) (x : X)
    (hyx : (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))).base y = x)
    (hy : Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj F) y) :
    Stacks.Divisors.IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint F x

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUD.**  The relative weak assassin of a finite direct image is the
image of the relative weak assassin on the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints_pushforward_eq_image
    {Z X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsFinite i]
    (F : Z.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] :
    relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints f ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj F) =
      i '' relativeWeaklyAssociatedPoints (i ≫ f) F

Passing to underlying topological spaces preserves the limit of a cofiltered diagram of

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.existsUnique_mem_closure_singleton_of_compatible
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUG.** The closure of a point in a cofiltered limit of schemes with
affine transition morphisms is the inverse limit, as a set, of the closures of its images.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_mem_closure_singleton_of_compatible
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (s : c.pt)
    (x : ∀ i, D.obj i)
    (hx : ∀ ⦃i j : I⦄ (f : i ⟶ j), D.map f (x i) = x j)
    (hx_closure : ∀ i, x i ∈ closure ({c.π.app i s} : Set (D.obj i))) :
    ∃! y : c.pt, y ∈ closure ({s} : Set c.pt) ∧ ∀ i, c.π.app i y = x i
declarations.comment: closures_sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isLimit_reducedClosures
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUG.** The reduced closure of a point of a cofiltered limit of
schemes is the limit, as a scheme, of the reduced closures of its images.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isLimit_reducedClosures
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (s : c.pt) :
    ∃ (E : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (ι : E ⟶ D) (c' : Cone E)
      (e : c'.pt ≅ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({s} : Set c.pt))).subscheme),
      (∀ i, ∃ eᵢ : E.obj i ≅ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
        (Closeds.closure ({c.π.app i s} : Set (D.obj i)))).subscheme,
        eᵢ.hom ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({c.π.app i s} : Set (D.obj i)))).subschemeι = ι.app i) ∧
      (∀ i, c'.π.app i ≫ ι.app i =
        e.hom ≫ (Scheme.IdealSheafData.vanishingIdeal
          (Closeds.closure ({s} : Set c.pt))).subschemeι ≫ c.π.app i) ∧
      Nonempty (IsLimit c')
declarations.comment: closures_schemes

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.residueField_isColimit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUG.** The residue field of a point in a cofiltered limit of schemes
with affine transition morphisms is the filtered colimit of the residue fields of its images.
declarations.statement:
theorem residueField_isColimit
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (s : c.pt)
    (K : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ CommRingCat.{u})
    (e : ∀ i : I,
      K.obj (Opposite.op i) ≅ (D.obj i).residueField (c.π.app i s))
    (hK : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      K.map f.op =
        (e j).hom ≫
          ((D.obj j).residueFieldCongr (by
            symm
            change (c.π.app i ≫ D.map f) s = _
            rw [c.w f])).hom ≫
          (D.map f).residueFieldMap (c.π.app i s) ≫ (e i).inv) :
    ∀ (T : CommRingCat.{u})
      (φ : ∀ i : I, K.obj (Opposite.op i) ⟶ T),
      (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), K.map f.op ≫ φ i = φ j) →
      ∃! ψ : c.pt.residueField s ⟶ T,
        ∀ i : I, (e i).hom ≫ (c.π.app i).residueFieldMap s ≫ ψ = φ i
declarations.comment: residue_fields

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isClosedImmersion_limitMap
declarations.doc:
A stagewise closed immersion between inverse systems of algebraic spaces with affine
transition morphisms induces a closed immersion of their inverse limits.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosedImmersion_limitMap
    (B : BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    {X Y : I ⥤ (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u}
    (η : X ⟶ Y)
    (hX : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (X.obj i))
    (hY : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (Y.obj i))
    (hXAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (X.map f))
    (hYAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (Y.map f))
    (hClosed : ∀ i, IsClosedImmersion B S hS (η.app i)) :
    IsClosedImmersion B S hS (limMap η)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isReduced_limit
declarations.doc:
A cofiltered inverse limit of reduced algebraic spaces with affine
transition morphisms is reduced.
declarations.statement:
public theorem Space.isReduced_limit
    (B : AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfSite.{u}) (S : Scheme.{u}) (hS : B.Contains S)
    {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ (AlgebraicGeometry.BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hSize : Cardinal.mk I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, Cardinal.mk (i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      AlgebraicGeometry.Space.IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hReduced : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (D.obj i)
      (fun X : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced X)) :
    AlgebraicGeometry.Space.HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (limit D)
      (fun X : Scheme.{u} => IsReduced X)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_point_limit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUJ.** Let `D` be a directed inverse system of decent algebraic spaces over `S`
with affine transition morphisms, indexed by a category whose object type and whose morphism
types are smaller than the cofinality of the site's size cutoff. Then a family of points of
the stages which is compatible with the transition morphisms is induced by exactly one point
of `limit D`; that is, `|lim D| = lim |D|` as sets.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_point_limit (D : I ⥤ (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u)
    (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (_hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (_hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hDecent : ∀ i, IsDecentSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (x : ∀ i, points B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hx : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), pointsMap B S hS (D.obj i) (D.map f) (x i) = x j) :
    ∃! y : points B S hS (limit D),
      ∀ i, pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) y = x i

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.closure_singleton_limit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUK, as sets.** Let `x` be a point of the limit `X` of a cofiltered inverse
system of algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms, with images `x i` in the
stages. The closure of `x` in `|X|` is the intersection of the preimages of the closures of
the `x i`, that is, the inverse limit of those closures.
declarations.statement:
theorem closure_singleton_limit (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (x : points B S hS (limit D)) :
    closure {x} = ⋂ i : I, pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) ⁻¹'
      closure {pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) x}
declarations.comment: as sets

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.existsUnique_point_closure_limit
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUK, as sets.** The set-level assertion read through the identification
`|X| = lim |D i|` of Stacks 0CUJ, for a compatible family of points.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_point_closure_limit (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (hDecent : ∀ i, IsDecentSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (x : points B S hS (limit D)) (z : ∀ i, points B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hz : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), pointsMap B S hS (D.obj i) (D.map f) (z i) = z j)
    (hzmem : ∀ i, z i ∈ closure {pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) x}) :
    ∃! y : points B S hS (limit D), y ∈ closure {x} ∧
      ∀ i, pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) y = z i
declarations.comment: as sets, for a compatible family of points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.exists_iso_limit_reducedClosure
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUK, as algebraic spaces.** Let `x` be a point of the limit `X` of a cofiltered
inverse system of algebraic spaces over `S` with affine transition morphisms. The closure of
`x`, with its reduced induced structure, is the limit of the closures of the images `x i` with
theirs: those closures form an inverse system of algebraic spaces with affine transition
morphisms, its limit is reduced, and the inclusion of the closure of `x` into `X` factors
through an isomorphism onto that limit.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_limit_reducedClosure (hSize : #I < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hHomSize : ∀ i j : I, #(i ⟶ j) < B.cutoff.ord.cof)
    (hD : ∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (D.obj i))
    (hAffine : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (D.map f))
    (x : points B S hS (limit D)) :
    ∃ (E : I ⥤ (BigFppfOver B S hS)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u) (η : E ⟶ D)
      (e : (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS (limit D)
          (isAlgebraicSpace_limit B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine)
          (closure {x}) isClosed_closure).toFunctor ≅ limit E),
      (∀ i : I, ∃ eᵢ : E.obj i ≅ (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS (D.obj i) (hD i)
            (closure {pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) x}) isClosed_closure).toFunctor,
          eᵢ.hom ≫ (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS (D.obj i) (hD i)
            (closure {pointsMap B S hS (limit D) (limit.π D i) x}) isClosed_closure).ι
            = η.app i) ∧
        (∀ i, IsAlgebraicSpace B S hS (E.obj i)) ∧
        (∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom B S hS (E.map f)) ∧
        HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS (limit E) (fun Y : Scheme.{u} ↦ IsReduced Y) ∧
        e.hom ≫ limMap η = (reducedClosedSubspace B S hS (limit D)
          (isAlgebraicSpace_limit B S hS D hSize hHomSize hD hAffine)
          (closure {x}) isClosed_closure).ι
declarations.comment: as algebraic spaces with the reduced induced structure

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_mem_supportOfSheaf_of_localRingDimension_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUL, the first assertion.** A point of an algebraic space which lies in the
support of an `𝒪_X`-module and has codimension zero, in the sense that the local ring of the
space there has Krull dimension zero, is weakly associated to that module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_mem_supportOfSheaf_of_localRingDimension_eq_zero
    (F : Modules.{u, m} B S hS X.1 X.2) (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (hsupp : x ∈ supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F))
    (codim : localRingDimension B S hS x = 0) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x
declarations.comment: the first assertion, that a codimension-zero point of the support is weakly associated, stated for every module in place of a quasi-coherent one

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_localRingDimension_schemeTheoreticSupport_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUL, the second assertion.** Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite
type with scheme theoretic support `Z`. A point of `Z` of codimension zero in `Z`, in the sense
that the local ring of `Z` there has Krull dimension zero, has an image in `X` weakly associated
to `F`.

The scheme theoretic support is a closed subspace and `F` is the direct image of a
quasi-coherent module `G` on it, by Stacks 07U0; the direct image of Stacks 03LU along the
closed immersion is the direct image along base change of étale charts. The image of the point
lies in the support of `F`, which is the set of points of `Z`, so the stalk of `G` at a
geometric point above it is nonzero, and the first assertion's argument applies on `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_localRingDimension_schemeTheoreticSupport_eq_zero
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    [SheafOfModules.IsFiniteTypeOnSite F]
    (x : points B S hS (schemeTheoreticSupport B S hS X F).toFunctor)
    (codim : localRingDimension B S hS x = 0) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F
      (pointsMap B S hS (schemeTheoreticSupport B S hS X F).toFunctor
        (schemeTheoreticSupport B S hS X F).ι x)
declarations.comment: the second assertion, for a codimension-zero point of the scheme theoretic support of a quasi-coherent module of finite type

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_mem_supportOfSheaf_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUM.** Let `X` be an algebraic space over `S` all of whose chart fibres are
finite — in particular a decent one — and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. A point of
`|X|` which lies in the support of `F` and is not a specialization of another point of that
support is weakly associated to `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_mem_supportOfSheaf_of_specializes
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (hdecent : HasFiniteChartFibersAtEveryPoint B S hS X.1)
    (x : points B S hS X.1)
    (hx : x ∈ supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F))
    (hmin : ∀ y, y ∈ supportOfSheaf B S hS X.1 ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj F) →
      y ⤳ x → y = x) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F x
declarations.comment: with decency read as condition (α) of Stacks 03JX, which is all Stacks 03K5 needs, and with no assumed inputs

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_inter_finite
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUN.** Let `X` be a locally Noetherian algebraic space over a scheme `S` and let
`F` be a coherent `𝒪_X`-module.  Then the weakly associated points of `F` — the associated
points, in the terminology of the source — meet every quasi-compact open subset of `|X|` in a
finite set.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_inter_finite
    (hX : HasEtaleLocalProperty B S hS X.1 (fun Y : Scheme.{u} => IsLocallyNoetherian Y))
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [hF : IsCoherent B S hS X.1 X.2 F]
    (W : Set (points B S hS X.1)) (_hWopen : IsOpen W) (hWcompact : IsCompact W) :
    (weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F ∩ W).Finite

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.injective_sections_eval_of_weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUP.** Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module on an algebraic space
`X` and let `U` be an étale chart of `X` such that every weakly associated point of `F` lies in
the image of `|U| → |X|`.  Then the restriction `Γ(X, F) → Γ(U, F)` of global sections to the
chart is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_sections_eval_of_weaklyAssociatedPoints_subset
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (U : SmallEtale B S hS X.1)
    (weakAss_subset :
      weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F ⊆ Set.range (chartSchemeToPoints B S hS X.1 U)) :
    Function.Injective fun s : F.sections => s.eval (op U)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUQ.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`,
let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `y` be a point of `Y` outside the image of
`|f|`. Then `y` is not weakly associated to `f_*F`.

This is
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward_of_notMem_range` with its
Stacks 0CU2 hypothesis discharged by
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_subset_image_of_isAffineHom`.
Quasi-separatedness of `f`, which the source assumes, is not needed; see the implementation notes
of `StacksFrontier/AlgebraicGeometry/Spaces/WeaklyAssociatedPushforward.lean`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (y : points B S hS Y.1) (hy : y ∉ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom)) :
    ¬ IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) y

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_subset_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUQ, as an inclusion of sets of points.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact
morphism of algebraic spaces over `S` and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. Then every
weakly associated point of `f_*F` lies in the image of `|f|`.

This is the pointwise statement
`AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward` contraposed.
declarations.statement:
theorem weaklyAssociatedPoints_modulePushforward_subset_range
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite) :
    weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) ⊆
      Set.range (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom)
declarations.comment: as an inclusion of sets of points

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward_of_notMem_range
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUQ**, granting Stacks 0CU2.

Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a quasi-compact morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, let `F` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module and let `y` be a point of `Y` outside the image of `|f|`. Then `y`
is not weakly associated to `f_*F`.

The hypothesis `h0CU2` is Stacks 0CU2, the inclusion `WeakAss(g_*H) ⊆ |g|(WeakAss(H))` for an
affine morphism `g`; it is the one step of the source's argument that this development does not
have. Quasi-separatedness of `f`, which the source assumes, is not needed: it enters the source
only through Stacks 03M9, and the argument below does not use quasi-coherence of the direct
image, so Stacks 03M9 is not needed either.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePushforward_of_notMem_range
    (h0CU2 : AffinePushforwardWeaklyAssociatedImage B S hS)
    {X Y : AlgebraicSpaces B S hS} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hfqc : IsQuasiCompact B S hS f.hom)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    (y : points B S hS Y.1) (hy : y ∉ Set.range (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom)) :
    ¬ IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Y ((modulePushforward B S hS f).obj F) y
declarations.comment: granting Stacks 0CU2

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.mono_of_stalk_injective_or_notMem_weaklyAssociatedPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0CUR**.

Let `φ : F ⟶ G` be a map of quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-modules on an algebraic space `X` such that
every point `x` of `X` satisfies at least one of: the induced map `F_x̄ → G_x̄` is injective for
a geometric point `x̄` above `x`, or `x` is not a weakly associated point of `F`.  Then `φ` is
injective.

The proof follows the source: `Ker(φ)` is quasi-coherent by the kernel clause of Stacks 03M1(3),
`WeakAss(Ker(φ)) = ∅`, and `Ker(φ)` vanishes by Stacks 0CU0.
declarations.statement:
theorem mono_of_stalk_injective_or_notMem_weaklyAssociatedPoints
    (F G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] [G.IsQuasicoherentOnSite] (φ : F ⟶ G)
    (hφ : ∀ y : points B S hS X.1,
      (∃ ybar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1, ybar.LiesOver y ∧
          Function.Injective (geometricModuleStalkMap B S hS X ybar φ)) ∨
        y ∉ weaklyAssociatedPoints B S hS X F) :
    Mono φ

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_fibre_of_refines
declarations.doc:
**Weak association descends along a refinement of field-valued points.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y`
be a morphism of algebraic spaces over `S`, let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module, let `q`
refine `p` as a field-valued point of `Y` through `κ : q.siteObject ⟶ p.siteObject`, and let `π`
be the comparison morphism of the fibre of `f` over `q` with the fibre of `f` over `p`,
compatible with the projections to `X` and presenting the one fibre as the base change of the
other along `κ`. If a point of the fibre over `q` is weakly associated to the restriction of `F`
there, then its image in the fibre over `p` is weakly associated to the restriction of `F`
there.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_fibre_of_refines (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) (hF : F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite)
    {p q : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y.1} (κ : q.siteObject ⟶ p.siteObject)
    {π : fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q ⟶ fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f p}
    (hπ : π ≫ fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f p =
      fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f q)
    (sq : IsPullback π.hom (pullback.snd f.hom (fieldMorphism B S hS Y.1 q))
      (pullback.snd f.hom (fieldMorphism B S hS Y.1 p)) (yoneda.map κ))
    {ζ : points B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q).1}
    (h : IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q)
      ((modulePullback B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f q)).obj F) ζ) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f p)
      ((modulePullback B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f p)).obj F)
      (pointsMap B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q).1 π.hom ζ)
declarations.comment: at a refinement of field-valued points of the target, read on the comparison of the two fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_fieldBaseChange
declarations.doc:
**Weak association descends along a field extension.** Let `K/k` be a field extension,
presented by objects `Tk` and `Tk'` of the site with underlying schemes `Spec k` and `Spec K` and
a morphism `gk : Tk' ⟶ Tk` inducing `Spec K → Spec k`. Let `X` be an algebraic space over
`Y = h_{Tk}`, let `X' = X ×_Y Y'` be its base change along `g : Y' ⟶ Y` for `Y' = h_{Tk'}`, and
let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module. If a point `y` of `X'` is weakly associated to the
pullback of `F`, then its image in `X` is weakly associated to `F`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_of_fieldBaseChange (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] (Tk Tk' : BigFppfOver B S hS) (gk : Tk' ⟶ Tk)
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (g : Y' ⟶ Y) (π : X' ⟶ X) (sq : IsPullback π f' f g)
    (ek : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Tk ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (eK : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).obj Tk' ≅ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    (hgk : (BigFppfOver.toScheme B S hS).map gk =
      eK.hom ≫ Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)) ≫ ek.inv)
    (eY : Y.1 ≅ yoneda.obj Tk) (eY' : Y'.1 ≅ yoneda.obj Tk')
    (hg : g.hom ≫ eY.hom = eY'.hom ≫ yoneda.map gk)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2) [F.IsQuasicoherentOnSite]
    (y : points B S hS X'.1)
    (hy : IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X' ((modulePullback B S hS π).obj F) y) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X F (pointsMap B S hS X'.1 π.hom y)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback_iff_of_isFinite_of_isFlat
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUT.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite flat morphism of algebraic spaces over a
scheme `S`, let `G` be an `𝒪_Y`-module and let `x ∈ |X|` be a point with image `y ∈ |Y|`.
Then `x ∈ WeakAss(f^*G)` if and only if `y ∈ WeakAss(G)`.

The source takes `G` quasi-coherent; that hypothesis is not needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback_iff_of_isFinite_of_isFlat (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfinite : IsFinite B S hS f.hom) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) x ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Y G (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_geometricModuleStalk_modulePullback_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0CUT** at the étale local ring, for the geometric stalk of the pullback module.
Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a finite flat morphism of algebraic spaces and let `x̄` be a geometric point
of `X` with image `ȳ`. Then the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{Y, ȳ}` is weakly associated to the
geometric stalk `G_{ȳ}` exactly when the maximal ideal of `𝒪_{X, x̄}` is weakly associated to
the geometric stalk `(f^*G)_{x̄}` of the pullback module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPrime_geometricModuleStalk_modulePullback_iff (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hfinite : IsFinite B S hS f.hom) (hflat : IsFlat B S hS f.hom)
    (xbar : GeometricPoint B S hS X.1)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) :
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 Y.2 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar)
    letI : IsLocalRing (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar) :=
      isLocalRing_etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 X.2 xbar
    letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar) G) :=
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar) G).isModule
    letI : Module (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G)) :=
      (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G)).isModule
    (IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))
          (geometricModuleStalk B S hS Y (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar) G)
          (maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS Y.1 (geometricPointMap f.hom xbar))) ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPrime (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)
        (geometricModuleStalk B S hS X xbar ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G))
        (maximalIdeal (etaleLocalRing B S hS X.1 xbar)))
declarations.comment: at the étale local ring, for the geometric stalk of the pullback module

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback_iff
declarations.doc:
**Weak association along an étale pullback.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` be an étale morphism of
algebraic spaces over a scheme `S`, let `G` be an `𝒪_Y`-module and let `x` be a point of `X` with
image `y`. Then `x` is weakly associated to `f^*G` if and only if `y` is weakly associated to
`G`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_modulePullback_iff (f : X ⟶ Y) (hf : IsEtale B S hS f.hom)
    (G : Modules.{u, u} B S hS Y.1 Y.2) (x : points B S hS X.1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS X ((modulePullback B S hS f).obj G) x ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS Y G (pointsMap B S hS X.1 f.hom x)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_fibre_refines_iff_of_isEtale
declarations.doc:
**Weak association transfers along an étale refinement of field-valued points.** In the
situation of `AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_fibre_of_refines`, with `F` an
arbitrary `𝒪_X`-module, if the morphism of field spectra the refinement presents is étale, then a
point of the fibre over `q` is weakly associated to the restriction of `F` exactly when its image
in the fibre over `p` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeaklyAssociatedPoint_fibre_refines_iff_of_isEtale (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : Modules.{u, u} B S hS X.1 X.2)
    {p q : FieldValuedPoint B S hS Y.1} (κ : q.siteObject ⟶ p.siteObject)
    (hκ : IsEtale B S hS (yoneda.map κ))
    {π : fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q ⟶ fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f p}
    (hπ : π ≫ fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f p =
      fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f q)
    (sq : IsPullback π.hom (pullback.snd f.hom (fieldMorphism B S hS Y.1 q))
      (pullback.snd f.hom (fieldMorphism B S hS Y.1 p)) (yoneda.map κ))
    (ζ : points B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q).1) :
    IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q)
        ((modulePullback B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f q)).obj F) ζ ↔
      IsWeaklyAssociatedPoint B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f p)
        ((modulePullback B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPointProjection B S hS f p)).obj F)
        (pointsMap B S hS (fibreAtFieldValuedPoint B S hS f q).1 π.hom ζ)
declarations.comment: at an etale refinement of field-valued points of the target, read on the comparison of the two fibres

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.Space.isLocallyNoetherianFiber_tfae
declarations.doc:
For a morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of algebraic spaces over `S` and a point `y` of `Y`, local
